Responsibilities include maintaining recruiting systems and records, coordinating scheduling and logistics, processing documentation, and assisting with reports and candidate materials.

This entry-level position works within established procedures with regular guidance and review, offering exposure to the lateral partner recruiting lifecycle and opportunities to develop skills for advancement to the Coordinator level. **Key Responsibilities**

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree required.
* At least one year of law firm experience required; experience in an administrative, recruiting, or operations role preferred.
* Experience maintaining databases, tracking tools, or applicant tracking systems preferred.
* Interest in pursuing a career in legal recruiting.

**Knowledge Skills and Abilities**

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to maintain accurate records and data.
* Ability to manage a high volume of assignments, competing priorities, and deadlines while supporting multiple team members.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills and a professional, service-oriented approach.
* Ability to exercise discretion and maintain the confidentiality of candidate, compensation, and strategic information.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Outlook, and the ability to learn ATS platforms, Smartsheet, and AI tools.
* Ability to work independently and reliably in a remote environment, communicate responsively, and follow through on assignments.
* Willingness to learn lateral partner recruiting processes and assume additional responsibilities as skills develop.

148f89e6769705f26a93.title: Data Operations Specialist
148f89e6769705f26a93.description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

Pricebook Digital is seeking a detail-oriented Data Operations Specialist to support our Distributor Operations team by maintaining accurate data, reviewing records for inconsistencies, and assisting with routine reporting.

This is a hands-on role focused on data entry, data validation, organization, and basic analysis. The ideal candidate is comfortable working with spreadsheets and business systems, enjoys solving discrepancies, and takes pride in producing accurate, reliable work.

This position is well suited for someone early in their career, someone with administrative or operations experience looking to transition into a data-focused role, or someone returning to the workforce who enjoys structured, detail-oriented work.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Enter, update, and maintain information in spreadsheets, databases, and internal business systems.
* Review data for completeness, accuracy, and consistency, correcting errors when appropriate.
* Compare information across multiple sources to identify missing, duplicate, or conflicting records.
* Organize, sort, filter, and clean data to keep information accurate and easy to use.
* Use Excel or Google Sheets to maintain records, perform calculations, and prepare routine reports.
* Run standard reports and summarize findings for the Distributor Operations team.
* Flag unusual results, discrepancies, or data quality concerns and follow established procedures to resolve them.
* Work with team members across the business to clarify information and maintain reliable records.
* Follow established workflows and documentation standards while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and accuracy.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Approximately 2–5 years of experience in an office, administrative, operations, data entry, records management, or similar role preferred.
* Comfortable using Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for organizing, reviewing, and maintaining information.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Ability to follow established processes and manage repetitive tasks consistently.
* Good organizational, time management, and problem-solving skills.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.
* Willingness to learn new systems, tools, and processes.

Experience with CRM systems, ERP platforms, databases, or other business software is a plus.

Advanced SQL, programming, and business intelligence development experience are not required for this position.

**We Offer**
------------

* Base salary of $50,000 per year.
* Remote work.
* Reimbursement for all travel expenses.
* Health benefits, HSA, and 401(k).
* 15 days of paid vacation, sick leave, and 12 paid holidays.
* Career development opportunities.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

Pricebook Digital is an equal-opportunity employer. We do not discriminate against employees or applicants based on any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We value the unique perspectives and experiences each person brings to our team.

**About Pricebook Digital**
---------------------------

Pricebook Digital is a growing technology/SaaS company providing sales and pricing products and services to the HVAC industry. Our products help dealers, distributors, and manufacturers sell more efficiently and achieve better results. We also provide data management services and work closely with manufacturers and distributors to expand market reach and improve dealer performance through a unified sales enablement platform.

ac7afc8f52ef2485fbc4.title: Customer Experience Rep I
ac7afc8f52ef2485fbc4.description:
Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world's health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient's request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.  
  
By joining Datavant today, you're stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

**What We're Looking For:**

Datavant's **Customer Experience Representative I – Retrieval** supports Record Hub customers by responding to inquiries, resolving standard issues, and providing accurate information in a high-volume, fast-paced environment. This role focuses on delivering a consistent, high-quality customer experience while building product knowledge and customer support skills.

**What You Will Do:**

* Maintain a positive, empathetic, and professional attitude toward customers at all times.
* Respond promptly to customer inquiries in a high call volume, fast-paced environment following established processes and guidelines.
* Interact with customers via telephone, email, and online chat to answer product-related questions, resolve standard issues, and provide basic education on Record Hub services.
* Accurately document customer interactions, inquiries, issues, and resolutions in designated systems.
* Identify issues that require additional expertise and appropriately escalate to senior representatives or specialists.
* Make outbound telephone and email contacts to customers to provide updates, education, and support issue resolution.
* Follow defined workflows, scripts, and quality standards to ensure consistency and compliance.
* Communicate and coordinate with colleagues and team leads as needed to support customer needs.
* Actively participate in training, coaching, and feedback sessions to build product knowledge and customer service skills.
* Provide feedback on customer experience challenges and opportunities for improvement.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**What Helps You Stand Out:**

* Strong communication skills, including active listening and clear verbal and written communication.
* Customer-focused mindset with the ability to remain calm and professional when addressing questions or concerns.
* Basic problem-solving skills with a willingness to ask questions and learn.
* Comfort using multiple computer systems and learning new software tools.
* Attention to detail and ability to follow established processes.
* Familiarity with ticketing systems or call center tools is a plus.

  

**What You Need to Succeed:**

* High school diploma, general education degree, or equivalent required.
* **2–3 years of customer service experience** required.
* **1 year of experience in a call center or customer support environment** preferred.
* Experience using call center phone systems such as RingCentral is a plus.
* Data entry and typing skills of 30 WPM or higher.

To ensure the safety of patients and staff, many of our clients require post-offer health screenings and proof and/or completion of various vaccinations such as the flu shot, Tdap, COVID-19, etc. Any requests to be exempted from these requirements will be reviewed by Datavant Human Resources and determined on a case-by-case basis. Depending on the state in which you will be working, exemptions may be available on the basis of disability, medical contraindications to the vaccine or any of its components, pregnancy or pregnancy-related medical conditions, and/or religion.
  
  
This job is not eligible for employment sponsorship.  
  
Datavant is committed to a work environment free from job discrimination. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected status. To learn more about our commitment, please review our EEO Commitment Statement here. Know Your Rights, explore the resources available through the EEOC for more information regarding your legal rights and protections. In addition, Datavant does not and will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay.  
  
At the end of this application, you will find a set of voluntary demographic questions. If you choose to respond, your answers will be anonymous and will help us identify areas for improvement in our recruitment process. (We can only see aggregate responses, not individual ones. In fact, we aren't even able to see whether you've responded.) Responding is entirely optional and will not affect your application or hiring process in any way.  
  
Datavant is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you need an accommodation while seeking employment, please request it here, by selecting the 'Interview Accommodation Request' category. You will need your requisition ID when submitting your request, you can find instructions for locating it here. Requests for reasonable accommodations will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis.

  

For more information about how we collect and use your data, please review our Privacy Policy.

0cf088dab45c020c889b.title: Patient Access Specialist III #Full Time #Remote
0cf088dab45c020c889b.description:
**Top Healthcare Provider Network**

The 61st Street Service Corporation, provides administrative and clinical support staff for ***ColumbiaDoctors***. This position will support ColumbiaDoctors, one of the largest multi-specialty practices in the Northeast. ColumbiaDoctors’ practices comprise an experienced group of more than 2,800 physicians, surgeons, dentists, and nurses, offering more than 240 specialties and subspecialties.

**Job Summary:**

The Patient Access Specialist III provides support to the Columbia West Campus sphere that is part of a system wide access center managing large volumes of inquiries and requests from patients and customers for access/assistance in scheduling diagnostic services, physician referral/appointments, and general information on ColumbiaDoctors. The Patient Access Specialist III is a lead role that supports, guides and mentors Patient Access Specialists and serves at the heart of the contact center acting as the front door to patient care.

**Job Responsibilities**:

* Greets patients and answer telephone calls.
* Schedule appointment requests.
* Communicate insurance participation, financial responsibility and time of service policy.
* Obtain insurance/demographic information and ensure all obtained information is registered in EPIC.
* Perform real-time insurance verification and inform patient of insurance requirements for services provided.
* Collect pre-registration information to address outstanding Epic work queue accounts.
* Perform outbound calls to perform Epic referral scheduling.
* Provide support and back-up coverage as needed.
* General faxing, filing, and mail sorting.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.
* Resolve escalated insurance related cases and escalate issue for resolution when appropriate. Conduct investigations, collect information and document issues.
* Facilitate team discussions about complex patient scheduling needs. Communicate with management team and care providers to resolve scheduling issues.
* Train/coach new and established Patient Access Specialists on scheduling protocols.
* Identify Specialists that need additional coaching or training.
* Assist management with day-to-day activities relating to process problems/changes, inter-department communication receiving of feedback, and adjusting workflow.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes and make recommendations to management.
* Work on escalated cases with higher complexity as assigned.

**Job Qualifications**:

* High School Diploma or the equivalent required.
* Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience including proficiency in medical terminology. The incumbent must demonstrate a strong proficiency in a wide range of scheduling complexity and related workflows.
* Advanced customer service skills and problem assessment.
* Ability and/or past experience in leading and influencing teams and/or team building skills.
* Intermediate proficiency of Microsoft Office (Word & Excel) or similar software is required.
* Associate's Degree or higher preferred.
* Prior high volume customer service experience in a call center environment is preferred.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) a plus

**Hourly Rate Ranges: $31.37 - $36.65**

Note: Our salary offers will fall within these ranges based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to experience, skill set, training and education.

**61st Street Service Corporation**

At 61st Street Service Corporation we are committed to providing our client with excellent customer service while maintaining a productive environment for all employees. The Service Corporation offers a competitive comprehensive Benefit package to eligible employees; including Healthcare and various other benefits including Paid Time off to promote a healthy lifestyle.

We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we adhere to all requirements of all applicable federal, state, and local civil rights laws.

**Job Description:**

**Patient Care Representative**

At Elara Caring, we care where you are and believe the best place for your care is where you live. We know there’s no place like home, and that’s why our teams continue to provide high-quality care to more than 60,000 patients each day in their preferred home setting. Wherever our patients call home and wherever they are on their health journey, we care. Each team member has a part to play in this mission. This means you have countless ways to make a difference as the Patient Care Representative. Being a part of something this great, starts by carrying out our mission every day through your true calling: developing an amazing team of compassionate and dedicated healthcare providers.

To continue to be an industry pioneer delivering unparalleled care, we need a Patient Care Representative with commitment and compassion. Are you one of them? If so, apply today!

**Why Join the Elara Caring mission?**

* Work in a collaborative environment.
* Be rewarded with a unique opportunity to make a difference
* Competitive compensation package
* Tuition reimbursement for full-time staff and continuing education opportunities for all employees at no cost
* Opportunities for advancement
* Comprehensive insurance plans for medical, dental, and vision benefits
* 401(K) with employer match
* Paid time off, paid holidays, family, and pet bereavement
* Pet insurance

**As the Patient Care Representative, you’ll contribute to our success in the following ways:**

* Conducts phone calls on a daily basis, communicating with prior patients in assigned territory to follow-up on health status and potential changes in condition warranting additional services.
* Actively works to connect patients with appropriate internal team members based on patient needs and requests, including but not limited to skilled care, personal care, hospice care, ElaraConnect personnel or others as appropriate.
* Answers all inquiries regarding enterprise services and provides appropriate information.
* Collaborates with Patient Care Specialists for leads identified in assigned market territory.
* Collaborates with Patient Care Specialists and service line operators to resolve issues related to Check-In operations, including connection issues with prior patients and overall program utilization.
* Remains current on virtual customer relations trends and innovations to meet the needs of the customers.
* Assists in evaluating agency operations and systems and identifies ways to enhance workflow and productivity.
* Participates in clinical record audits, utilization reviews and Peer Review and Quality Improvement programs.
* Attends training, education, seminars, or other means of learning.
* Notifies supervisor of any problems requiring administrative attention and intervention.
* Processes all data entry information accurately into appropriate company systems.
* Participates in weekends and/or holidays, as assigned.

**What is Required?**

* High School Diploma/GED
* 1+ year experience in a home health care setting preferred
* Knowledge of Medical Terminology
* Proficiency with MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook)
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

You will report to the **Program Supervisor.**

*The base rate for this position is $17.00-$19.00 hourly and is based on the company’s good faith estimate at the time of posting. Actual pay will be determined based on factors such as education, experience, skills, and internal equity.*

We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.

**Job Summary**

Summary  
Under direction, receives incoming communication and online requests from both patients and referring providers interested in accessing care. Performs patient registration, and scheduling processes. Ensures that patients, referring providers and other customers receive timely, efficient and high-quality service.  
  
Does this position require Patient Care?  
No  
  
Essential Functions  

* Coordinates the registration and scheduling for new patient appointments.

  

* Documents all patient demographic, medical, financial, and referral information into the computer in strict compliance with established department procedures for the purpose of getting a hospital registration number and scheduling an appointment.

  

* Answers telephone, triages calls, and takes accurate and detailed messages using professional and courteous customer service techniques.

  

* Provides basic information and instructions to patients regarding the practice and Hospitals across the enterprise.

  

* Obtains all patient information required by the providers prior to an appointment. Ensures that the medical records are available to all health care providers.

  

* Completely and accurately transcribes call, referral and scheduling information in multiple systems.

  

* Provides excellent customer service to both internal and external customers of the Mass General Brigham Hospitals and ambulatory practices; supports ongoing communication and provides service recovery when needed with patients and referring physicians.

  

* Maintains confidentiality and privacy consistent with HIPAA guidelines.

**Qualifications**

Education High School Diploma or Equivalent required Can this role accept experience in lieu of a degree? Remote

At Mass General Brigham, we believe in recognizing and rewarding the unique value each team member brings to our organization. **Mass General Brigham Competency Framework**
---------------------------------------------

The framework is comprised of ten competencies (half People-Focused, half Performance-Focused) and are defined by observable and measurable skills and behaviors that contribute to workplace effectiveness and career success. These competencies are used to evaluate performance, make hiring decisions, identify development needs, mobilize employees across our system, and establish a strong talent pipeline.

a968a68a9ea99668e017.description:
**Description**

FT Customer Support Specialist- Remote

Ideal candidate will reside in Columbus, OH, Pittsburgh, PA, Akron, OH, Erie, PA, or Cincinnati, OH areas

Interim HealthCare has a team focused on patient care through after hour calls to support our entire five state franchise (Indiana, Kentucky, Ohio, Pennsylvania, and West Virginia). We an opening available for:

FT, 40 hours a week, Monday- Friday 4:45pm-12:45am, Sat (8am-8pm) and Sun (10am-12:30pm) & every other weekend off.

Our Customer Support Specialist has been called to care in their own unique way. As part of the Interim HealthCare's Customer Support Center team, you will provide positive customer experiences by answering incoming calls, after hours, in a timely and efficient manner to support operations throughout the company.

What we offer our Customer Support Specialist:

Competitive pay up to $19 per hour and benefits

Remote position

Daily Pay Option Available

Excited to hear more? Apply Below.

Working at Interim HealthCare means a career unlike any other. With integrity at the center of all we do, we know that when we support you and your community, you'll change lives every day.

As a Customer Support Specialist, you will:

Actively listen and probe callers in a professional and timely manner to determine purpose of the calls.

Respond to customer queries in a timely and accurate way, via phone, email or chat.

Provide swift, thorough, friendly, and effective customer service to all internal and external customers, remaining focused on creating great customer experience.

Resolve issues by clarifying the customer's concern, determining the cause of the problem, selecting and explaining the best solution to solve the problem, and expediting correction or adjustment

Have access to personal health information ("PHI") necessary to fulfill the above duties and responsibilities. Access to use and ability to disclose PHI is further defined by each organization/department.

Effectively work with others and promote teamwork to generate positive and creative results.

To qualify for a Customer Support Specialist with us, you will need:

High school diploma

One (1) year experience in customer service

Ability to multi-task, work under pressure with changing priorities and short deadlines, and effectively handle a heavy workload.

Ability to effectively communicate, both orally and in writing, with clinical and non-clinical personnel.

Proficient in software programs and be able to navigate between computer systems.

Ability to sit in front of computer for long periods of time.

Travel is required for training

At Interim HealthCare, our patients deserve the very best – that's why we focus on each individual's needs in the comfort and dignity of their home. Through nursing, personal care, therapy, case management, and countless specialized services, we bring quality care where it's needed most. We're called to care so that family members can be just that.

We're an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

#RMC

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

4359d0af4fd36cc19eaa.description:
About BioHealth Wellness

BioHealth Wellness is a growing healthcare company focused on personalized wellness, regenerative medicine, and longevity programs. Our mission is to provide safe, research-based healthcare while delivering an exceptional patient experience.

We are looking for an experienced, motivated, and highly organized **Patient Case Manager** to join our remote team.

This position combines patient relationship management, payment collection, scheduling, and customer retention. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator who knows how to build trust, navigate difficult conversations, and take ownership of the patient experience.

What You'll Do

**Patient Payments & Retention**

* Contact enrolled patients to collect outstanding balances and coordinate payments.
* Confidently discuss payment arrangements and financing options.
* Address patient concerns, objections, and potential cancellations professionally.
* Build strong patient relationships to help maintain confidence and program commitment.
* Follow up consistently on outstanding payments and unresolved issues.
* Maintain accurate documentation of payments, patient conversations, and follow-up activities.

**Patient Onboarding & Coordination**

* Welcome newly enrolled patients and guide them through their next steps.
* Explain the patient journey, including medical reviews, scheduling, treatment preparation, and follow-up.
* Coordinate patient appointments with medical providers and scheduling teams.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for patient questions and concerns.
* Proactively communicate with patients to ensure a smooth, organized experience.
* Maintain accurate patient information and documentation in our CRM.
* Work closely with internal departments to resolve patient issues efficiently.

What We're Looking For

* Minimum 2 years of experience in customer service, patient coordination, collections, account management, or customer retention.
* Excellent verbal communication and telephone skills.
* Comfortable discussing high-value healthcare programs and collecting significant outstanding balances.
* Strong objection-handling, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage difficult conversations with empathy and professionalism.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple patients simultaneously.
* Self-motivated, dependable, and accountable while working remotely.
* Comfortable learning and using CRM systems, scheduling software, and communication platforms.
* Ability to follow established processes while taking initiative to resolve problems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in healthcare, wellness, medical practices, or patient financing.
* Background in payment collections, customer retention, or high-ticket customer service.
* Experience handling cancellation requests and resolving customer complaints.
* Previous experience in a fast-paced remote position.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role?

You are someone who:

* Takes ownership instead of waiting for instructions.
* Is persistent with follow-up without being aggressive.
* Can confidently ask for payment while maintaining a positive patient relationship.
* Remains calm and professional when patients are upset.
* Is extremely organized and follows through on commitments.
* Genuinely cares about helping patients have a positive experience.
* Enjoys working toward measurable performance goals.

Position Details

* **Schedule:** Full-Time
* **Location:** Remote
* **Compensation:** Based on experience
* **Industry:** Healthcare / Wellness / Regenerative Medicine

Apply Today

If you are an excellent communicator who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys helping patients, and has the confidence to manage payments and challenging conversations, we would love to hear from you.

Join BioHealth Wellness and help us deliver an exceptional patient experience.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $15.00 - $18.00 per hour

* How would you rate your ability to speak clearly and compassionately with patients over the phone?
* What is your desired hourly rate to start this role?

* Have you ever worked in concierge medicine, telehealth, regenerative medicine, or elective/cash-based healthcare? If yes, please explain.
* Are you currently working, if so, how soon can you start?
* Are you tech-savvy and comfortable using multiple platforms (EHR, CRM, task tracker) daily? Please explain.

Experience:

* Regenerative Medicine: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: Remote

5a8cdfc318c1cf44e783.title: Lead Logistics Coordinator
5a8cdfc318c1cf44e783.description:
At Curaleaf, we're redefining the cannabis industry with a strong commitment to quality, expertise, and innovation. As a leading global cannabis provider, our brands—including Curaleaf, Select, and Grassroots—offer premium products and services in both medical and adult-use markets.

Join us at Curaleaf to be part of a high-growth, purpose-driven company that champions corporate social responsibility through our *Rooted in Good* initiative, supporting community outreach and positive change. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, drive innovation, and help shape the future of cannabis.

**Lead Logistics Coordinator**

**Job Type: Full Time; Non-Exempt**  
**Shift: Monday - Friday, 7AM to 3:30PM**  
**Location: Hammonton, NJ**  
**Hourly Rate: $24.00 Per Hour**

**Who You Are:**

TheLead Logistics Coordinator is responsible for leading the planning, organization, execution, and follow-up of daily delivery route assignments to ensure internal and external customers are serviced in a compliant, on-time and in-full capacity and that acceptable levels are maintained for driver safety, best-in-class customer service, efficiency, and cost. Ensures the accurate and timely completion of manifests and continuous communication to sales partners is maintained. Oversees the loading and unloading of fleet vehicles and receives and processes product returns. Measures and analyzes key department metrics including route efficiency, mileage, and fuel costs. Also responsible for partnering with peripheral teams (Packaging, Order Fulfillment, Vault operations) to meet planned team objectives.

**What You Will Do:**

  

**Planning, Data & Analysis**

* + Participate in the coordination and execution of order fulfillment
  + Work directly with the Packaging Team(s), Sales Team, and Delivery Team(s)
  + Develop delivery schedules and route plans utilizing historical and future-looking data and to seek opportunities to enhance customer service and to reduce operating costs
  + Maintain strict and compliant inventory records of all inbound and outbound products
  + Perform basic inventory and miscellaneous data analysis as needed
  + Monitor schedule adherence, productivity, customer service, product integrity and safety performance of each route and delivery team
  + Log delivery data and perform delivery cycle recaps (route/drop efficiency, mileage, fuel costs, revenue per drop, etc.)
  + Using core metrics and key performance indicator data, achieve department quantity, quality, and productivity objectives

**Logistics & Scheduling**

* + Lead and understand all delivery logistics operations to include sales order review, route planning and communication
  + Coordinates order staging with the fulfillment team
  + Ensures transport vehicles are loaded and unloaded daily
  + Maintains timely communication to sales partners regarding deliveries, manifests, questions, and product returns
  + Maintain, adapt, and improve upon delivery times and schedules to maximize resources and minimize cost
  + Create, revise and publish delivery manifests
  + Utilize available tools to enhance the delivery experience
  + Analyze routing parameters and location geography and recommend enhancements to initiate fleet cost savings
  + Serve in an on-call capacity during delivery cycles working early, late, or extended hours to remain available to customers, stakeholders, and the delivery team(s)
  + Review customer demand volume and mix for routes and determine potential gains from revising routes

**Communication**

* + Ensures timely dispatch of communications of routes/schedules to the Fulfillment Team, Delivery Team(s), Sales Team, partners, and to the DOH
  + Coordinate daily communications between the facility, Delivery Team(s), and the DOH
  + Participate in communication between departments regarding movement of inventory, returns, and deliveries
  + Update metrics and distribute reports as needed
  + Participate in collaborative conference calls and sales meetings as needed to address routing and distribution issues
  + Support communication to the state with critical revisions and updates
  + Utilize communication tools (walkie-talkies, email, phone, company portals) to promote an effective interdepartmental workflow
  + Communicate planned vs. actual results and set the pace for the team

**Computing/Software**

* + Proficient with Microsoft Office (especially Excel) and Google Maps
  + Learn and use various transportation and inventory tracking systems including MJ Freeway.
  + Support and maintain proficiency with inventory tracking and recordkeeping functions with the state seed-to-sale e-system MJ Freeway remaining in compliance with the Department of Health's rules and regulations.

**Inventory Control**

* + Learn and manage the Supply Chain functions in MJ Freeway
  + Ensure inventory transactions are entered expeditiously and with statuses updated
  + Track movement of finished packaged cannabis products through to completion of delivery
  + Participate in inventory cycle counting
  + Review, receive and process product returns adding inventory to MJ Freeway and internal databases
  + Receive and intake dispensary returns, third party items, vault consumables, etc. and maintain visual organization
  + Assist in destruction and tracking of dispensary returns
  + Perform unit count conversions, combinations, and adjustments to meet order fulfillment requirements and organizational/storage needs

**Compliance**

* + Learn and maintain continual awareness and understanding of rules and regulations determined by the law and by the DOH, and ensure department remains fully compliant at all times
  + Report required information to the Compliance Department, Packaging Department, and to the DOH as necessary
  + Follow standard operating procedures (SOP) for all operations, ensuring adherence to company and regulatory compliance (proper weighing, data recording, product tracking, security, green waste disposal, etc.
  + Ensure that all product and orders are compliant to include packaging and required batch and content labeling
  + Maintain security protocols are maintained during delivery cycles

**Administrative**

* + Maintain accurate and compliant internal records of documents/workbooks including schedules, invoices, manifests, vehicle information, and returns
  + Perform administrative duties such as data entry, data transmitting, phone answering, communication drafting, etc.

**Maintenance**

* + Schedule emergency and regular maintenance and repairs to ensure vehicles are safe, compliant, and roadworthy
  + Coordinate and/or perform fleet operator-level maintenance
  + Ensure vehicles are cleaned, sanitized and ready for use
  + Maintain awareness of vehicle conditions and status of critical documentation such as registration and safety inspection
  + Maintains and updates service records internally and in MJ Freeway
  + Monitor and maintain vehicle storage spaces and climate controls to ensure product integrity is maintained

**Process Improvement**

* + Serve as a proponent for critical continuous improvement, quality and occupational safety initiatives such as the 5S program and Hazard Communication
  + Perform quality audits and "ride alongs" to seek process improvement opportunities
  + Maintain 5S and sanitation standards (safety, organization, cleanliness, and compliance) within the van loading and order staging spaces
  + Ensure daily/weekly/monthly 5S and Sanitation Schedules are completed properly and on time. Serve as a champion for sanitation and bio-security
  + Train and coach team members in accordance with SOP, work instructions, process controls, etc.
  + Conduct performance gap analysis and identify obstacles to success (forms of waste, variation, etc.)
  + Participate in delivery calls and communicate with dispensary customers and driving teams to troubleshoot discrepancies and mitigate common errors
  + Engage in honest, innovative, problem solving dialogue
  

**What You Will Bring:**

* High school diploma or general education degree (GED)
* Solid organizational skills with keen attention to detail and accuracy
* Willingness to tackle complex order fulfillment problems or complications to ensure proper support for our wholesale partners
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Proficient computing skills including basic operating system knowledge, file organization, and general security best practices
* Innate desire to achieve success and a work ethic to match
* Ability to critically think and problem solve without direction
* High level of integrity and honesty
* Strong mathematical skills that include the ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs
* Reasoning Ability:Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry our instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form. Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations

**Even Better If:**

* You have 1 year of experience in a fast-paced order fulfillment or warehouse environment
* You have prior experience using Excel in a professional setting

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to lift up to 50 pounds unassisted
* Ability to stand and walk for long periods of time
* Ability to climb ladders or crawl under low spaces
* Ability to use computer and look at a screen for long periods of time
* Ability to have close vision (read small print at 20 inches or less)

**What We Offer:**

* Career Growth Opportunities
* Competitive Pay and Benefits
* Generous PTO and Parental Leave
* 401(K) Retirement Plan
* Life/ Disability Insurance
* Community Involvement
* Referral Bonuses and Product Discounts

*Benefits vary by state, role type, and eligibility.*

**Job Description:**

**Now Hiring: Client Service Specialist**

**Sterling Limousine | Full-Time, In-Office Position**

**About Sterling Limousine**

Sterling Limousine is a luxury transportation company dedicated to providing exceptional service to corporate clients, private travelers, and special-event customers. We operate in a fast-paced environment where communication, accuracy, teamwork, and attention to detail are essential to delivering an outstanding client experience.

We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented **Client Service Specialist** **reservation experience** to join our growing team. The ideal candidate is comfortable managing a high volume of phone calls and emails, handling reservations and pricing inquiries, and using multiple software platforms to keep daily operations running smoothly.

**Position Details**

**· Schedule:** Full-time, 40 hours per week

**· Compensation:** $22.00–$24.00 per hour, depending on experience

**· Training Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM

**· Hours**: Work hours will be scheduled based on business needs and employee availability upon successful completion of the training program.

**· Hours of Operation:** 7:00 AM–10:00 PM

**· Work Location:** In-office only — remote work is not available

**Key Responsibilities**

· Handle a high volume of inbound telephone calls regarding transportation reservations, pricing, quotes, and general client inquiries.

· Monitor, prioritize, and respond promptly to a high volume of inbound emails related to quotes, reservations, and client requests.

· Create, update, and maintain reservations with exceptional accuracy and attention to detail.

· Assist the dispatch department with overflow calls and communication as needed.

· Confirm upcoming transportation assignments and verify that all reservation details are complete and accurate.

· Coordinate special-event transportation details, ensuring all necessary information and instructions are collected and documented in advance.

· Utilize multiple software platforms and technological tools to manage reservations, communications, and daily workflows.

· Provide professional, courteous, and solution-oriented client support throughout the reservation process.

· Collaborate with reservations, dispatch, and other departments to ensure a seamless client experience.

**Qualifications & Skills**

**· Previous limousine, chauffeured transportation, or ground transportation reservation experience is strongly preferred.**

**· Hospitality experience is also a plus.**

· Proven customer service experience, including professional telephone support and client communication.

· Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

· Ability to learn, understand, and confidently navigate multiple software systems and technology platforms.

· Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and general computer applications.

· Ability to manage competing priorities, multitask effectively, and remain composed under pressure in a fast-paced environment.

· Impeccable attention to detail, organization, and follow-through.

· Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently while contributing to a team.

· Dependable, professional, adaptable, and committed to providing exceptional customer service.

**Benefits**

0848e25bae5c212e2dc2.description:
**JOB TITLE:** Territory Manager

**LOCATION:** Bay Area, CA (Field-based; Requires extensive travel)

**REPORTS TO:** Regional Operations Manager

**The Company:**

Sunbit is a top ranked financial technology company headquartered in Los Angeles, California, revolutionizing how people manage everyday expenses with its cutting-edge Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution.

Trusted by over 30,000 locations nationwide—with a strong presence in dental practices and automotive dealerships (where more than 1 out of 2 dealerships are offering Sunbit)—Sunbit makes essential services more accessible, affordable, and convenient.

Founded in 2016, Sunbit has become the fastest, simplest, and most inclusive financing solution tailored for auto dealership service centers. By offering flexible payment options, Sunbit empowers service teams to complete more approved repair orders and ease the financial burden on customers—helping people say “yes” to the maintenance and repairs they need, when they need them.

Sunbit’s impact and innovation have been widely recognized. The company was named to the Inc. 5000 list in both 2022 and 2023, and has earned accolades such as Most Loved Workplace®, Best Point of Sale Company, and Top Fintech Startup by CB Insights. Sunbit is also featured on CB Insights' list of Unicorn Startup Companies, with a valuation of $1.1 billion. (Source: CB Insights Unicorn List)

With proven product to market fit and rapid success across thousands of merchants and millions of customers, Sunbit is expanding its Account Management team. This is a unique opportunity to join a high-performance, high-growth company that’s redefining how people pay for essential services—and helping our partners deliver more of them.

**﻿The Role:**

**﻿**At Sunbit, we help dental practices serve more patients every day by making the financing experience simpler, faster, and more accessible. As a Territory Manager, you will own a defined book of business and act as the strategic driver behind its growth.

This is not a cold-calling or hunting role. It is a highly consultative, sales-led account management position where you will partner deeply with practices, influence adoption behavior, and guide them toward meaningful, measurable outcomes.

You will become the expert on each practice’s business, uncover growth opportunities through strong discovery, and use data to drive performance.

You’ll work closely with DSOs, office managers, clinical teams, and internal Sunbit partners to ensure sustained success, helping to grow Sunbit to the #1 patient financing solution for dental practices across the US.

  
Requirements:  
  

**What You'll Own:**

* **﻿**Own and grow a defined book of business across dental practices and DSOs, driving consistent increases in Sunbit adoption, application velocity, and loan volume.
* Build trusted, long-term relationships with key decision makers: practice owners, DSOs, office managers, treatment coordinators, and front-office teams.
* Lead recurring performance reviews (monthly, quarterly) using practice data to highlight wins, uncover opportunities, and align on plans for growth.
* Deliver high-impact training and coaching for office teams to improve financial presentation skills, Sunbit workflows, and overall patient conversion.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Partner Success Managers, the Training Manager, Marketing, and Operations to support practice performance and execute territory strategies.
* Execute territory plans including routing, visit cadence, segmentation, and prioritized account focus based on performance trends.
* Maintain disciplined CRM management (activity, notes, scheduling, account planning) to support forecasting and business visibility.
* Share critical field insights (market trends, competitive intel, partner needs) with leadership to shape product enhancements and go-to-market strategy.
* Represent Sunbit with professionalism and expertise, always focused on helping practices serve more patients through responsible financing solutions.

**﻿What You'll Bring:**

* **﻿**3+ years in field sales, account management, or DSO/practice consulting in the dental industry (highly preferred), medical, healthcare, or other in-office services.
* 3+ years managing a territory and book of business across dental practices and DSOs.
* Demonstrated track record of growing existing accounts through strong relationships, training, data-driven performance conversations, and strategic influence.
* Experience coaching front-line staff and managers, preferably in a workflow-driven or technology-enabled environment.
* Strong business acumen and comfort with performance metrics, including conversion trends, account segmentation, and revenue planning.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills; confident leading trainings, business reviews, and group discussions.
* Highly organized with strong time-management, pipeline planning, and territory routing skills.
* A self-motivated, proactive, high-ownership mindset — someone who thrives in a dynamic, fast-growing environment.
* Willingness to travel 50%+ (overnights included).
* Mastery of productivity tools (PowerPoint, Excel, CRM systems)

**﻿Why Choose Sunbit?**

Sunbit is recognized as one of the fastest-growing and most admired fintech companies, earning honors from Inc. 5000 (four consecutive years), Forbes Fintech 50, Deloitte Technology Fast 500, Financial Times, and FinTech Breakthrough for its innovation and impact. The company has also been featured among Newsweek’s Most Loved Workplaces and CB Insights’ Unicorn Companies, reflecting a valuation of $1.1B.

People choose Sunbit for its people-first culture rooted in service, inclusion, and real-world impact. Powered by AI that helps people in life’s critical moments—offering high approvals, speed, and zero fees—Sunbit has achieved proven scale across tens of thousands of merchants and millions of transactions. Its fast, fair, and simple financial products empower consumers and partners alike through clarity and trust.

**﻿The Perks:**

* Join one of LA’s fastest growing startups (2023), A Most Loved Workplace, #576 on the 2023 Inc 5000 list, and Forbes Fintech 50 (2024), #161 on Deloitte Technology Fast 500 list
* Mission driven + empowered + collaborative
* Competitive pay and stock options
* Unlimited PTO
* Health Insurance options including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, EAP, FSA, & Maternity Leave
* Newly added HSA and Pet Insurance
* 401K Plan with Matching
* Cell Phone Stipend

**How We Pay:**

* We believe in paying fairly and equitably based on a number of factors including but not limited to previous experience, relevant work history, interview performance, geographical location, internal equity, and expected level of ownership.
* We are targeting a base salary of $110k-140k per year for this role. This role is eligible for commission/ bonus in addition to the base salary
* This role will also be granted company equity via stock options

*Sunbit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We strive to provide a professional & welcoming workplace for all employees.*

**﻿Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer**

We’ve been made aware of fraudsters impersonating Sunbit employees during the hiring process. Please note that all official communication will come from an @sunbit.com email address, through our applicant tracking platform @sunbit.comeet-notifications.com or directly via LinkedIn. We will never ask for your age, Social Security number, bank account details, payment of any kind, or other unrelated personal information during the application process. Our hiring process always includes interviews, either by phone, zoom, or in person, before any offer is made. If something feels suspicious, please contact us at hr@sunbit.com to confirm. We ask that you contact hr@sunbit.com only about potential instances of fraud. hr@sunbit.com does not reach our recruiting team directly. Your application directly through the posting is the best way to ensure that your candidacy is reviewed by our team. Due to the volume of applications, we will not respond to nor forward emails about your candidacy that are sent to hr@sunbit.com directly, and your email about your application will be deleted from our systems.

As a Senior Executive Assistant in GitLab's Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) organization, you'll support the VP, Global Solution Architects and the VP, High Velocity Sales & Sales Development. 177de92045a3c67b9e37.description:
**BH Job ID:**5450

  
  

**SF Job Req ID:**21234

  

Ingersoll Rand is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

**Job title:** Customer Service Representative
  
**Location:** Ivyland, PA – Onsite

**About Us**
  
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

**Job Overview**
  
The Customer Service Representative supports the Milton Roy team in Ivyland by processing orders, assisting customers, and coordinating order flow within a manufacturing environment. This onsite position provides customers with accurate information about pricing, product availability, order status, and delivery schedules.
  
The Customer Service Representative will partner with Sales, Production, Planning, Application Engineering, Supply Chain, and Finance to resolve customer concerns and support timely order fulfillment. Candidates should bring professional communication, computer proficiency, attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities while following safety, quality, and operating procedures.

**Responsibilities**

• Process and manage daily customer orders and business transactions, reviewing information for accuracy and compliance before entry.
  

* Monitor order progress and coordinate with Planning and Production to communicate delivery dates, address delays, and accommodate urgent requests.
* Respond to customer inquiries regarding pricing, availability, product details, and order status.
* Process claims, product returns, and cancellation requests, coordinating with customers, suppliers, and internal teams as needed.
* Resolve customer complaints and assist Finance with investigating customer disputes.
* Maintain clear communication between customers, Sales, Supply Chain, Operations, and other internal teams.
* Complete tracking logs and order documentation accurately, record issues, and update standard work procedures as needed.
* Participate in cross-functional discussions to identify process improvements and support customer service, production, and quality objectives.
* Participate in customer service, product, and monthly environmental, health, and safety training.
* Follow applicable ISO requirements, company policies, safety procedures, and 5S practices to maintain a safe and organized work environment.

**Requirements**

• High school diploma or GED.
  

* At least one year of customer service experience.
* Order entry system and data entry skills.
* Proficient computer skills, including navigating business applications and using Microsoft Outlook, Word, and Excel.

**Core Competencies**

• Customer Service: Ability to understand customer needs, respond professionally, and follow through on requests.
  

* Communication: Ability to provide clear, accurate updates to customers and internal teams.
* Accuracy and Documentation: Ability to review information, enter orders, and maintain complete records with attention to detail.
* Organization and Time Management: Ability to prioritize orders, inquiries, and urgent requests while maintaining productivity.
* Problem Solving: Ability to investigate concerns, identify practical solutions, and escalate issues appropriately.
* Conflict Resolution: Ability to address customer complaints calmly and work toward a resolution.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to coordinate with Sales, Production, Planning, Engineering, Finance, and other teams.
* Accountability and Integrity: Ability to follow established procedures, meet commitments, and handle customer and business information responsibly.

**Preferences**

* Experience in customer service or order processing within a manufacturing environment.
* Familiarity with JD Edwards or a similar order management or enterprise resource planning system.
* Experience coordinating delivery updates, product returns, claims, or customer billing inquiries.

**Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements**

• This is a fully onsite position at the Milton Roy facility in Ivyland, Pennsylvania.
  

* The work environment is a climate-controlled manufacturing plant.
* Protective eyewear and footwear are required.
* Relocation assistance is not available.

**Pay Range**
  
The total pay range for this role, not including incentive opportunities, is $50,000–$65,000. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location. Hired applicants will be eligible to participate in the LIP incentive program with a target of 4%, subject to plan terms.

**What We Offer**
  
At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment — as well as for our individual well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support needed to take charge of your health and future.
  
Our benefits include healthcare coverage (medical, prescription, dental, and vision), wellness programs, life insurance, a 401(k) plan with company match, paid time off, and an employee stock program, among other offerings. These benefits, combined with our pay transparency and inclusive culture, reflect our commitment to supporting you at work and beyond.

At Milton Roy – Ivyland, we focus on employee appreciation, development, and growth. Our Activities Committee organizes monthly luncheons, birthday and anniversary celebrations, community service opportunities, and team events. We support employee growth through individualized development plans, skills training, internal promotion opportunities, and access to LinkedIn Learning.

Ingersoll Rand Inc. (NYSE:IR), driven by an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset, is dedicated to helping make life better for our employees, customers and communities. Customers lean on us for our technology-driven excellence in mission-critical flow creation and industrial solutions across 40+ respected brands where our products and services excel in the most complex and harsh conditions. Our employees develop customers for life through their daily commitment to expertise, productivity and efficiency. For more information, visit www.IRCO.com.

b1c213be6eb6c58b76c5.description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

Under the direction of the Senior Supervisor, Customer Service, this position performs a range of various clerical and administrative duties in support of the Customer Service team for Western Growers Assurance Trust (WGAT) and Pinnacle Claims Management (PCMI). The Call Center Clerk will aid in the documentation of processes and participate in any project that will benefit the department. This position will also support the customer service team by routing all incoming or outgoing correspondence as well as mail, fax forms, or copy requests as requested by providers or members. This role will also serve as backup for telephone and web-based member/provider inquiries.

**Duties And Responsibilities**
===============================

*Administrative Support*

* Review, respond to, and process daily clerical inquiries received via fax, mail, email, and all general clerical correspondence through telephone or email queues.
* Prescreen claim documents to ensure validation and accuracy prior to processing.
* Cross-reference all claims and correspondence received from new or established providers and members in order to determine accuracy.
* Prepare routine reports and assist the Senior Supervisor with ad hoc projects as assigned.
* Analyze problems and provide information and solutions.
* Assess and report performance in terms of impact, making improvements, and course correcting along the way. Be accountable for helping the Customer Service department.
* Research and resolve aged Customer Service open calls within company standards.
* Develop and maintain positive customer relations and coordinate with various functions within the company to ensure customer requests and questions are handled appropriately and promptly.
* Lead and respond to escalated customer inquiries regarding billing issues.

*Call Center Support*

* Process Customer Service representative form requests.
* Resolve Customer Service Check Tracers by interacting with internal associates/external sources.
* Thoroughly document the routing of claims to examiners and other department inquiries.
* Maintain a status report on all calls referred to other departments, return calls, and/or documentation requests and follow-ups sent to outside sources. This includes making outbound calls, sending messages via internal systems for tracking and continuity, and returning messages.
* Prescreen and process HIPAA requests and verify all required items are submitted accurately.
* Resolve Customer Service Virtual Credit Card (VCC) requests, Stop Pay and Check Tracer Requests.
* Serve as a liaison to the financial transactions department to assist in reconciling overpayments, Stop Pay requests, or returned checks.
* Provide phone backup to the Customer Service department as needed.
* Operate in the Health Care Processing System (HCPS), Imaging systems, and all systems necessary to obtain and extract information. Ensure the accuracy of documentation to maintain HIPAA compliance within these systems.
* Meet and maintain telephone performance measures per Customer Service Performance reports based on department goals and metrics.

*Other*

* Maintain regular attendance per employee handbook guidelines
* Utilize all capabilities to satisfy one mission — to enhance the competitiveness and profitability of our members. Do everything possible to help members succeed by being curious and striving to understand what others are trying to achieve, planning, and executing work helpfully and collaboratively. Be willing to adjust efforts to ensure that work and attitude are helpful to others, be self-accountable, create a positive impact, and be diligent in delivering results.
* Serve as a representative of WGAT and PCMI, displaying professionalism, knowledge, quality customer service, and discretion in all interactions with other members of the WGAT and PCMI community and their customers.
* Maintain internet speed of 40 MB download and 10 MB upload and router with wired Ethernet.
* Maintain a HIPAA-compliant workstation and utilize appropriate security techniques to ensure HIPAA-required protection of all confidential/protected client data.
* Maintain and service safety equipment (e.g., smoke detector, fire extinguisher, first aid kit).
* All other duties as assigned.

**Physical Demands/Work Environment**
=====================================

The physical demands and work environment described here represent those that an employee must meet to successfully perform this job’s essential functions. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to communicate with others. The employee frequently is required to move around the office. The employee is often required to use tools, objects, and controls. This noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

**Qualifications**
==================

* High School diploma or equivalent and two (2) years of experience working as a professional office administrator with a minimum of one (1) year of experience within an inbound call center environment preferred.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Ability to work independently or as part of a team.
* Intermediate knowledge of health insurance claims processing preferred.
* Strong knowledge of general office administrative functions.
* Intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Office programs such as Word, Excel, and Outlook.
* Basic accounting or finance research experience to help manage Check Tracers, Flexible Spending Account (FSA), Health Reimbursement Account (HRA), and Health Savings Account (HSA) accounts.
* Advanced verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong knowledge of Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) rules and regulations to manage requests for account access other than the named account holder.
* Bilingual in Spanish preferred.
* Internet access provided by a cable or fiber provider with 40 MB download and 10 MB upload speeds.
* Home router with wired Ethernet (wireless connections and hotspots are not permitted).
* A designated room for your office or steps taken to protect company information (e.g., facing computer towards wall, etc.)
* A functioning smoke detector, fire extinguisher, and first aid kit on site.

**About CCI**

Complete Compliance, Inc. (CCI), based in Omaha, Nebraska, provides compliance, audit, and information technology consulting services to community banks nationwide. We help financial institutions understand regulatory requirements, strengthen internal programs, manage risk, and prepare for regulatory examinations.

We are seeking an organized, detail-oriented Operations Coordinator to keep client engagements, internal processes, and project workflows organized, current, and moving forward.

**Position Summary**

The Operations Coordinator supports CCI’s audit, compliance, and information technology functions and provides administrative and project coordination support to the Operations & Marketing Manager and President. The role maintains workflow and recordkeeping systems, tracks engagement progress, coordinates projects, supports company publications, and follows organizational priorities from initiation through completion.

The ideal candidate is organized, initiative-taking, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a professional services environment. Candidates should have strong proofreading and communication skills and a willingness to learn banking, compliance, audit, and regulatory concepts.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Audit & Project Coordination**

* Support audit engagement scheduling, prioritization, and deadlines.
* Maintain audit tracking system and engagement status reports.
* Manage audit request lists and document collection processes.
* Organize engagement files and supporting documentation.

**Report Review & Publication Management**

· Review audit reports for formatting, grammar, consistency, completeness, and adherence to established report procedures.

* Track report revisions and review comments.

**Records & Document Management**

* Create and maintain SharePoint and ShareFile engagement folders.
* Manage records retention and engagement archiving.
* Verify documentation is properly retained and organized.

**Tracking & Operational Support**

* Record and track audit data.
* Track engagement metrics, deadlines, and project status.
* Assist management with workload planning and operational reporting.
* Maintain the firm's centralized audit citation database and related reporting.

**Administrative & Executive Support**

* Answer and manage the CCI main telephone line.
* Schedule internal meetings and coordinate logistics.
* Provide administrative, project, and operational support to the Operations & Marketing Manager and the President.
* Assist with executive reporting, special projects, and workflow initiatives.
* Support operational improvement efforts across the organization.
* Coordinate conference registrations and event logistics.
* Assist with training administration and continuing education tracking.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Minimum of 2 years of administrative, operations, executive support, or project coordination experience.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
* High attention to detail.
* Exceptional proofreading, editing, and document formatting skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, SharePoint, and Teams.
* Ability to manage multiple deadlines with minimal supervision.

**Preferred**

* Experience working in banking, financial services, accounting, consulting, legal, or professional services industries.
* Experience with CRM systems and project tracking software.
* Familiarity with QuickBooks.
* Experience supporting multiple team members and managing workflows.

**Why Join CCI?**

* Collaborative, team-oriented culture.
* Meaningful work supporting community banks.
* Opportunity to make an immediate impact on organizational efficiency and client service.
* Direct exposure to executive leadership.
* Opportunity to develop project management, audit administration, publication management, and business operations skills.

Parking Management Company (PMC) is a national leader in hospitality-focused parking services. Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, PMC provides valet and self-parking management, shuttle services, event parking, and porter/bell services across multiple industries including hotels, resorts, healthcare, and event venues. With a commitment to excellence and a guest-first mindset, PMC serves as an extension of the hospitality experience—delivering seamless, high-touch service to partners and guests alike. Learn more: ParkingMgt.com
  
  
Assistant Valet Account Manager - [City]
  
  
**Location:** Multiple hospitality properties in [City]
  
**Department:** Valet Parking Division
  
**Schedule:** Full-time; Schedule may include evenings, weekends, holidays, and other hours based on operational needs
  
**Classification:** Exempt, subject to confirmation that the position satisfies all applicable salary and duties requirements
  
**Annual Salary:** $[X.XX] per year
  
Or
  
**Annual Base Salary Range:** $[XX,XXX]–$[XX,XXX]
  
  
**How to Apply:** Submit your application through Indeed or by visiting ParkingMgmt.com/joinpmc
  
**Application Deadline:** Until Filled
  
  
Pay Transparency and Equal Pay
  
The posted base-pay rate or range is a good-faith estimate of the wage or salary PMC reasonably expects to pay upon hire for this position and listed work location. Starting pay will be within the posted range based on relevant experience, Qualifications, and property assignment. The range covers the expected starting rates at all properties included in this posting.
  
  
PMC supports legally protected compensation discussions and prohibits retaliation for exercising those rights. PMC does not request or use salary history in hiring or pay decisions except as permitted by applicable law.
  
  
Position Summary
  
The Assistant Account Manager supports the Account Manager in the daily operation of an assigned valet account. Responsibilities include guest service, staff hiring and development, operational supervision, revenue controls, payroll review, claims prevention, and safety. The role provides hands-on shift support as needed, including safe vehicle parking and retrieval, while maintaining strong relationships with associates and client contacts.
  
  
Duties and Responsibilities
  
  

* Coordinate daily valet operations, including safe vehicle parking and retrieval, secure key handling, and hands-on shift support. Reinforce safety procedures to help prevent vehicle damage and associate injuries.
* Assist with interviewing, hiring, onboarding, and required training. Coach associates, develop future leaders, and promote teamwork and internal advancement.
* Monitor guest service and uniform standards, provide performance feedback, and administer fair, documented progressive discipline under the Account Manager’s guidance.
* Communicate with associates and client contacts, resolve guest and operational concerns, and use feedback to improve service and support account retention.
* Audit weekly timecards, clock punches, reported tips, minimum wage adjustments, and vehicle counts. Resolve discrepancies, submit timely reports, and enforce PMC’s revenue procedures.
* Implement company initiatives, involve staff in process improvement, and support team accountability.
* Participate in assigned on-call coverage and address urgent staffing, service, and safety needs. Work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as required.
* Attend required meetings and training, travel occasionally for account support or company business, and perform other duties as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
  
  
Competencies and Qualifications
  
Ability to perform essential duties satisfactorily, with or without reasonable accommodation.
  
  
Education/Experience
  
High school diploma or GED required. At least one year of supervisory experience in customer service or hospitality preferred. Relevant management or leadership training or certifications preferred.
  
  
Certificates and Licenses
  
A valid driver’s license and reliable transportation are required. Maintain an acceptable motor vehicle record in accordance with PMC policy, including no more than three moving violations within a three-year period. Must meet applicable background-screening requirements consistent with company policy and applicable law. Complete required PMC training and any applicable internal certifications; no additional professional certifications are required.
  
  
Hospitality, Customer Service and Communication
  
Strong guest service and communication skills, including active listening, anticipating guest needs, and resolving concerns professionally.
  
  
Strong Analytical and Problem-Solving Abilities
  
Ability to review revenue and payroll data, resolve discrepancies, and improve operational efficiency.
  
  
Work Environment
  
Work takes place indoors and outdoors at valet properties, including driveways, garages, parking lots, and on-site offices, with exposure to vehicle traffic and varying weather. Administrative duties include computer and telephone use.
  
  
Physical Demands
  
Duties include extended standing and walking, sitting, entering and exiting vehicles, driving guest vehicles, bending, reaching, and handling keys and equipment. Ability to observe traffic and surroundings is essential for safety. Essential functions may be performed with or without reasonable accommodation.
  
  
Technology, Cell Phone Use, and Expense Reimbursement
  
This position may require the use of a mobile phone for work-related communication and access to company applications. PMC will reimburse employees for necessary and reasonable business expenses, including required business use of a personal mobile phone, mileage, parking, tolls, and approved travel expenses, in accordance with company policy and applicable federal, state, and local law. Company-issued equipment may be provided when applicable.
  
  
Compensation and Benefits
  
Benefits vary based on employment status, plan eligibility, and the terms of the applicable benefit plans. Eligible employees may receive:
  
  

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) plan
* Supplemental life and critical-illness insurance
* Bonus opportunities: Based off annual outlined goals
* Paid time off: paid vacation/PTO available to this position
* Paid training
* Leadership-development opportunities
* Tuition assistance through Bellevue University of up to $5,250 annually
* Nationwide employee discounts through Perks at Work
* Other compensation: Bonus opportunities

Employment Classification
  
PMC intends to classify this position as exempt from overtime requirements. Exempt status depends on the position satisfying all applicable federal, state, and local salary, duties, authority, and independent-judgment requirements.
  
  
The position’s title alone does not determine its classification. The employee’s actual duties must remain consistent with the applicable exemption requirements. PMC may review or modify the classification when responsibilities or legal requirements change.
  
  
At-Will Employment
  
Except where applicable law or a binding agreement provides otherwise, employment is at will and may be ended by either party with or without cause or advance notice, subject to applicable law. An introductory period does not guarantee continued employment or override statutory termination protections.
  
  
Equal Employment Opportunity
  
PMC is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without unlawful discrimination based on race, color, religion, religious creed, ancestry, national origin, citizenship status, age, sex, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, reproductive-health decision-making, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.
