a877f1deb16fd94e37c0.title: Customer Care Operations Manager
a877f1deb16fd94e37c0.description:
**Company Description**

Founded in 1978, California Closets has built a reputation as the leader and design authority in premium space management, delivering custom-designed organizational solutions and exceptional service. We believe home is more than just a place — it should be a source of creativity, comfort, and connection. From beautiful walk-in closets and entertainment centers to versatile pantries and home offices, we design custom storage solutions that add value to your life and home by making space for what belongs. Think of it as ‘practical magic.’

 **Job Description**

The Manager, Customer Care is the accountable operational leader for California Closets’ centralized Customer Care function. This hands-on role leads the internal Central Support team and owns the operational relationship with the First Contact Call Center vendor, TLS. The Manager is responsible for day-to-day service performance, departmental KPIs, quality, lead-management operations, customer escalations, market support, operational risk, and continuous improvement.

The role maintains a strong working knowledge of contact-center workforce management principles to evaluate TLS forecasts, staffing and capacity recommendations, identify performance risks, and hold the vendor accountable for corrective action.

The Manager also serves as the business and operational owner for Customer Care Salesforce campaigns and lead-routing requirements. The role defines and validates operational requirements, coordinates setup and testing with appropriate technical partners, monitors routing performance, and remains accountable for business impact, escalation, communication and validation when issues occur.

Success requires equal strength in people leadership and operational management. This individual is expected to operate with minimal day-to-day direction, use data to identify root causes and recommendations, and drive issues through resolution even when execution requires support from TLS, Salesforce/Technology resources, Service Delivery or other business partners.

Pay - $95K or more depending on experience

Duties and Responsibilities

* Independently lead the day-to-day operation of the Central Support team, establishing priorities and ensuring business goals, service expectations and customer experience standards are met.
* Directly manage Customer Liaisons, Specialists and Team Leads responsible for consultation scheduling, technical support and back-office administration across supported communication channels.
* Own departmental performance and KPIs, including lead-management metrics, complaint and feedback handling, quality, team NPS and applicable contact-center service metrics; identify root causes and establish measurable corrective actions when results fall below expectations.
* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for markets supported by Customer Care. Prepare performance reporting, analyze trends, conduct regular business reviews and translate findings into clear recommendations, owners and follow-up actions.
* Lead hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, payroll administration, schedules and rosters for the internal Central Support team; build a culture of accountability, customer focus and continuous improvement.
* Manage the Quality Assurance program and provide guidance to the Quality Assurance Team Lead. Audit and monitor customer interactions, identify trends and ensure coaching and corrective actions are completed for internal and external teams.
* Lead customer escalations with sound judgment, customer focus and solution-oriented decision making.
* Partner with Service Delivery to develop and maintain departmental SOPs, training and operational documentation, and ensure consistent execution across Central Support and applicable vendor teams.
* Communicate recurring issues, trends, risks and key learnings to leadership and internal partners, including Marketing, Product, Service Delivery and Technology, and drive follow-through on agreed actions.
* Perform other duties aligned to the scope and accountability of the role.

Vendor Performance

* Own the day-to-day operational relationship with TLS, including service performance, quality, lead-management expectations, issue escalation, action-plan follow-through and adherence to agreed operating standards.
* Maintain a strong working knowledge of workforce-management principles, including forecasting, capacity planning, staffing, scheduling and intraday management, sufficient to evaluate vendor recommendations and performance.
* Review and challenge TLS forecasts, staffing and capacity plans; understand forecast-versus-actual performance and escalate material staffing or service-level risks.
* Hold TLS accountable for investigating performance gaps, presenting recovery plans and demonstrating sustained improvement. Ensure operational issues remain actively managed through resolution rather than relying solely on ticket creation or vendor escalation.
* Use vendor performance, quality and operational data to identify trends and recommend changes to processes, training, staffing assumptions or service-delivery practices.

Salesforce Campaign & Lead Routing Operations

* Own the business and operational requirements for Customer Care lead management and customer service campaigns, queues and lead-routing processes.
* Guide and coordinate campaign setup, routing changes, testing, launch readiness and post-launch validation with appropriate Salesforce/Technology partners and TLS.
* Maintain current documentation of campaign purpose, routing logic, operational dependencies, ownership and escalation paths.
* Monitor lead-routing and campaign performance for exceptions, failures or unintended outcomes that may affect customer response, lead handling or market performance.
* When campaign or routing issues occur, assess business impact, coordinate containment or interim procedures, engage the appropriate technical owner, communicate status to stakeholders, and validate operational recovery before closure.
* Provide operational input into Salesforce enhancements and process changes that affect Customer Care, lead management, routing or call-center workflows.

Operational Risk & Incident Management

* Identify and escalate material operational risks based on customer, lead, service, revenue or brand impact, developing and following established escalation protocols.
* Own business-side incident coordination through containment, technical or vendor escalation, operational workaround, validation and closure.
* Communicate issue scope, business impact, current status, ownership, interim actions and next steps to affected stakeholders and leadership.
* Lead or participate in post-incident reviews for material or recurring issues and ensure preventive actions, documentation, controls, testing or training are implemented.

 **Qualifications**  

* 7+ years of progressive customer care or contact-center experience, including demonstrated responsibility for contact-center operations and people leadership.
* Demonstrated experience managing outsourced contact-center or BPO relationships and holding partners accountable for service, quality and operational performance.
* Strong understanding of contact-center workforce-management principles and ability to evaluate forecasts, staffing plans, capacity recommendations and service-level performance; direct ownership of vendor agent scheduling is not required.
* Experience working with Salesforce or a comparable CRM in a lead-management, campaign, queue or routing environment. Ability to define business requirements, validate operational outcomes and partner effectively with technical resources.
* Thorough understanding of contact-center KPIs and performance drivers, with the ability to interpret operational data, identify root causes and turn findings into executable, measurable plans.
* Experience leading operational incidents or cross-functional escalations and maintaining accountability through resolution.
* Strong process-management and continuous-improvement capabilities, including development and maintenance of SOPs and operating controls.
* Excellent written and verbal communication with the ability to clearly communicate performance, risks, recommendations and decisions to team members, vendors, markets and leadership.
* Proven people leadership capability, including hiring, coaching, performance management and development of team members and leads.
* Strong working knowledge of contact-center and CRM technologies and the ability to distinguish operational issues from technical issues and engage the appropriate owner.

Key Success Characteristics

* Operational ownership: takes accountability for business outcomes and drives issues through resolution, even when another team or vendor performs the technical work.
* Analytical judgment: uses data to diagnose performance, challenge assumptions and make clear recommendations.
* Proactive communication: identifies and communicates material risks early, with impact, ownership and an action plan.
* Vendor leadership: establishes clear expectations and follows through on corrective actions and sustained performance.
* Process discipline: ensures campaign, routing, escalation and service processes are documented, tested and consistently executed.
* Customer focus: balances operational efficiency with the quality of the customer and market experience.

  
**Additional Information**

Find us on Facebook, YouTube, and Instagram

*We are an equal opportunity employer. We E-Verify.*  
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

fdf4eaca7fcdbff70b18.title: Senior People Operations Coordinator, Claude Corps
fdf4eaca7fcdbff70b18.description:
CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 50,000 students from more than 1,000 universities. Our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. After nearly a decade of training technical talent, we launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic to prepare people for careers in AI.

We're expanding into new markets and growing our team as AI changes the workforce. People joining CodePath now will help shape this next stage of our work.

We believe technical skills create opportunities. Our goal is to train millions of learners and create lasting economic impact. If you want to build something new, take ownership, and see the results of your work, this is a place to do it.

**Location:** Remote (US)
  
**Role Type:** Full-Time
  
**Reporting to:** Senior HR Business Partner, Claude Corps  
**Compensation:**$65,000 to $85,000

**About Claude Corps**

Claude Corps is a fellowship that places early-career talent in nonprofits, government agencies, and public-interest organizations to build AI solutions those organizations can continue using after the fellowship ends. It is a partnership between Anthropic, CodePath, and Social Finance. Fellows are full-time employees for a one-year term.

Cohorts now run in the hundreds, and new fellows onboard while earlier cohorts are still placed. We need a coordinator who can run the day-to-day onboarding work at that scale, in partnership with the Senior HR Business Partner, and make sure every step is organized, accurate, and completed on time.

**About the Role**

You run the day-to-day onboarding work for Claude Corps fellows, from signed offer through completion of required employment steps. You send instructions, track progress, maintain employee records, and coordinate payroll and benefits setup.

The Senior HR Business Partner owns the overall onboarding process and handles sensitive questions and exceptions. You complete the work, keep fellows informed, and flag issues early.

You work closely with recruiting, the Claude Corps program team, Finance, and our HR service providers. Between onboarding waves, you help maintain records, coordinate offboarding, and improve processes so the team is ready for the next cohort.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

**Coordinate fellow onboarding**

* Manage onboarding for each cohort, including offer tracking, background checks, I-9 verification, employee information collection, HRIS setup in CoAdvantage, and benefits enrollment
* Track required employment steps and deadlines, ensuring fellows are ready to start on time and records are complete and accurate
* Maintain a centralized onboarding tracker, proactively identifying outstanding items, potential delays, and issues requiring escalation
* Coordinate with Finance on onboarding clearances and flag sensitive or compliance-related concerns to the Senior HR Business Partner

**Be the primary point of contact for fellows**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for onboarding questions, providing timely, clear, and supportive communication
* Send onboarding instructions, reminders, and updates so fellows understand what to expect and what actions they need to take
* Resolve routine questions and coordinate with the appropriate HR partners on benefits, system issues, or policy-related matters
* Manage the HR inbox with care, discretion, and consistent follow-through

**Maintain systems and improve processes**

* Keep employee records, onboarding trackers, process documentation, the Notion hub, and relevant Fellow Handbook resources accurate and up to date
* Support offboarding and ongoing employee record maintenance between onboarding cohorts
* Create clear, repeatable workflows that support larger cohorts and allow additional team members to step in when needed
* Use AI and automation to reduce repetitive work, improve efficiency, and maintain accuracy as the program grows

**Requirements**
----------------

* Experience coordinating high-volume onboarding, people operations, or HR processes with time-sensitive requirements
* Familiarity with HRIS or PEO systems and the ability to learn new tools quickly
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with experience maintaining accurate records, trackers, and deadlines
* Clear, warm communication skills and a commitment to creating a positive employee experience
* Sound judgment when handling confidential information, resolving questions, and escalating sensitive matters
* Experience using AI or automation tools to improve workflows and reduce manual work
* A proactive, service-oriented approach and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment

**Key Success Metrics**

* **Onboarding Readiness:** Fellows complete required employment steps accurately and on time, with payroll and benefits information ready for their start dates
* **Fellow Experience:** Fellows receive clear instructions, timely updates, and responsive support throughout onboarding
* **Operational Accuracy:** Employee records and onboarding trackers remain current, with potential issues identified and communicated early
* **Efficiency and Collaboration:** Teams receive timely information, and onboarding processes become more consistent and efficient as cohorts grow

**Compensation**

CodePath has standardized salaries based on the position’s level, no matter where you live. For this role, we’re offering an annual salary of $65,000 to $85,000. Salary is determined based on your relevant experience and skills as evaluated through our interview process.

**Full-Time Employee Benefits**

This is a remote position—work from anywhere in the US! CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance.

* Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer-covered for employees and dependents), employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program
* Financial Security: 401(k), employer-paid life & disability insurance, and identity theft protection
* Work-Life Balance: Generous PTO, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and an annual year-end company closure (Dec 24 – Jan 2)
* Professional Growth: $1,000 annual professional development stipend and home office setup support
* Student Loan Forgiveness: CodePath is a qualifying employer for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), helping employees manage student loan debt
* Additional Perks: Pet wellness plans, legal services, home/auto insurance discounts, and exclusive marketplace savings

Pay range

$65,000 - $85,000 USD

f4d712a5e8f916aea6e3.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

#### **The role**

You will be the hands-on operator behind our Workday work and a key resolver for our core recruiting systems. In the near term you will help test and implement Workday for Talent Acquisition, then support it and improve its processes after go-live. Alongside that, you will resolve issues across Greenhouse and ChartHop for the core processes that recruiters and coordinators depend on, such as backfills and conversions. You will spot patterns in what breaks and fix the process, not just the ticket.

### **What you will do**

#### **Workday testing and implementation**

* Partner with the Workday project team and TA stakeholders to document requirements, write and run test scenarios, and track and retest defects.
* Coordinate user acceptance testing with recruiters, coordinators, and business partners, and make sure issues are resolved before go-live.
* Validate data and process flows between Workday and our other TA systems, and help prepare cutover, training materials, and communications.

#### **Workday support and improvement after go-live**

* Be a first point of escalation for Workday questions and issues from TA, resolving what you can and routing the rest with clear context.
* Iterate on processes after launch: gather feedback, find friction, and propose and test improvements.
* Keep process documentation and job aids current as configuration and workflows change.

#### **Core systems resolution (Greenhouse and ChartHop)**

* Resolve system issues that affect core processes, including backfills, conversions, and requisition and headcount alignment between systems.
* Investigate data and sync discrepancies, fix the root cause where you can, and escalate with a clear summary where you cannot.
* Handle support tickets and requests with consistent quality and response times.

#### **Continuous improvement**

* Track recurring issues and questions, identify root causes, and recommend changes to configuration, process, or training.
* Partner with the enablement team so recurring questions become better training and guidance.
* Help define process around outcomes and actual tool usage, so the tools get used correctly and consistently.

**How the role evolves**
------------------------

Early on, your time is split between Workday testing and implementation and core systems resolution. After go-live, the balance shifts toward Workday support and process improvement, while core systems resolution continues. As the Workday footprint grows, this role is a natural path toward leading larger systems projects, initiatives, and process improvement for TA to meet increasingly complex and scaling business needs.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

  

### **Benefits**

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

  

### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

* **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
* **Please always verify communications:**
  + Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address.
  + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.
* **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
* **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

### **Data Privacy**

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

  

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

Are you ready to Level Up?  
Join our growing team as a Support Operations Specialist  
  
**About the role**  
You will own the systems, reporting, and knowledge that keep Track's Customer Support team running smoothly. Reporting to the Support Operations Manager, you will partner with Support Leadership, Product, and Engineering to tune Zendesk, build the dashboards our leaders rely on, and grow our AI and self-service tools. As our support team scales, this role exists to make every ticket easier to solve, or better yet, never needed. This is a remote, full-time role with about 10% travel.  
  
**What you will do**  

* Keep Zendesk running clean by tuning views, macros, triggers, automations, and routing so tickets land in the right hands the first time.
* Build dashboards that track ticket volume, backlog, response and resolution times, SLA performance, and CSAT, and flag trends before they turn into problems.
* Find the manual work slowing the team down and remove it through better workflows, automation, or documentation.
* Own the knowledge base so customers and agents find answers fast, writing and updating internal and external articles and troubleshooting guides across Track's products.
* Configure, test, and improve our AI support tools and chatbots, keeping content AI-ready and driving up ticket deflection and self-service adoption.
* Build onboarding and ongoing training for Tier 1 and Tier 2 Support so new agents ramp faster and stay current on product changes.
* Partner with Tier 3, Product, and Engineering to document known issues, defects, and workarounds, and keep user access across support tools accurate.

**What you will bring**  

* 2+ years in customer support, support operations, or technical enablement at a SaaS or technology company.
* Hands-on admin experience with Zendesk or a similar platform, including views, macros, triggers, automations, routing, and reporting.

We combine deep hospitality expertise with forward-thinking technology and a customer-obsessed mindset to help property managers win.

1ee52a325e3c9550c8ac.description:
Vimly is hiring a Client Services Specialist to serve as the Tier 2 contact for members, employer groups, brokers and internal teams. You will own nine areas of group administration, from user access to EDI support. You will keep each one accurate and on deadline. This role will report to our Manager, Client Services.

  

At Vimly, our mission is to simplify the complexities of workforce and benefit administration for our customers and partners. We need team-oriented people who want to do excellent work, grow and enjoy the day while they do it.

  

**YOU WILL OWN NINE AREAS OF GROUP ADMINISTRATION**

Each area has a clear start, a deadline and a record in Salesforce. You will work them through cases and log every step so the next person can see what happened.

* **User Access** - Set up, change and remove Vimly platform access for employer, broker and trust users. Troubleshoot login and permission problems, and answer how-to questions about SIMON features.
* **New Groups** - Set up new employer groups, including plan setup, SBS tagging and new plan document tagging. Confirm each group is ready before its effective date.
* **Renewals** - Process renewing groups and rolling renewals. Update plan and rate information, and track every renewal deadline through completion.
* **Terms & Reinstatements** - Process employer and group terminations, then reinstate groups and members when coverage resumes. Confirm the billing and carrier impact of each change.
* **New Group & Renewal Audits** - Check each new group and renewal against its source documents. Maintain the audit engine, and correct errors before they reach a carrier or member.
* **Broker Management** - Keep broker records current, answer producer questions, and support broker commissions and case closing.
* **Reporting** - Build recurring and ad-hoc reports in Excel and Cleaner Reports. Support ACA reporting and send compliance notices (SAR, Medicare Part D, CMS disclosure, Form M-1).
* **Trust Meeting Support** - Prepare reports and materials for trust meetings, record action items, and follow up until each one closes. Track deadlines and deliverables for your assigned trusts.
* **EDI Support** - Start manual carrier loads, review 834 suspensions and reconcile eligibility between SIMON and carriers. EDI (electronic data interchange) 834 files carry enrollment data to carriers.

  

**YOU WILL ALSO PROVIDE GENERAL SUPPORT**

* Keep detailed logs, documentation and audit trails in internal systems.
* Act as the liaison between clients, brokers, insurance carriers and providers.
* Contribute to internal initiatives, process documentation and cross-functional projects.
* Help other departments with overflow work and special assignments.

  

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* High school diploma or GED required. Associate or bachelor's degree preferred.
* 1+ years in customer service, administrative support, operations or customer success.
* 1-2 years in benefits, eligibility, billing, and enrollment/Benefits Administration Experience
* Advanced Microsoft Office skills, especially Excel (pivot tables, formulas, reporting).
* Salesforce or another CRM (preferred).
* Working knowledge of EDI 834 files or carrier eligibility feeds (preferred).
* Strong math, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Clear verbal and written communication with a professional tone.
* High accuracy, attention to detail and respect for confidentiality.
* Skill at managing large workloads, shifting priorities and firm deadlines while working remotely.
* Comfort with Teams, Zoom and shared drives.

  

**What Will Help You Excel**

* Alignment with Vimly's values and strategic goals.
* Strong interpersonal skills and a customer-first mindset.
* Organization and time-management habits that hold up under volume.
* Composure under pressure and in challenging conversations.
* High integrity and sound judgment.
* Self-motivation and willingness to learn and take on new responsibilities.
* Project management skills and comfort with changing processes.

  

**What We Offer**

**Base salary:** $23/hr.+Bonus.

Comprehensive bonus plan.

This role serves as a key connection point between technical teams, business partners, and customers, ensuring reliable service delivery while driving issues through resolution and identifying opportunities to improve processes and operational effectiveness. Success in this position requires strong **communication, customer service, and collaboration skills**, along with the ability to build trusted partnerships, coordinate across teams, and lead technical efforts in a fast-paced environment.

*As a* **Systems Administrator Lead***, you will*...

* **Lead day-to-day systems administration operations**, including technical projects, escalations, incident resolution, and infrastructure support to maintain reliable and effective services.
* **Drive continuous improvement** by identifying opportunities to strengthen processes, improve system reliability, reduce operational friction, and enhance the customer experience.
* **Build strong cross-functional partnerships** through clear communication, collaboration, and a customer-focused approach, serving as a trusted technical resource for teams, partners, and stakeholder

**Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* 4-6 + years of relevant experience
* Growing Knowledge of systems engineering and administration.
* Ideal candidate would have education and/or equivalent experience in a prior Systems Admin position
* Ability to use knowledge, sound judgment, and resourcefulness to support the design and deployment of global
* technology solutions
* Demonstrates junior leadership skills to help junior staff excel in role
* Building on foundational skills to automate manual processes and growing technical acumen in role
* Ability to balance multiple priorities and meet deadline

Partners have access to short-term and long-term disability, paid parental leave, family expansion reimbursement, paid vacation from date of hire\*, sick time (accrued at 1 hour for every 25 hours worked), eight paid holidays, and two personal days per year. Starbucks also offers eligible partners participation in a 401(k) retirement plan with employer match, a discounted company stock program (S.I.P.), Starbucks equity program (Bean Stock), incentivized emergency savings, and financial well-being tools. Additionally, Starbucks offers 100% upfront tuition coverage for a first-time bachelor’s degree through Arizona State University’s online program via the Starbucks College Achievement Plan, student loan management resources, and access to other educational opportunities. You will also have access to backup care and DACA reimbursement. Starbucks will comply with any applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, and in accordance with its plans and policies. 5e31f73a0c52d3348237.description:
**Position Summary**  
Rue Insurance’s Assistant Account Manager is responsible for client account servicing and insurance renewal tasks to support the Account Managers. Quality of work must exemplify the best-in-class service standards established by Rue Insurance at all times. A primary objective of this role is to effectively support new and existing medium and large size commercial client accounts. The Assistant Account Manager is an integral part of the client onboarding and renewal processes.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist Account Managers with overall servicing of client accounts:
  + request and compile pre-renewal client data
  + request insurer loss runs
  + create draft proposals and summaries of insurance
  + invoice transactions and assist with billing reconciliations
  + review policies for accuracy and request and process changes as necessary
  + process mid-term policy change requests for client exposure changes
  + assist with audit processing
  + issue proofs of insurance and other client forms
  + update and maintain Applied Epic client account and application detail
  + create and transmit client correspondence and related documentation
* Process client policy renewals and remarketing
* Onboard new clients
* Follow up on outstanding items, including, but not limited to, policy change requests, cancellations and reinstatements, and overdue premium payments, update agency management system accordingly, and communicate any concerns to Account Manager
* Perform assigned responsibilities in accordance with agency-established client service standards
* Follow all agency processes and procedures, including but not limited to Epic Workflows, documentation, and paper and electronic record maintenance and retention guidelines
* Ensure all work product is timely and accurate
* Provide in-house customer service to producers and other agency departments as requested
* Evaluate and answer client coverage questions and other client inquiries
* Handle telephone, electronic, and in-person communication with clients, insurers, Rue personnel, and third parties in an empathetic and professional manner
* Attend and participate in department and company meetings as requested

**Reports to:** Chief Operating Officer  
**Department:** Commercial  
**Work Schedule & Classification:** Full-time, salaried non-exempt position  
**Salary:** $50,000 - $70,000 Annually  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Strong customer service mindset and skills
* Strong written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills
* Ability to operate in a time-sensitive environment, with a sense of urgency when required
* Strong organizational skills with attention to detail
* Ability to work well with others as a team, as well as to work well independently and accept accountability
* Ability to be flexible, and to multi-task in a fast-paced environment
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office

  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Active New Jersey Property & Casualty Insurance License
* Functional and technical knowledge of commercial lines core coverages
* At least 1 year of commercial lines insurance experience at an agency or insurance company
* Associate’s Degree
* Proficiency with agency management software
* Experience with Applied Systems Epic software

**Benefits:**

* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* 401(k) with Employer Match
* Profit Sharing Plan
* Flexible work and In Office/Remote Hybrid Work Schedules (after 90 days)
* Insurance options for: Medical, Dental, Vision, Long Term Disability, Short Term Disability, Life, Accident, Critical Illness, Accident Death & Dismemberment and Identity Theft

**Physical Requirements:**  
Must be capable of sitting for a long period of time, working on a computer, standing, and walking.  
  
**About Rue Insurance**  
Rue Insurance is one of the largest independent insurance brokerages in the state of NJ, having been established in 1917. We offer insurance solutions throughout NJ and PA with a focus on Mercer, Bucks, Burlington, Middlesex, Monmouth, Ocean, and Somerset counties and licenses in most states across the US. We consistently win “Best Places to Work NJ” and recently “Best Places to Work Insurance”, a national designation. We have an exceptional and diverse company culture that has led to our average employee remaining with us for over a decade. Our employees give 5 star customer service to our clients which in turn has fostered our sterling reputation.  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**  
Rue Insurance provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.  
  
This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

**Job Details**

High School Diploma/GED  



**Experience - Required**

Less than 1 year healthcare experience  



**Experience - Preferred**

* Less than 1 year Experience in a fast-paced customer service or medical environment preferred.
Less than 1 year Familiarity with medical terminology is preferred

* Healthcare Knowledge - Knowledge of medical terminology, patient care needs and their role in interprofessional team.
* Execution of Delegated Tasks - Ability to complete delegated tasks within scope of role.
* Cultural Awareness- Knowledge of people with diverse backgrounds and the ability to convey respect and connect effectively.
* Effective Communication- Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques, ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors. Uses the language of partnership with patients and families, engaging them in their health and health care.

**Work Shift**

Workday Night (United States of America)

**Worker Sub Type**

Regular

**Employee Entity**

Thomas Jefferson University Hospitals, Inc.

111 S 11th Street, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, United States of America

Nationally ranked, Jefferson, which is principally located in the greater Philadelphia region, Lehigh Valley and Northeastern Pennsylvania and southern New Jersey, is reimagining health care and higher education to create unparalleled value. **Benefits**

Jefferson offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and part-time colleagues, including medical (including prescription), supplemental insurance, dental, vision, life and AD&D insurance, short- and long-term disability, flexible spending accounts, retirement plans, tuition assistance, as well as voluntary benefits, which provide colleagues with access to group rates on insurance and discounts. Colleagues have access to tuition discounts at Thomas Jefferson University after one year of full time service or two years of part time service. ae710ff117f8fc1f69a6.title: Coordinator, New Student and Family Programs
ae710ff117f8fc1f69a6.description:
**Temple University's New Student and Family Programs Department is searching for a Coordinator.**

Become a part of the Temple family and you will have access to the following:  
**A hybrid work schedule**  
**Full medical, dental, vision coverage**  
**Paid time off**  
**3 Personal Days**  
**Tuition remission - eligible employees and their dependents can obtain a degree TUITION FREE**  
**A generous retirement plan and so much more!**

**Salary Grade: T24**  
*A variety of important factors are reviewed by HR when considering salary, including job duties, the applicant’s education and experience, all relevant internal equity considerations, department budget, and funding source.*

**Position Summary**  
The Coordinator for New Student Programs is a full-time member of the New Student and Family Programs (NSFP) team within the Division of Student Affairs and reports to the Associate Director of New Student and Family Programs. This role supports the planning, implementation, and continuous improvement of orientation and transition programs that foster belonging, engagement, academic readiness, and successful transition for new first-year and transfer students.  
Primary responsibilities include the implementation of day-to-day coordination of assigned components of orientation experiences, transition initiatives, student communications and resources, and related programs. This includes coordinating program logistics, staffing, materials, technology, registration, and on-site execution while collaborating with academic and administrative partners across the University.

A key component of the role is coordinating and supporting the recruitment, selection, training, scheduling, supervision, and evaluation of undergraduate student leaders, working closely with the Associate Director to ensure effective staffing and program delivery. This position also supports the implementation and support of year-round transition and engagement initiatives for new first-year and transfer students, including programs designed to foster connection, belonging, peer support, and continued engagement throughout the first-year experience.

The Coordinator supports the department's assessment and continuous improvement efforts through data collection, program evaluation, reporting, and implementation of identified improvements. The position also contributes to the development and delivery of student-facing communications, resources, and outreach associated with orientation and transition programs.

In collaboration with members of New Student and Family Programs and university partners, the position supports departmental priorities and contributes to broader programs and initiatives, including family and Engagement Portfolio programs, as assigned.

Performs other duties as assigned.

**Application requirements**  

* Please submit a resume

**Job-related Details**  

* This position requires the following background check: Cash Handling and Personally Identifiable Information background check. This must be completed prior to commencement of service.
* Offer of employment is conditional upon the successful completion of a pre-employment physical.
* This position is assigned to a hybrid work arrangement (on-campus and remote). The duration of this hybrid work arrangement is at the discretion of Temple University and the hiring department.
* Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends (when necessary).

**Required Education and Experience**  

* Bachelor's degree with concentration in Student Affairs, Higher Education, or related field
* And at least 2 years directly related experience in a full-time, professional environment.
* An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

**Preferred Experience**  

* Master’s degree with concentration in Student Affairs, Higher Education, or related field and at least one year of full-time, professional experience.

**Required Skills and Abilities**  

* Demonstrated ability to handle and prioritize diverse tasks in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience coordinating and implementing student programs, orientation and transition programs, or related student services and training.
* Excellent organizational skills, along with the ability to prioritize and work independently and efficiently.
* Ability to foster positive interactions and work with a diverse group of students, parents, faculty, staff and other stakeholders.
* Ability to recruit, direct, and manage large group of student workers.
* Competency with remote learning and engagement technology.
* Exceptional oral and written communication skills, along with the ability to tailor communication to specific audiences.
* Strong customer service and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Access and Excel).

**Temple University** is committed to a policy of equal opportunity for all in every aspect of its operations, including employment, service, and educational programs. The University has pledged not to discriminate on the basis of age, color, disability, marital status, national origin or ethnic origin, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information or veteran status.

**Compliance Statement**: In the performance of their functions as detailed in the position description employees have an obligation to avoid ethical, legal, financial and other conflicts of interest to ensure that their actions and outside activities do not conflict with their primary employment responsibilities at the institution. Employees are also expected to understand and be in compliance with applicable laws, University and employment policies and regulations, including NCAA regulations for areas and departments which their essential functions cause them to interact.

The Planning Studio Leader demonstrates the leadership, technical expertise, and business acumen necessary to lead and grow NELSON’s Planning Studio while delivering exceptional client service and successful project outcomes. This individual is responsible for the overall performance of the studio, including teammate development, resource management, project delivery, quality, and financial performance.

The Planning Studio Leader provides strategic direction and oversight for a range of urban planning and development initiatives, including land use planning, master planning, zoning and entitlements, community development, and sustainable design. Working collaboratively with Practice Leadership, project leads, and clients, this individual ensures projects are executed successfully while identifying opportunities to strengthen existing client relationships, pursue new business, and expand the studio’s capabilities and market presence.

A key responsibility of this role is building a collaborative and engaging studio environment where teammates are supported, developed, and empowered to excel. The Planning Studio Leader mentors and grows NELSON talent, establishes a vision for the studio, and ensures the team has the resources, guidance, and technical expertise necessary to deliver high-quality work and achieve business objectives.

  

**Attributes to support the NELSON culture:**

* **Go All In. Own the Outcome.**We go all in—with urgency, follow-through, and pride in the result.
* **Be Direct. Be Respectful. Be Authentic.**We keep it real—with clarity, candor, and care.
* **Grow with Purpose.**We embrace growth—through learning, coaching, and continuous improvement.
* **Think Bold. Execute Smart.**We think boldly—and pair ambition with discipline.
* **Make Space for Everyone.**We value you—and build a culture where people can thrive and do their best work.

  

**Qualifications**:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty and responsibility satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Critical features of this job are described under the headings below. They may be subject to change at any time due to reasonable accommodation or other reasons.

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned:**

##### ***Leadership & Team Development:***

* Provide strategic direction and establish a vision for the Planning Studio, aligning team goals and priorities with broader firm and practice objectives.
* Lead, mentor, and develop project leads and teammates, fostering an environment of accountability, collaboration, professional growth, and continuous improvement.
* Manage and support project leads and assigned teams, ensuring teammates are engaged, appropriately supported, and positioned for success.
* Establish performance goals, conduct performance evaluations, provide regular feedback, and identify opportunities for professional development and advancement.
* Develop project leads in core responsibilities, including communication, presentation skills, time management, workload prioritization, and team leadership.
* Evaluate team capabilities and identify opportunities to strengthen technical expertise and expand studio capabilities.
* Promote a diverse and inclusive workplace that encourages collaboration, innovation, and engagement.
* Develop professional and industry relationships that support talent acquisition and the continued growth of the studio.
* Address team challenges, resolve conflicts, and maintain a positive and productive studio environment.
* Serve as a resource and mentor to teammates across the studio and broader firm.

*Resource Management & Operations:*

* Oversee resource planning and allocation to ensure appropriate staffing, balanced workloads, and effective utilization across projects and teams.
* Meet regularly with project leads to review project progress, staffing needs, schedules, and resource requirements.
* Provide direction and support to project leads in resolving project-related issues and balancing workloads across teams.
* Evaluate team skills and capabilities and make staffing recommendations to Practice Leadership.
* Participate in recruiting, interviewing, hiring, and onboarding efforts to support the continued growth of the studio.
* Coordinate with Practice Leadership and other Studio Leaders on staffing decisions, resource sharing, and business priorities.
* Monitor studio utilization and staffing levels to support established performance targets.
* Ensure timely completion of internal reporting, project planning, pipeline projections, timesheet approvals, and other operational requirements.

*Technical Leadership & Planning Expertise:*

* Provide technical guidance and oversight across urban planning projects, ensuring quality, consistency, and adherence to applicable standards and regulations.
* Oversee the development of comprehensive land use plans, master plans, conceptual designs, and planning studies that address community needs, environmental considerations, and long-term development objectives.
* Guide teams in zoning analysis, entitlement processes, land use regulations, building codes, accessibility requirements, and applicable federal and local government programs.
* Ensure teams understand and incorporate relevant regulatory, environmental, social, economic, and infrastructure considerations into planning recommendations and deliverables.
* Provide direction on the use of Geographic Information Systems (GIS) for mapping, spatial analysis, and data-driven planning decisions.
* Promote sustainable planning practices, including an understanding of LEED, WELL, energy efficiency, environmental impact, and responsible land development.
* Ensure project teams follow NELSON standards and established quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC) procedures.
* Review project work and deliverables, providing technical direction and recommendations to maintain quality and consistency.
* Support the development of best practices, tools, and resources that strengthen the studio's technical capabilities.
* Stay informed of industry trends, emerging planning practices, regulatory changes, and advancements in technology relevant to urban planning and community development.

*Project Delivery:*

* Oversee project execution across the studio, ensuring projects are delivered on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with established scope and quality expectations.
* Provide guidance to project leads in developing project work plans, schedules, budgets, and resource requirements.
* Oversee the preparation and execution of master plans, conceptual and schematic designs, zoning analyses, planning studies, reports, and related project deliverables.
* Support the preparation of proposals, contracts, scopes of work, and fee estimates.
* Lead or participate in complex projects and provide additional project leadership when necessary to support studio performance and client needs.
* Guide teams through zoning reviews, entitlement processes, permitting requirements, and coordination with applicable authorities having jurisdiction.
* Oversee coordination of internal teams, external consultants, and project stakeholders to ensure comprehensive and consistent project execution.
* Lead or facilitate client workshops and design charrettes, communicating planning concepts and recommendations through presentations, discussions, and visual communication.
* Ensure project deliverables meet NELSON standards and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Monitor project progress, identify potential scope or schedule issues, and work with project leads to implement corrective actions.
* Support project leads in identifying additional services, managing scope changes, and maintaining accurate project documentation.
* Encourage knowledge-sharing and collaboration across project teams to improve project delivery and overall studio performance.

*Financial Management:*

* Maintain accountability for the overall financial performance of the Planning Studio, including revenue, profitability, utilization, and project performance.
* Review financial reports and use performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas requiring improvement.
* Oversee project budgeting, fee development, resource planning, and financial forecasting.
* Ensure project leads and project managers effectively manage project budgets, schedules, and financial performance.
* Monitor project plans, fee expenditures, staffing projections, and profitability to ensure projects remain on track.
* Partner with Practice Leadership to develop annual revenue forecasts and establish strategies to achieve financial objectives.
* Monitor client and account revenue, identify potential risks, and proactively address issues that may impact studio performance.
* Ensure timely project invoicing and support accounts receivable collections, escalating client payment concerns as needed.
* Mentor teammates on financial management fundamentals, including project budgets, timesheets, utilization, and invoicing.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, maximize profitability, and support sustainable studio growth.

*Client Relationships & Business Development:*

  

* Build, strengthen, and maintain relationships with existing clients while identifying opportunities to develop new client relationships and expand the studio's market presence.
* Maintain awareness of client satisfaction and proactively address concerns related to project performance, service delivery, or client relationships.
* Serve as a senior point of contact for key clients and support project leads in managing client expectations and relationships.
* Participate in client meetings, presentations, interviews, and project reviews with Practice Leadership and Account Leaders.
* Support business development initiatives by identifying new opportunities, participating in pursuits, responding to RFPs, developing proposals, and interviewing for new business.
* Identify opportunities to expand NELSON's planning services through relationships with developers, public officials, government entities, community organizations, and industry partners.
* Represent NELSON in professional organizations, industry events, and community initiatives to strengthen the firm's visibility and reputation.
* Develop and maintain relationships with industry professionals and organizations to support business development, recruiting, and the continued growth of the Planning Studio.

*Supervisory Responsibilities:*

* Directly supervises assigned teammates and project leads within the Planning Studio.
* Responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of assigned teams.
* Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with NELSON policies and applicable laws.
* Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training teammates; planning, assigning, and directing work; conducting performance evaluations; providing feedback; and addressing complaints and resolving problems.

  

##### **Required Knowledge and Skills:**

* Extensive knowledge of urban planning, land use, community development, zoning, and entitlement processes.
* Strong understanding of design, urban development trends, construction methodologies, materials, and sustainable planning practices.
* Extensive knowledge of federal, state, and local government programs, regulations, zoning codes, and applicable building and accessibility requirements.
* Demonstrated experience with master planning, land use planning, conceptual design, and development strategies.
* Experience utilizing Geographic Information Systems (GIS) software for mapping, analysis, and planning applications.
* Strong understanding of project management, including budgeting, scheduling, resource planning, and project delivery.
* Proficiency in financial management concepts, including project profitability, revenue forecasting, utilization, and financial reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and develop teams while managing multiple projects and competing priorities.
* Strong business development, client relationship management, and presentation skills.
* Excellent analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
* Strong written, verbal, and visual communication skills, including the ability to lead client presentations and design charrettes.
* Ability to develop and maintain relationships with clients, public officials, developers, consultants, and industry partners.
* Proficiency in Deltek Vision/Vantagepoint and Microsoft Office applications.
* Working knowledge of AutoCAD or Revit, Adobe Photoshop, Bluebeam Revu, and other relevant planning and design software.
* Knowledge of LEED, WELL, and other sustainability guidelines.

  

##### **Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Urban Planning, Architecture, Public Policy, or a related field from an accredited university required.
* 12+ years of relevant professional experience in urban planning, regional planning, architecture, or a related field preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading teams, managing complex projects, and overseeing studio or practice performance.
* Experience with business development, client relationship management, and financial management within a professional services or AEC environment.
* Master's degree in Urban Planning or Regional Planning preferred.
* American Institute of Certified Planners (AICP) certification preferred.
* Architectural license in at least one state preferred.

  

##### **Continuing Education & Professional Development:**

* Maintain applicable professional certifications and fulfill continuing education requirements.
* Stay current on industry trends, regulatory developments, planning methodologies, and emerging technologies.
* Continuously develop leadership, business management, and communication skills.
* Participate in professional organizations and industry events to support continued learning and professional growth.

  

***Benefits of NELSON******: (additional benefit details can be found at:******nelsonworldwide.com/careers (https://nelsonworldwide.com/careers/))***

* **401(K) plan with company match**
* **Full health benefits including medical, dental, and vision**
* **Wellness program with rewards for healthy activities**
* **Pet Insurance**
* **Opportunities for career advancement**
* **Paid time off and holiday pay**
* **Paid parental leave**
* **Flexible working schedules and work from home options based on client’s needs**
* **Professional Development including discretionary support and reimbursement for registrations, certifications, and membership to a professional organization**

  

***NELSON and its related affiliates are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, transgender, national origin, status as a protected veteran, disability or any other classification protected by law.***

fee4f7acaef7d691a006.description:
**Position Summary**  
Rue Insurance’s Senior Account Manager is a Trusted Advisor to clients and a liaison between clients and insurance carriers. Senior Account Managers are primarily responsible to provide exceptional client service and advisory support to key Rue client accounts. They are accountable to build and maintain strong relationships with clients, insurers, and Rue producers; and to work closely with the Department Manager and team to support client retention and new prospect opportunities for the purpose of improving and growing the Unit. Quality of work must exemplify the best-in-class service standards established by Rue Insurance at all times.

* Handle primary responsibility for overall servicing of larger ($200K+ premium) and/or complex Commercial client accounts
* Build and maintain strong internal and external relationships
* Efficiently and effectively lead new client onboarding and account renewals, and advocate for client interests as needed
* Assist Producers with renewal and mid-term account risk analysis and insurance structure and coverage recommendations; and obtain and offer quote proposals as appropriate
* Lead complex account servicing such as advanced coverage inquiries and policy change requests, audit and billing inquiries, insurance proof compliance, and OCIP/CCIP enrollment and compliance
* Conduct thorough review of insurance requirements for client contractual agreements, advise client in accordance with findings, and assist client with its third-party negotiations
* Support the Rue Be Ready model by proactively seeking to discover client operational or exposure-based risk improvement opportunities, making appropriate risk control or insurance coverage recommendations to address identified risks, and following through to resolution
* Resolve coverage questions or deficiencies identified in the course of account servicing, independently or with joint accountability with Producers, as appropriate
* Collaborate with Producers, Rue Risk Services, and Claims on strategic recommendations and implementation for client’s Total Cost of Risk reduction
* Contribute to enhancement of agency processes and procedures, including, but not limited to, taking initiative to drive continuous improvement in client service offerings, Epic Workflows, system documentation, and paper and electronic records management
* Proactively identify and resolve client, insurer, Rue personnel, and third-party communication and service issues in an empathetic and professional manner
* Collaborate with agency management to drive growth, including, but not limited to, leading account rounding efforts and supporting new program development and integration
* Serve as liaison between insurers and clients, both as a technical advisor and on service-related issues
* Lead internal agency and departmental meetings with respect to market relationships and/or client servicing
* Provide hands-on assistance, training, and mentorship support to team members to enhance their personal professional development and success
* Develop and maintain advanced exposure and coverage knowledge by proactively seeking formal and informal educational programs to enhance knowledge and skills, and/or to obtain additional professional designations
* Participate in and/or conduct internal educational program(s) as a subject matter expert to further enhance knowledge and skills for self and team members
* Perform all other duties or projects as assigned by management

**Reports to:** Director of Client Services - Commercial Lines  
**Department:** Commercial Lines  
**Work Schedule & Classification:** Full-time, salaried (non-exempt) position  
**Salary:** $100,000 - $120,000  
**Physical Requirements:** Must be capable of sitting for a long period of time, working on a computer, standing, and walking.

**Required Qualifications**

* Current Property & Casualty license
* 10+ years Commercial account management experience with an agency or risk management department
* Demonstrated proficiency handling larger accounts ($200K+ premium), niches, and full range of property, casualty, and specialty insurance products required
* Demonstrated advanced functional and technical knowledge of Commercial core and specialty insurance coverages, policy structure, and practical application to client operations and exposures required
* Demonstrated ability to recognize client operational or exposure-based risks and identify improvement opportunities; and to make appropriate risk control or insurance coverage recommendations to address identified risks
* Exceptional proactive concierge-level customer service mindset and skills, with demonstrated problem resolution capability
* Excellent data entry and written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, including ability to create professional business correspondence and to create clear, detailed, meaningful descriptions and notes in agency management system
* Above average math skills with ability to rate insurance policies and analyze and resolve audits and billing discrepancies
* Team player with ability to also learn and work well independently without regular supervision, and accept accountability
* Professional appearance and demeanor, and positive attitude
* Ability to efficiently lead unit team members, with a sense of urgency when required
* Exceptional organizational, critical thinking, and analytical skills, with strong attention to detail and demonstrated ability to prioritize and operate strategically and effectively in a fast-paced environment
* Intermediate computer aptitude and skills including proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite
* Proficiency with insurance company rating systems
* Advanced Applied Epic aptitude

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree
* Advanced professional insurance designation(s) (e.g., CPCU, ARM) in progress or completed

**Benefits:**

* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* 401(k) with Employer Match
* Profit Sharing Plan
* Flexible work and In Office/Remote Hybrid Work Schedules (after 90 days)
* Insurance options for: Medical, Dental, Vision, Long Term Disability, Short Term Disability, Life, Accident, Critical Illness, Accident Death & Dismemberment and Identity Theft

**About Rue Insurance**

Rue Insurance is one of the largest independent insurance brokerages in the state of NJ, having been established in 1917. We offer insurance solutions throughout NJ and PA with a focus on Mercer, Bucks, Burlington, Middlesex, Monmouth, Ocean, and Somerset counties and licenses in most states across the US. We consistently win “Best Places to Work NJ” and recently “Best Places to Work Insurance”, a national designation. We have an exceptional and diverse company culture that has led to our average employee remaining with us for over a decade. Our employees give 5 star customer service to our clients which in turn has fostered our sterling reputation.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Rue Insurance provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Description & Requirements
  
Maximus is a trusted federal partner supporting mission critical programs for the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS). Through these partnerships, Maximus delivers compliant, mission driven services that help millions access vital healthcare information and benefits.
  
  
This position will support our Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS). The Helpdesk is the central point for Providers to report problems and seek assistance with problem reports and service requests. The help desk also provides vetting and approval and offers ongoing support for the Medicare Provider community for all aspects of the Identify Management web self-registration and profile Management process.
  
  
This position is fully remote. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a CMS client vetting process after offer acceptance.
  
  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**  

* Assist Technician II in providing Desktop and Operational Support to assigned site and remote offices.
* Install, configure, maintain, and support desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, and other PC peripherals and related hardware, as well as remote access devices.
* Install and support a variety of PC operating systems.
* Diagnose, resolve, and follow up on issues relating to various user concerns.
* Use remote desktop software to provide remote support and resolve issues for users whom may be at remote offices or home office users.
* Provide written updates for problem resolution in ticketing system, knowledge bases, troubleshooting manual(s), or on-line documentation repository.
* Assist in troubleshooting advanced technical issues within the network and telecommunications environments, especially as they relate to problems at the workstation level.
* Serve as a technical liaison to project managers as needed.
* Assist in providing support to project managers to integrate and transition projects or new technology efforts to the production support environment.
* Assist in maintaining software and workstation image management, including the use of image deployment software to perform imaging tasks for workstations.
* Perform other duties as may be assigned by management.

Minimum Requirements
  

* High School diploma or equivalent with 0-2 years of experience.
* May have additional training or education in area of specialization.
* Works on assignments that are routine in nature, with responsibilities easily learned on the job.
* Acquires job skills and learns applicable policies and procedures to complete routine tasks.
* Able to read, understand & perform assignments within prescribed guidelines.
* Communicates routine information in a clear and accurate way with internal & external contacts.

**Job-Specific Minimum Requirements:**  

* High School diploma or equivalent with 1+ year of experience.
* Shift schedule for this role is 10:45 AM - 7:00 PM Eastern Time. However, candidates must be available to work Monday-Friday, 7:00 AM-7:30 PM EST.
* Strong verbal and written communication /customer service skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to follow processes, procedures, and guidelines to ensure repeatable customer experiences.
* Highly detail-oriented, organized, timely, and customer service-oriented.
* Ability to work well independently and in a team setting.
* Must be able to successfully complete the CMS client vetting process as a condition of employment.
* Adaptable, flexible and able to deal with ambiguity and change.
* Excellent oral and written communication and customer service skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and good analytical skills.

**Preferred Skills and Qualifications:**  

* May have additional training or education in area of specialization.
* Knowledge of and the ability to monitor logs and scheduled events, as well as report on problems and anomalies.
* Experience with and/or ability to use call center telephony equipment.
* Experience in customer support or call center support.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio and Project).
* Government experience preferred.

e393d8f8dd6e00d4aabb.title: Associate Director, Global Quality Business Operations
e393d8f8dd6e00d4aabb.description:
**Associate Director, Global Quality Business Operations**

The Global Quality (GQ) Business Operations Associate Director is responsible for providing centralized oversight and coordination of strategic initiatives, resource planning, portfolio management, and program performance management across Global Quality. This role enables data-driven decision making by maintaining an integrated view of program priorities, resource capacity, dependencies, and initiative progress. The position serves as a key business partner within Global Quality, driving transparency, accountability, operational effectiveness, and continuous improvement while strengthening collaboration across global programs and strategic initiatives.

  

The Associate Director, GQ Operations will help build and mature program management capabilities, preserve organizational knowledge through process documentation and governance, and support the scalability of Global Quality operations to meet evolving business needs.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Portfolio & Program Management**

* Lead the management of a consolidated portfolio view of Global Quality strategic initiatives, programs, and key projects, enabling informed prioritization, resource allocation, and investment decision-making.

* Track initiative progress, milestones, risks, dependencies, and deliverables across Global Quality Operations global programs.

* Designs and governs program management standards, tools, and reporting mechanisms to strengthen program management discipline, improve execution consistency, and build organizational capabilities across Global Quality.

* Facilitate governance reviews and provide regular updates on program performance across Global Quality Operations

**Continuous Improvement & Performance Monitoring**

* Enable performance monitoring through the development and maintenance of metrics, dashboards, and reporting processes that provide visibility into operational effectiveness.

* Drive action tracking, follow-through, and accountability to support the timely execution of commitments, deliverables, and strategic priorities.

* Utilize performance data, trends, and insights to identify opportunities for operational effectiveness, process optimization, and continuous improvement.

* Support governance activities, performance reviews, and operational assessments to drive proactive decision-making and sustained improvement across Global Quality.

**Process Governance & Knowledge Management**

* Maintain end-to-end process maps, operational documentation, and process ownership frameworks.

* Ensure process documentation remains current, accurate, and aligned with organizational objectives.

* Promote program best practices across Global Quality.
* Preserve organizational knowledge and reduce dependency on individual expertise through robust documentation and governance practices.

**Stakeholder Partnership & Collaboration**

* Strengthen engagement and collaboration between Global Quality and functional business partners through the Centers of Excellence.

* Foster strong cross-functional partnerships to support alignment on strategic priorities, initiatives, and organizational objectives.

* Facilitate effective communication and coordination across regions, programs, and stakeholder groups to promote shared understanding and execution.

* Enhance transparency of priorities, dependencies, risks, and outcomes to support informed decision-making and organizational alignment.

* Act as a strategic partner to Global Quality leadership, Global Quality Operations, and business stakeholders to drive operational effectiveness and successful delivery of strategic initiatives. .
  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Quality, Life Sciences, or a related field.

* 8+ years of experience in portfolio management, strategic planning, PMO leadership, business operations, or organizational effectiveness

* Experience in program management, portfolio management, business operations, strategic planning, operational excellence within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or other regulated industries.

* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple strategic initiatives and priorities within a complex, global organization.
* Experience developing and maintaining portfolio management processes, governance frameworks, project plans, and operational reporting mechanisms.

* Experience developing metrics, dashboards, and performance reporting to support leadership decision-making and operational effectiveness.

* Experience facilitating cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder alignment across business functions, regions, and global programs.

* Knowledge of process improvement methodologies, operational excellence principles, and organizational effectiveness practices.

* Experience tracking program performance, risks, dependencies, actions, and deliverables to drive accountability and execution discipline.

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize data, identify trends, and provide actionable business insights.

Excellent organizational, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.  

  

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic thinking and business acumen

* Program and portfolio management

* Resource planning and prioritization

* Data analysis and performance management

* Process mapping and governance

* Continuous improvement mindset

* Stakeholder engagement and influence

* Cross-functional collaboration

* Executive communication and presentation skills

* Organizational change and transformation support
  

**Competencies**  
**Accountability for Results -** Stay focused on key strategic objectives, be accountable for high standards of performance, and take an active role in leading change.
