e32de17caf591f06f198.description:
### **About Throne**

Throne is a fast growing Series C startup transforming local communities by delivering clean, safe, accessible restrooms to cities, transit agencies, and public spaces. With flagship customers in Los Angeles, the San Francisco Bay Area, Ann Arbor, and Washington DC, and recent launches in New York City, Atlanta, and Seattle, we're rapidly scaling into new markets in 2027 and beyond.

We recognize an unspoken problem: that better bathroom accommodations are sorely needed in most cities. Public and retail bathrooms are neither positioned to meet demand, nor incentivized to provide the quality experience people deserve.

Our mission is to provide peace of mind to the millions of people who set out on an adventure on any given day. That adventure may be big or small. It may involve taking your toddler to the park, driving a stranger to the airport, running a half marathon, or exploring a new city for the first time.

**About the Job**

We are looking for a full-time Head of Talent Acquisition to join our team, reporting to the Head of People Operations. As Throne's first dedicated Talent Acquisition hire, you will be responsible for building and running our hiring engine for professional and managerial roles across engineering, product, sales, and corporate functions. You will partner closely with Finance, People Operations, our Founders and executive team, and hiring managers to connect hiring decisions to their tangible impact. While this role is being hired as an individual contributor given the nimble nature of our team, as Throne's business needs grow, you may have the opportunity to build out a team to further support specialized recruiting efforts, high-volume field staffing, and other disciplines.

This role can be performed remotely within the United States, with flexibility expected to work across timezones to support hiring teams. Minimal domestic travel (less than 10%) will be required.

The base salary range for this position is $150,000 - $190,000. This role is also eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, including equity.

### **Primary Responsibilities:**

* **Full-cycle recruiting for professional roles**: Own the full-cycle recruiting for central roles across engineering, product, sales, and corporate functions, from intake and sourcing through offer and close. As the first internal talent acquisition hire, you will design the entire hiring process: sourcing strategy, structured interviews and scorecards, interviewer training for hiring managers, offer construction and approvals within Throne's pay bands, and a candidate experience we are proud of. You will select and implement a scalable Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and use AI tooling (with unlimited Claude access) to automate scheduling, sourcing, and reporting from day one. If you are looking to maintain a well-established playbook, it does not exist, and this is not the right position for you.
* **Partner with the business**: Deeply understand the business by working with Finance, People Operations, Founders, and managers across every discipline. You will co-own the annual hiring plan with Finance and People Operations, including req prioritization and an honest view of whether the plan can be delivered with current resourcing. You will own recruiting metrics (time to fill, pipeline health, offer acceptance, candidate experience) and report monthly to the Founders and Finance. You will be expected to be commercially fluent in Throne's business, and will be fully supported in that endeavor.
* **Optimize field hiring**: While not serving as a field recruiter, you will support our Operations and Production Managers to reduce time to fill and cost to hire in high-volume recruiting efforts. This will look like enabling them with easy to implement templates and hiring guides, tooling, and coaching to improve hiring practices.
* **Leadership hiring**: Run senior and executive searches (VP+ and GM level) as Throne expands into new markets, including selecting and managing retained search firms and agencies where needed. Own the recruiting budget and vendor relationships.

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, especially for professional and managerial roles
* Ability to partner closely with finance and business leaders to connect hiring plans to business outcomes
* Exceptional communication and influencing skills, with the ability to coach and align hiring managers at every level in the organization
* Proven track record of recruiting for a variety of positions, including technical roles, sales, and corporate
* Experience selecting and implementing an ATS, with no particular preference given to one system
* Strong knowledge of compliant hiring practices across multiple states, including but not limited to CA, WA, and NY
* Comfortable working both strategically and hands-on in a fast-paced, evolving environment
Can-do attitude and passion for Throne's mission - You* toilets!

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience building or scaling a talent acquisition function, ideally as an early or first TA leader at a high-growth company
* Experience recruiting for government contractors or public-sector-facing businesses
* Experience working with visa sponsorship, such as coordinating with immigration counsel on H-1B, O-1, L-1B, and PERM cases
* Experience recruiting for hardware, IoT, or operations-heavy businesses

### **Benefits:**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance, with medical options that are 100% employer-paid
* Equity for all US-based positions, so you share in Throne's growth
* Daily access to earned wages
* 401(k) plan
* Paid time off that grows with tenure, in addition to paid sick time and paid parental leave
* Life insurance, AD&D coverage, and short and long-term disability insurance
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

*Benefits offered to full-time and part-time employees may vary by State.*

*Throne is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer, and we are committed to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce. We believe that every person has a right to equal employment opportunities without discrimination, and that diversity contributes to the overall health of the organization. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, religion, sex, sexual stereotyping, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, mental or physical disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, pregnancy (which includes pregnancy, childbirth, and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth, or breastfeeding), or any other protected characteristic. Employment may be contingent upon Throne's receipt of an acceptable and job-related drug test, motor vehicle report, and/or background check, as applicable and permissible by law.*

Torsh Inc. is an education technology company that produces a suite of coaching and professional development support products, including Torsh TALENT, a cloud-based coaching and professional learning platform through which all of the disparate elements of coaching can be organized, tracked, implemented, and managed and SESEBA powered by Torsh, a research based and evidence-backed coaching model that supports educators who teach Dual Language Learners in grades pre-K through 3. Our core mission is to improve student outcomes by increasing educator effectiveness, and we do this by helping schools and organizations increase educator instructional capacity, improve the delivery of educator professional development, and generate insights into educator effectiveness.

As Director of Customer Success, you'll lead and develop a team that helps customers realize the full value of TORSH's solutions. You'll play a critical role in driving customer retention, renewals, account growth, and overall customer satisfaction.

This is a hands-on leadership opportunity for someone who enjoys both the people and operational sides of Customer Success. You'll coach and support your team, strengthen customer engagement strategies, improve processes, and use data to make informed decisions.

Working closely with Business Development, Product, Engineering, and Marketing, you'll help shape how we deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience as TORSH continues to grow.

**What You'll Do**

**Lead, Coach, and Develop Your Team**

* Lead and mentor Customer Success Managers and Customer Enablement Managers, fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous development.
* Establish clear goals, performance expectations, and consistent coaching practices that help team members succeed.
* Support team development, hiring, onboarding, and workforce planning.
* Identify opportunities to improve team effectiveness, workload distribution, and customer coverage.

**Drive Customer Retention and Growth**

* Own the overall strategy and performance of customer renewals, retention, and expansion opportunities.
* Develop accurate renewal and growth forecasts, identify risks early, and implement proactive customer retention strategies.
* Partner with Customer Success Managers to strengthen account planning, customer engagement, and renewal readiness.
* Monitor account health and portfolio performance, using data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas requiring attention.

**Build Scalable Customer Success Practices**

* Develop and improve Customer Success processes, playbooks, and operating standards.
* Strengthen customer onboarding, account transitions, executive business reviews, and escalation management.
* Design customer engagement approaches that balance personalized support with scalable service delivery.
* Maintain accurate customer information, renewal forecasts, and account activity within our CRM.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, consistency, and the overall customer experience.

**Build Strong Customer and Cross-Functional Partnerships**

* Serve as an executive-level partner for strategic, high-value, and at-risk customers.
* Build trusted relationships with customer leaders, helping them connect TORSH's solutions to their organizational goals.
* Collaborate with Business Development, Product, Engineering, and Marketing to address customer challenges and improve customer outcomes.
* Represent customer needs internally and help prioritize improvements that support retention and long-term growth.
* Provide leadership with meaningful insights into customer performance, revenue opportunities, and business risks.

**What We're Looking For**

**Required Qualifications**

* 7+ years of progressive experience in Customer Success, account management, or implementation within a SaaS environment.
* 3+ years of experience managing, coaching, and developing customer-facing teams.
* Demonstrated success improving customer retention, renewals, account growth, and overall portfolio performance.
* Strong understanding of Customer Success operations, including account health monitoring, renewal forecasting, customer lifecycle management, and escalation processes.
* Experience developing scalable Customer Success strategies and service models across different customer segments.
* Proven ability to build relationships with senior and executive-level customer stakeholders.
* Strong analytical skills, including experience using CRM data, reporting, and customer performance metrics to guide decisions.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and leadership skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Product, Engineering, and other business functions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in EdTech, K–12 education, early childhood education, or education-focused SaaS.
* Experience with HubSpot or similar CRM platforms.
* Familiarity with Gong or other conversation intelligence tools.
* Experience leading customer success operations in a growing SaaS organization.
* Experience developing tiered customer engagement models, including high-touch, mid-touch, and technology-enabled support.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **Base Salary:** $110,000 annually
* **On-Target Earnings (OTE):** $130,000, including performance-based incentives
* Competitive employee benefits package
* Paid time off and company holidays
* Fully remote work environment
* Professional development opportunities

**Join Our Team**

If you're a Customer Success leader who enjoys developing people, solving complex challenges, and building strong customer partnerships, we'd like to hear from you.

Join TORSH and help us strengthen the customer experience while supporting educators and organizations in achieving meaningful outcomes.

93324bd89f43db26b6f9.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
93324bd89f43db26b6f9.description:
Marek Health is built around a simple vision: help people reach a level of health and performance they did not think was possible. Our expert clinical team creates a clear path to higher energy, stronger bodies, sharper minds, and a longer, fuller life. We do this through personalized, clinician-guided care grounded in advanced diagnostics and evidence-based treatments, including hormone optimization, peptides, nutrition, and lifestyle support. Our goal is to become the partner that guides people to the healthiest, most capable version of themselves.

We are hiring a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own email and SMS end-to-end across all three Marek brands: Marek Health, Marek Diagnostics, and Marek Supplements. This covers every email and text we send: lifecycle and automated flows, lead nurture, campaigns and promotions, client and care communications, and newsletters. Email and SMS are the channels we control outright, and they are one of our biggest levers for intakes, revenue, and retention. This role sets the strategy and does the build, and is directly accountable for what the program drives. It reports to the Growth and Operations Manager and works closely with the tech, sales, product, and clinical teams.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Lifecycle Strategy and the Client Journey**

* Own, manage, and scale the email and SMS program across all three brands: strategy, calendar, and cadence.
* Map the entire client lifecycle and hold the source of truth for every automated touchpoint: what triggers it, who receives it, what it says, and how it looks.
* Own stage-to-stage conversion after intake: intake to labs, labs to provider exam, exam to treatment plan, and first refill. Set baselines for each stage and show the lift email and SMS drive.
* Work in parallel with the tech and sales teams to rebuild and maintain the journey, define what lifecycle needs, and see it through.
* Focus heavily on client retention and reactivation.
* Drive adoption of the new Account Management portal. Use email and SMS to notify clients of status changes and incentivize the actions we want them to take, and partner with product to see which features clients use and scale adoption.

**All Email and SMS, Across All Brands**

* Run every type of send: lifecycle and automated flows, campaigns and promotions, client and care communications, and newsletters.
* Build lead nurture and mid-funnel journeys that move prospects from first touch through the questionnaire, discovery call, and intake.
* Build and run onboarding, evergreen sends to inactives, abandonment, win-backs, and retention journeys.
* Ship campaign and promotional sends on time, and modify flows for sales and promotions as they come up, without being asked.

**Data, Build, and Deliverability**

* Define and maintain the event and attribute spec that lifecycle depends on, covering the clinical system, payments, scheduling, and both Shopify stores. QA new events with tech before they go live.
* Own segments and the data behind them, and verify in QA before a send goes out.
* Write the copy, build and QA responsive emails that render across clients, and hold the final call on quality. Design supports the build.
* Own inboxing for email: warming, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, list hygiene, suppression, and the Gmail and Yahoo bulk-sender rules. Own SMS compliance and delivery: 10DLC registration, opt-in and opt-out handling, and quiet hours.

**Compliance and Patient Privacy**

* Keep every send compliant with HIPAA, CAN-SPAM, and TCPA, and make sure protected health information is only used where it is allowed and never exposed in marketing.
* Work with the clinical team on care communications and health claims so messaging stays accurate and within regulatory guidelines.

**Testing, Optimization, and Reporting**

* Run a standing testing program and optimize flows continuously. Test hooks, offers, timing, channel, and structure to drive conversion.
* Own the funnel from first touch to refill, package performance with clear takeaways, and report up.
* Use AI to move faster on build, personalization, testing, and reporting.

### **Qualifications**

* 5 to 7 years running lifecycle, email, SMS, or CRM marketing, including owning strategy for a program, not just executing it.
* Experience in a service-based or subscription business where the customer relationship is ongoing, not purely transactional e-commerce. Health, wellness, telehealth, SaaS, or membership all fit.
* You have run an email and SMS platform end to end. Customer.io preferred; Klaviyo, Iterable, Braze, Attentive, Postscript, or similar transfers.
* You build multi-step automated flows with triggers, segmentation, and decision logic across channels, not just one-off sends.
* Strong grasp of deliverability: authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), warming, inbox placement, list hygiene, and SMS registration and consent.
* Working knowledge of HIPAA and how PHI should and should not move through marketing tools, plus CAN-SPAM and TCPA.
* Fluent in HTML and email templating (Liquid or similar), responsive and cross-client.
* You handle segmentation and the data behind it, and can write an event spec a technical team can build from.
* You map systems and document them. You can walk into something undocumented and make it organized and maintainable.
* You run A/B tests properly and read the results.
* Strong copywriter with a sharp analytical mindset. You live in the data and turn it into decisions.
* You run independently: you own your area, drive it without being managed task to task, and carry several workstreams across three brands at once.
* Health, wellness, supplements, or longevity industry experience preferred.

### **Role Expectations**

* Full-time.
* Remote role.
* Ability to work effectively across PST to EST time zones.
* Reports to the Growth and Operations Manager, working in close partnership with the tech, sales, product, and clinical teams.

### **Compensation**

* Base compensation: $85,000 to $95,000 annually, depending on experience.
* Paid time off (PTO).
* 401(k): employer-contributed.
* Health insurance: employer-subsidized medical, dental, and vision.

*Marek Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.*

*This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.*

bec8841740c1104de7f3.title: Senior Project Manager
bec8841740c1104de7f3.description:
The Senior Project Manager will take primary responsibility within the project team for planning, coordinating, and delivering project activities through the entire project life cycle, from pre-development through construction and handoff to the client, on major, complex, and business-critical projects. Under the general direction of the Project Director, the SPM delivers CMD’s Owner’s Advisor Services as an extension of the client’s team, independently leading day-to-day execution to meet schedule, budget, quality, and client objectives, in conformance with CMD’s project management methodologies and standards.

The SPM brings CMD’s core values to every relationship (internally and externally) and engagement. Stewardship: take ownership of what is ours, following through on our commitments, and caring for the people, resources and responsibilities entrusted to us. Collaboration: building an aligned and effective team through working together with openness, trust, and shared purpose, valuing the perspectives and contributions of everyone involved. Professionalism: holding ourselves to the highest standards in everything we do, bringing expertise, integrity, and dedication to every engagement from start to finish. The SPM will lead multidisciplinary international project teams, independently direct day-to-day planning, design management, and construction activities, and be instrumental to the successful development, implementation, and delivery of a highly complex, ground-up ultra-luxury resort and branded residential development on a remote island in the Caribbean.

#### **DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

Project Leadership and Client Relations

* Assume primary responsibility for independently directing daytoday project execution, establishing projectspecific objectives, priorities, policies, and procedures, and ensuring accountability across all project disciplines.
* Serve as a senior representative of the client in coordinating with ownership, internationally recognized architects and designers, engineering consultants, contractors, operators, and regulatory agencies. Lead highlevel project meetings, drive critical decisions, and provide executivelevel briefings on project milestones, financial performance, risks, and strategic recommendations.
* Exercise independent judgment in anticipating and resolving complex project challenges, proactively identifying risks, evaluating technical and commercial implications, and implementing effective solutions while escalating major strategic matters to the Project Director.
* Provide leadership and direction to multidisciplinary project teams, holding consultants and contractors accountable for performance, deliverables, and project objectives. Mentor junior project staff in technical coordination, design management, and project management methodologies and standards.

#### **Pre-Development**

* Lead early planning efforts, including site analysis, feasibility studies, land planning, area programming, master planning, infrastructure assessments, and conceptual design, ensuring alignment with the client’s development objectives and ultraluxury hospitality expectations.
* Direct technical due diligence of site conditions, infrastructure, environmental constraints, and development risks to inform project decisions.
* Lead preliminary budgets, cost estimates, financial models, and master schedules; assess design feasibility and construction approaches.
* Recommend project delivery, contracting, procurement, phasing, and bid packaging strategies suited to remote island logistics and available resources.
* Coordinate entitlements, permitting, and regulatory approvals, identifying potential obstacles early.
* Challenge early design solutions to align architectural vision with constructability, infrastructure, cost, and schedule.

#### **Pre-Construction**

* Establish project communication, document control, roles, and accountability across international teams; lead design coordination and project control meetings.
* Direct the multidisciplinary design process from concept through construction documentation, managing internationally recognized architects, engineers, interior designers, and specialty consultants to ensure coordinated, technically sound deliverables that meet project quality, schedule, and budget objectives.
* Critically evaluate architectural and engineering designs for technical feasibility, interdisciplinary coordination, constructability, regulatory compliance, and alignment with the client's vision and luxury hospitality brand standards. Identify deficiencies, challenge proposed solutions, and direct appropriate corrective measures.
* Evaluate detailed budgets, schedules, cash flow, and design cost exposure; identify cost and schedule impacts of design decisions and recommend mitigation.
* Direct comprehensive design reviews, value engineering initiatives, peer reviews, and constructability assessments, balancing architectural integrity, technical performance, construction feasibility, cost, and schedule without compromising the intended design quality.
* Oversee coordination of complex structural systems, building envelopes, waterproofing, MEP systems, highend architectural finishes, FF and E, IT/lowvoltage systems, and other ownerfurnished components, ensuring seamless integration across design, procurement, and construction disciplines.
* Coordinate permitting and regulatory reviews with local authorities and technical consultants; proactively address schedule risks.
* Lead procurement and contracting activities, including RFQ/RFP development, consultant and contractor prequalification, bid evaluation, negotiations, contract awards, and buyout. Develop procurement strategies addressing international sourcing, shipping logistics, limited local resources, and longlead materials and equipment.
* Oversee consultant and contractor agreement administration, financial controls, invoice review, and tracking of budgeted, committed, actual, and projected costs. Evaluate commercial risks, proposed changes, and potential cost exposures to protect the client's financial interests.
* Oversee project QA/QC procedures and risk and issue registers; proactively resolve technical, commercial, and logistical challenges.

#### **Construction Management**

* Direct and oversee general contractors and multidisciplinary construction teams, lead OAC and project control group meetings, and assume primary responsibility for daytoday construction execution, including complex sequencing, site logistics, infrastructure coordination, and adherence to project quality, schedule, and budget objectives.
* Provide seniorlevel technical oversight of construction activities, critically evaluating structural systems, building envelopes, waterproofing, MEP installations, construction methodologies, and highend architectural finishes. Proactively identify deficiencies, resolve complex field conditions, and direct consultants and contractors in implementing technically sound solutions.
* Oversee the review and resolution of submittals, RFIs, shop drawings, substitution requests, change proposals, and change orders. Evaluate technical and commercial implications, challenge unnecessary costs or design complexities, and review and approve monthly payment requests in accordance with contractual requirements and delegated authority.
* Direct construction quality assurance and quality control activities, oversee special inspections, site safety compliance, insurance requirements, construction schedules, and FF and E installation. Monitor contractor performance and enforce accountability for workmanship, coordination, and adherence to the project's luxury design and construction standards.
* Oversee construction reporting and provide executive updates on milestones, financial performance, schedule risks, technical issues, and corrective actions.
* Direct substantial completion and project closeout activities, including inspections, punch lists, occupancy approvals, commissioning, record drawings, warranties, contract closeouts, final payments, digital turnover, and coordination with hospitality operators and client representatives to ensure operational readiness and successful handover.
* Other duties may be assigned.

#### **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* A minimum of a bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related technical field is required.
* A minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible construction or project management experience.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex, multidisciplinary design teams throughout the project life cycle.
* Proven ability to independently lead major construction developments, manage sophisticated international project teams, exercise sound technical and commercial judgment, and effectively resolve complex design and construction challenges.
* Must have excellent communication skills, both oral and written, with the ability to communicate effectively and confidently with clients, ownership representatives, consultants, contractors, and other project stakeholders.
* Must possess exceptional organizational, analytical, leadership, and problemsolving skills, with the ability to anticipate challenges, manage competing priorities, make independent decisions, and maintain accountability across multiple project disciplines.
* Must have strong written communication skills and proficiency with project management, scheduling, document control, and construction management software.
* Experience delivering complex projects in the Caribbean or comparable remote island environments is strongly preferred.

#### **WORK LOCATION**

* Remote; travel required

#### **BENEFITS**

* 401(k)
* 401(k) Company Contribution
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Flexible Spending Account
* Health Insurance
* Life Insurance
* Paid Time Off

#### **COMPANY WEBSITE**

* www.cmdintl.com

#### **About CM&D**

CM&D is a global real estate development and construction management firm with nearly 40 years of experience guiding complex projects from concept to completion. Through stewardship, collaboration, and professionalism, we serve as a seamless extension of our clients, delivering customized solutions that protect investments, solve challenges, and drive successful outcomes across industries and geographies.

Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

**Facility Condition Assessment – Technical Director, Asset Services**
======================================================================

**JLL Real Estate Due Diligence (JREDD) – Asset Service*****s***

* Serves as a senior leader within the Asset Services business of the JLL Real Estate Due Diligence (JREDD) division, providing strategic direction, national operational oversight, and executive-level client engagement for Facility Condition Assessment (FCA) in accordance with ASTM E2018, as well as Regulatory Compliance Audit (RCA) services.
* Reports to and partners directly with the Global Leader of Asset Services to shape and execute the business strategy, drive sustainable revenue growth, and uphold the highest standards of technical and professional excellence across the Asset Services platform.
* Provides enterprise-level leadership across technical operations, talent development, quality and risk management, and service innovation to advance JREDD’s position as the premier provider of real estate due diligence services.
* Directs complex, multi-market client portfolios and serves as a key executive relationship owner, representing Asset Services in strategic business development pursuits, industry forums, and client-facing engagements.
* Champions the development and continuous improvement of service delivery frameworks, technical standards, and operational processes to support scalable, high-quality FCA execution nationally.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
-----------------------------------------

* Leads and oversees national production operations of the Asset Services – Facility Condition practice, including supporting accountability for revenue targets, gross profit margin, and overall financial health of the business line.
* Exercises senior-level review authority over Facility Condition Assessment reports, ensuring alignment with JREDD quality standards, client-specific protocols, ASTM E2018, and applicable regulatory frameworks.
* Establishes and cultivates executive-level client relationships across key accounts, proactively identifying opportunities to expand service scope, resolve escalated issues, and align delivery with clients; evolving portfolio objectives.
* Collaborates with the Global Leader of Asset Services to define and implement the strategic vision for the business, including market expansion, service line innovation, and competitive positioning within the broader platform.
* Provides support for executive oversight of project management staff nationally, ensuring consistent application of policies, technical standards, and operational procedures across all geographies and service engagements.
* Serves as one of the division’s senior subject matter experts in areas including building systems and conditions, MEP, structural, building envelope, seismic risk, and ADA compliance in the context of Facility Condition Assessments.
* Drives enterprise-level business development efforts, including leading pursuit strategies, responding to RFPs, and presenting JREDD Asset Services capabilities to JLL Integrated Facility Management (IFM) accounts, JLL Real Estate Management Services (REMS) verticals, institutional clients, and investment managers.
* Leads the design, development, and governance of standardized service templates, scope frameworks, and field assessment tools to ensure scalable, repeatable delivery of FCA services.
* Actively monitors industry trends, regulatory developments, and emerging best practices to inform service evolution and maintain Asset Service’s technical leadership position.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**
--------------------------------

* Provides senior leadership and formal supervision across multiple functional and operational teams within the Asset Services – Facility Condition practice.
* Partners with the business leader to make final decisions regarding staff recruitment, selection, promotion, advancement, and corrective action for direct reports and their respective teams.
* Establishes and monitors staffing strategies, workforce planning, and resource allocation to align with budgeted revenue goals and service delivery demands nationally.
* Oversees performance management processes, including review cycles, development planning, and compensation recommendations for direct reports and their teams.
* Serves as a senior mentor and coach to the Asset Services team members to build bench strength and cultivate future leaders within the business.
* Models and reinforces leadership behaviors aligned with JLL’s values, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and professional excellence.

**QUALIFICATIONS, EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**
--------------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) in architecture, engineering, or a related technical discipline; advanced degree preferred.
* Minimum 15 years of progressively responsible commercial building evaluation experience, including extensive application of ASTM E2018 and Facility Condition Assessment methodologies across diverse asset classes.
* Minimum of 12 years of experience in client management, strategic account development, and leadership of multi-disciplinary technical service teams.
* Minimum of five (5) years of senior leadership experience with direct management of multi-level teams and demonstrated accountability for business line financial performance.
* Demonstrated track record of driving revenue growth, managing operational costs, and scaling technical service organizations in a national or multi-market context.
* Expert-level knowledge of FCA scope requirements, and specialty applications including seismic, roofing, building envelope, conveyance, ADA, and MEP evaluations.

**CERTIFICATES AND/OR LICENSES**
--------------------------------

* Active licensure as a Professional Engineer (PE) or Registered Architect (RA) required.

**COMMUNICATION SKILLS**
------------------------

* Exceptional ability to comprehend, analyze, and interpret complex business and technical documents and translate findings into actionable strategic recommendations for executive and client audiences.
* Distinguished written and verbal communication, interpersonal, and consultative skills, with the ability to represent JREDD and Asset Services at the highest levels of client and industry engagement.
* Proven ability to navigate and resolve sensitive, high-stakes issues with clients, regulatory bodies, and internal leadership, demonstrating sound judgment and diplomatic effectiveness.
* Accomplished presenter with experience delivering strategic briefings, technical content, and business case arguments to C-suite and board-level audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to inspire and influence clients, stakeholders, and team members to advance organizational objectives and service excellence.

**FINANCIAL KNOWLEDGE**
-----------------------

* Advanced knowledge of financial terms, principles, and performance metrics. Demonstrated ability to develop business cases, interpret financial statements, and manage complex P&L responsibilities across a multi-team service organization.

**REASONING ABILITY**
---------------------

* Exceptional analytical and strategic problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize complex data, competing priorities, and market intelligence to develop enterprise-level solutions. Exercises independent, expert judgment with broad impact on division performance and client outcomes.

**OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES**
------------------------------

* Advanced proficiency in technology platforms and Microsoft Office Suite; familiarity with project management, data analytics, and reporting tools relevant to technical due diligence services.
* Outstanding time management, organizational, and prioritization skills with demonstrated capacity to lead multiple high-value, concurrent engagements in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong negotiation skills with the ability to effectively engage and align key internal and external stakeholders around shared objectives.

**SCOPE OF RESPONSIBILITY**
---------------------------

* Exercises broad, autonomous decision-making authority grounded in expert understanding of JREDD and Asset Services policies, technical standards, business practices, and market conditions to achieve division objectives and long-range strategic goals.
* Responsible for setting and adjusting priorities, deadlines, and resource allocation across the Asset Services – Facility Condition practice at a national scale.
* Errors in judgment may have significant short- to mid-term financial, reputational, or operational impact on the Asset Services business and the broader JREDD division.

612b2f76a055fb68ef54.description:
***Job Title: Associate Client Success Director***

***Location: Philadelphia, PA***

Health Union powers the first and largest community-based activation and data platform, transforming healthcare by providing unparalleled support, information, and validation for millions navigating complex health conditions and their care teams. With over 125+ condition-specific online communities and 15 years of community leadership, Health Union’s authentic engagements fuel the company’s robust suite of endemic media, influencer marketing, market research, and data solutions, driving proven outcomes for patients, HCPs, and brands.

**Position Overview:** The Associate Client Success Director has a critical impact on the success of our business. The CS team is responsible for client service, campaign success, revenue growth, and driving Health Union’s reputation as an industry leader among our client partners.

**What You Do:**

* **Fostering Client Relationships and Success:** Serve as the main point of contact throughout the campaign life cycle
  + Manage day-to-day communication internally and externally by triaging client inquiries, ensuring timely follow-up and effective communication on campaign results
  + Help develop and/or compile program proposals and materials, RFPs, and participate in new business sales meetings.
  + Communicate regularly with clients to provide campaign updates, solve issues, and set realistic expectations; ensure all of their needs are understood and addressed
  + Create and maintain client campaign documentation and deliverables
  + Foster strong client relationships to maintain current business and influence incremental / renewal dollars
* **Collaborating Internally:** Support the internal delivery team to ensure a broad understanding of the client’s business, goals, and point of view to meet and exceed revenue goals
  + Plan and lead internal team meetings (i.e., kickoffs, weekly statuses, performance reviews, etc.) and ensure clarity and productivity (setting meeting agendas, logging notes, etc.)
  + Recommend product improvements based on performance feedback and internal execution
* **Tracking Campaign Performance:** Analyze client campaigns and 3rd party tracking
  + Review campaign metrics and measurement dashboards on a weekly basis and proactively determine action times and timely updates to the client
  + Partner with internal delivery teams to create and review monthly and quarterly client reports to determine whether KPIs are being met, where there is a need for improvement, and what’s being done to optimize for improvement
* **Impacting Revenue** (after “closed won”)
  + Actively identify opportunities to grow our revenue with current client accounts, and partner with sales on new program proposals and identify expansion and upsell opportunities
  + Develop program proposals and RFPs, and participate in external proposal meetings

**What You Bring:**

* Experience in the healthcare/pharma industry is highly valued

* **Troubleshooter** – solving client problems. HU’s first line of defense to understand and take ownership of the problem, communicate with the customer and coordinate communication, and help facilitate resolution with the internal teams
* **Positive attitude** - always interested in finding solutions to problems while keeping a positive, but realistic, can-do attitude internally and externally
* **Proactive** - acts on the chance to help secure incremental through performance highlights, pricing out incremental inventory, offering expanded channels
* **Performance tracker** – primary owner of overseeing KPIs and flagging any potential issues internally
* **Champion** – represents the customer within and outside their own department. The voice of the customer and the liaison between customers and internal delivery teams
* **Change maker** – striving for continuous improvement. Efficiency experts looking for better ways to serve clients, streamline processes and improve products/services
* **Project manager** – juggling tasks, projects and people. Coordinating with other departments to serve customers without duplicating efforts or letting things fall through the cracks

* **Leader** – maintain the account and take charge of its success
* **Solution-oriented** – anticipating hurdles and client needs before they occur. A proactive solution seeker
* **Sounding board** – Not only good listeners but putting themselves in their customers’ shoes. Not just about solving the problem at hand. It’s also about recognizing and acknowledging the emotions that go along with it
* **Subject Matter Expert** – having measurable and specific knowledge and abilities. Having product and service knowledge, as well as client expertise

Annual base salary for positions at this level and job group is $79,000-$105,000, and your base pay will depend on the qualifications, experience, skills, and competencies required for this job.

At Health Union, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range that provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role.

In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan, a professional development budget, and paid time off available to full-time employees upon hire. You will also be granted time off for designated company-paid holidays, summer Fridays, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

**HEALTH UNION REALLY IS THE BEST PLACE TO WORK**

As a dynamic organization that offers flexible work options, we foster a workplace that encourages an authentic, respectful culture of teaching and learning. We work hard and save space to form close-knit relationships that are meaningful to us individually. Health Union also offers top-tier benefits and other perks to full-time employees, starting day one. We cultivate a dynamic, collaborative work environment that values **inclusion, community, excellence, and transparency**. But don’t just take our word for it: The Philadelphia Inquirer, Philadelphia Business Journal, Inc., and Forbes have all named Health Union a “best place to work”-and we take pride in living up to that hype every day.

**Commitment to Inclusion**

At Health Union, we believe that individually we make a statement, but collectively we make an impact. Diversity and inclusion power that impact. We strive to create a sense of belonging by embracing our differences. We are an organization where everyone is valued, heard, and appreciated. 3f92c07ad3e59f00094a.description:
**Job Description**

: The Associate Medical Director, Global Medical Affairs Strategy (( [Nephrology and Immunology OR CNS OR Digital Medicine & Therapeutics] NS) supports Medical Directors and Franchise Leads to drive strategic and tactical excellence for assigned Otsuka assets. The incumbent will play a critical role for the execution and implementation of the Medical Affairs strategy by serving as a key member on relevant cross-functional teams, collaboration with regional affiliates and strong project management. This role will also serve as a subject matter expert in content creation, strategic and tactical discussions, and presentations with internal colleagues, as well as external experts and investigators. Other responsibilities include support of medical affairs research execution including but not limited to Phase IV studies and investigator-initiated trials.

Key Responsibilities:

Specific responsibilities include, but may not be limited to:

* Collaborating with Medical Affairs colleagues to develop and execute asset strategy and tactics with appropriate use of resources.
* Assist with product and therapeutic area expert in both internal and external venues including the Medical Affairs sub-teams, and advisory boards / steering committees.
* Support indication and/or franchise leads in providing medical input into all aspects of product development and promotion across the entire asset lifecycle.
* Provide high quality scientific/clinical input and review of disease strategy plans, publications and externally facing educational materials. Part of this responsibility includes ensuring that medical content aligns with Medical Affairs strategy and communication objectives.
* This role may be involved in review of medical content of promotional materials for accuracy as part of the Promotional Review Committee.
* Track priority Medical Affairs tactics and performance to goals/budget.
* Develop data gap analyses and scientific communication priorities.
* Conduct literature searches and prepare data summaries to support strategic decision-making.
* Coordinate with commercial colleagues to provide training to commercial personnel, as needed.
* Help provide direction for medical information specialists.
* Support execution of Medical Affairs evidence generation activities, where applicable.
* Develop educational objectives and review medical education grant requests, as needed.
* Travel (approximately 20%).

Qualifications:

* MD/DO, PharmD or PhD in life sciences required.
* 4+ years’ experience in pharmaceutical industry Medical Affairs with expertise in kidney disease and/or immunology OR CNS preferred (Experience in Clinical Development and/or Medical Communications Agencies may substitute for exceptional candidates)
* Launch experience preferred.
* Motivated and solution oriented with ability to work collaboratively across the organization.
* Demonstrated ability to successfully lead projects in a matrixed environment.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills including experience presenting to large groups.
* Has full understanding of rules and regulations in pharma, which could have impact for the pharmaceutical industry. Can apply knowledge of guidelines and regulations to Medical Affairs activities.
* Proficiency with computer productivity programs necessary to complete work requirements (e.g., MS Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint).
* Knowledge of Medical Affairs systems including Veeva and KOL mapping solutions an asset

**Competencies**  
**Accountability for Results -** Stay focused on key strategic objectives, be accountable for high standards of performance, and take an active role in leading change.
  
**Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving -** Make decisions considering the long-term impact to customers, patients, employees, and the business.
  
**Patient & Customer Centricity -** Maintain an ongoing focus on the needs of our customers and/or key stakeholders.
  
**Impactful Communication -** Communicate with logic, clarity, and respect. Influence at all levels to achieve the best results for Otsuka.
  
**Respectful Collaboration -** Seek and value others’ perspectives and strive for diverse partnerships to enhance work toward common goals.
  
**Empowered Development -** Play an active role in professional development as a business imperative.

1a7d8122f4b9007d6276.title: Director, Revenue Operations
1a7d8122f4b9007d6276.description:
For over 35 years, Peak Technologies has been at the forefront of providing end-to-end enterprise mobility, managed services, printing and mobile data capture solutions for performance-driven organizations focused on the optimization of supply chain and field-based business processes.
  
  
JOB SUMMARY & SCOPE
  
Lead Peak Technologies’ Sales Operations function, including sales planning, forecasting, compensation program management, performance reporting, Salesforce effectiveness, and leadership of Sales Operations Support (SOS) and commercial pre-sales support. Partner with the Chief Revenue Officer, sales leaders, and Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) to strengthen sales execution, improve productivity, and support revenue and margin goals. Establish consistent processes, reliable reporting, and effective commercial support across assigned teams.
  
KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
  

* Manage the weekly sales forecast call process, templates, and cadence in coordination with FP&A and Sales SVPs.
* Lead the annual sales quota and financial planning process with the respective sales leaders and FP&A.
* Lead annual sales compensation plan design and implementation in partnership with Sales, Finance, and HR; monitor related KPIs and plan effectiveness.
* Manage monthly sales KPIs, leaderboards, and productivity reporting, providing actionable insights to sales leadership.
* Participate in the preparation, reporting, and overall facilitation of sales quarterly business reviews (QBRs).
* Implement best practices for Salesforce (SFDC) utilization, including adoption, data quality, reporting, and consistent sales processes.
* Facilitate the development and implementation of annual or quarterly SPIFFs and other revenue acceleration programs.
* Support performance inspection at the sales representative and regional levels by providing RVPs with sales data, activity reporting, and performance insights.
* Lead SOS and commercial pre-sales support personnel, establishing clear responsibilities, performance expectations, and accountability.
* Develop staffing, workload allocation, coverage, and training plans aligned with business needs and sales activity.
* Oversee quote preparation and commercial support workflows to improve accuracy, responsiveness, and turnaround time.
* Ensure quotes and supporting documentation reflect approved pricing, applicable terms, and required internal approvals.
* Coordinate with Procurement and vendor partners on pricing, product availability, lead times, and information needed to support customer opportunities.
* Standardize sales support procedures, documentation, escalation paths, and handoffs across assigned teams and business units.
* Partner with Sales, Finance, Procurement, and service delivery teams to resolve commercial issues and support accurate transitions from quotation to order execution.
* Monitor support service levels, quote turnaround, accuracy, backlog, productivity, and rework; use findings to improve workflows and resource allocation.
* Partner with IT and business stakeholders to improve Salesforce, ERP, quoting tools, reporting, and automation supporting sales and commercial operations.
* Manage escalated support issues, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions.
* Coach and develop employees and people leaders, supporting performance management, succession planning, and organizational effectiveness.
* Provide leadership with reporting on operational performance, resource needs, risks, and improvement priorities.
* Promote a collaborative “One Peak” approach to supporting sellers, customers, and internal business partners.

EDUCATION + EXPERIENCE + KEY TRAITS
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Finance, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* Eight or more years of progressive experience in sales operations, commercial operations, or related functions, including sales planning, forecasting, and performance analysis.
* Five or more years of experience leading teams, including responsibility for staffing, performance management, and employee development.
* Experience supporting a technology reseller, distributor, systems integrator, or technology services organization preferred.
* Demonstrated experience managing sales forecasting, quota and financial planning, sales compensation programs, and commercial support workflows.
* Experience driving Salesforce adoption, data quality, reporting, and process improvements; familiarity with ERP, quoting, and business intelligence tools.
* Strong analytical skills, including the ability to translate sales, financial, and activity data into actionable reporting, QBR materials, and performance recommendations.
* Working knowledge of pricing, gross margin, sales incentive structures, and approval controls.
* Proven ability to standardize processes and improve service quality, productivity, and operational efficiency.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to lead change, manage competing priorities, and establish accountability across distributed teams.
* Collaborative, service-oriented leadership style with sound business judgment and a continuous improvement mindset.

TYPICAL PERFORMANCE TARGETS
  

* SERVICE DELIVERY: Deliver timely, reliable forecasts, sales reporting, planning cycles, compensation program implementation, and commercial support.
* COST TO SERVE: Improve sales and support productivity through effective resource planning, standardized processes, and reductions in manual effort and rework.
* INNOVATION: Improve sales execution through Salesforce adoption, automation, incentive programs, and actionable performance insights.

LANGUAGE SKILLS
  

* Primary language used in daily operations is English. Additional primary company languages include Spanish, French, and Dutch.
* Read and interpret documents, procedure manuals and various correspondence from both internal and external.
* Speak effectively, both individually and before groups of both external customers and/or various levels of employees within the organization.

SUPERVISION
  

* Responsible for the supervision and development of assigned Sales Operations, SOS, and commercial pre-sales support personnel, including managers or team leads where applicable. Responsibilities include staffing, workload allocation, goal setting, coaching, performance evaluation, and employee development.

DECISION MAKING + REASONING
  

* Exercise independent judgment in sales operations planning, reporting, commercial support, resource allocation, and issue resolution. Evaluate sales, operational, and financial information to recommend improvements and support leadership decisions. Coordinate quota, compensation, and incentive recommendations with the appropriate leaders and operate within established policies and delegated authority.

WORKING RELATIONSHIPS
  

* Chief Revenue Officer, Sales SVPs, RVPs, and other sales leaders.
* Sales Operations, SOS, and commercial pre-sales support teams.
* Sales representatives and account management teams.
* FP&A, Finance, credit, billing, and payroll teams.
* Procurement and vendor management teams.
* IT and business systems teams.
* Service delivery and order fulfillment teams.
* Human Resources.
* OEM, distributor, and other vendor partners.
* Customers, as needed to resolve escalated commercial support issues.

def585e730334a7945e1.description:
***ABOUT MEITHEAL PHARMACEUTICALS***

*Founded in 2017 and based in Chicago, Meitheal is focused on the development and commercialization of generic injectable medications and, as of 2022, has expanded its focus to include fertility, biologic, and branded products. Meitheal currently markets over 75 U.S. FDA-approved products across numerous therapeutic areas including anti-infectives, oncolytics, intensive care, and fertility. As of April 2026, Meitheal, directly or through its partners, has 32 products in the research and development phase, 9 products planned for launch in 2026, 4 products in clinical trial phases, and 13 products under review by the FDA. Meitheal’s mission is to provide easy access to fairly priced products through robust manufacturing, consistent supply, and rapid response to our customers’ needs. Ranked regularly as one of Crain’s Fast 50 in Chicago, and in the top 100 of Crain’s Best Places to Work in Chicago from 2022 to 2026, Meitheal emulates the traditional Irish guiding principle we are named for—working together toward a common goal, for the greater good.*

*Learn more about who we are and what we do at* *www.meithealpharma.com**.*

***The pay range for this position is $115,000 to $155,000 / year. Payrate is determined by considering a person's prior experience and competence.***

*The estimated salary range reflects an anticipated range for this position. The actual base salary offered may depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job. The actual base salary offered will be in accordance with state or local minimum wage requirements for the job location.*

***What We Offer***

* *Competitive pay and medical, dental, and vision insurance*
* *Flexible spending accounts*
* *Long- and short-term disability insurance, as well as life insurance*
* *401(k) plan with match*
* *Competitive PTO and company-paid holidays*
* *Paid parental leave (maternity & paternity)*
* *Employee assistance program*

**Summary**

The Associate Director Marketing - Biosimilars & Women’s Health will contribute to establishing the marketing function at an emerging biopharmaceutical company aiming to bring biosimilars to market. This role will support the development and execution of marketing strategies and commercial initiatives for the company’s growing biosimilar and women’s health portfolio including brand strategy, content creation, product naming and branding support, market research support, launch planning support, congress preparation, and agency management.

The ideal candidate will apply knowledge of the biosimilar industry and promotional standards to contribute to the creation of compliant, compelling content and promotional materials across the biosimilar lifecycle. This will include a combination of agency collaboration and management as well as in-house material creation. Additionally, the role will actively participate in the promotional review process, own responses to questions and comments related to assigned materials and help move content efficiently through approval.

This is not a maintenance role, but a build. This individual will provide input to help shape and scale the biosimilar marketing function including developing processes and ways of working e.g., workflows, material storage, and documentation.

**Essential Responsibilities**

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following:

* Contribute to the development of value proposition strategies that effectively communicate the benefits, outcomes, and cost-effectiveness of products to payers and other organized customers.
* Collaborate closely with the biosimilar/fertility team to align go-to-market strategies with overall Meitheal strategy, ensuring appropriate consistency.
* Work in concert with internal stakeholders to ensure alignment of pricing and contracting strategies with overall commercial objectives and biosimilar/fertility strategy.
* Monitor competitive pricing and contracting activities, and proactively identify opportunities and threats to inform strategic decisions including pricing and contracting.
* Oversee the implementation of contract strategies and contracting platforms, including bid processes, negotiations, and pricing analytics.
* Coordinate operational activities such as rebates, chargebacks, and government reporting, ensuring compliance with pharmaceutical regulations.
* Work with Biosimilar Operations team to support development of reimbursement programs, physician and patient resources to address barriers to access of Meitheal products including, but not limited to coding and billing guides, patient copay programs etc.
* Coordinate with external experts and internal teams as needed to facilitate informed decision making with respect to go-to-market strategies required for successful launch of Meitheal Biosimilar platform.
* Execute contract strategies tailored to the unique landscape of biosimilars, ensuring alignment with business goals and regulatory requirements.
* Manage operational budgeting and forecasting processes, ensuring financial justification for contract strategies and offerings based on ROI and sound business judgment.
* Collaborate with Biosimilar operations to provide comprehensive business analytics support, gathering and analyzing market intelligence and competitive data to inform strategic decision-making.
* Foster collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders, including Legal, Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Finance, Quality, and Human Resources, to achieve corporate objectives effectively.
* Support growth and cross collaboration between Meitheal's Women's Health Division.

**Competencies**

* Business Acumen
* Judgement
* Change Management
* Project Management
* Ethics
* Interpersonal

**Qualifications**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* The successful candidate will be able to work across a broad range of therapeutic areas and understand how to communicate value in the biosimilar industry, where clinical novelty is not the main differentiator. This is a role is a great fit for someone with a strong execution focus and creative/efficiency mindset that is comfortable in a build environment without rigid, established processes.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing marketing strategy, brand plans, promotional content, or commercial materials in a regulated healthcare environment.
* Experience participating in a promotional, medical-legal-regulatory, or comparable review and approval process.
* Working knowledge of applicable pharmaceutical advertising and promotional requirements, industry standards, and internal compliance practices.
* Experience with product launch planning, positioning, messaging, market research, congress planning, and commercial readiness activities.
* Experience managing marketing agencies, creative agencies, research vendors, or other external partners.
* Ability to work effectively with Medical, Legal, Regulatory, Clinical, Market Access, Sales, and other cross-functional teams.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and deliverables with strong organization and follow-through.
* Willingness and ability to travel for company meetings, agency meetings, congresses, and other business needs.

*Strongly Preferred:*

* Biosimilar industry experience.
* Experience with customer relationship management systems, marketing automation platforms, or commercial analytics tools.
* Ability to contribute expertise to additional marketing tasks as requested e.g., Hub services, Market Access, Corporate initiatives.

**Education and/or Experience Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, life sciences, pharmacy, communications, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
* 6+ years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or life sciences; experience with biosimilars strongly preferred.

**Computer Skills**

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and Outlook.
* Familiarity with digital marketing platforms, content management systems, collaboration tools, and virtual meeting platforms.
* Ability to create clear, polished presentations and marketing materials using standard office and presentation software.
* Ability to learn and effectively use company-specific systems for content review, approval, document control, project tracking, and portfolio management.

**Work Environment**

* The ability to travel up to 25%, including overnights, as dictated by business need and attend all company sponsored events/meetings/conferences.
* Field-base Role/Remote.
* While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is frequently required to stand; walk; sit and talk or hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds.

***AAP/EEO***

*Meitheal Pharmaceuticals is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, including minorities, women, veterans, and individuals with disabilities.*

e39a832cbb37efb682b8.title: Regional Insights and Engagement Director, PDAC, Southeast
e39a832cbb37efb682b8.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

**The Opportunity:**

The Regional Insights and Engagement Director, Southeast is a field-based position focused on working closely with PDAC Cancer Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) at select institutions and accounts within the defined geography. This person is a RevMed clinical and product expert for Key Opinion Leaders and ensures that cross-functional resources are made available as appropriate. In this role, you will be a member of the commercial development team, and you will work closely with marketing, medical affairs, field sales, insights and analytics and other cross functional colleagues. You will help inform brand strategy, develop and execute KOL tactics and you will be evaluated in conjunction with individual performance and brand KPIs.

This role will cover major academic institutions, accounts, and the Key Opinion Leaders located in the Northeast.

Essential Duties:

* Designs, executes, and implements significant national strategic marketing deliverables.
* Applies leading-edge clinical and marketplace knowledge and professional concepts to influence the scientific direction of practicing oncologists to support the company and to achieve objectives in creative and effective ways.
* Expert knowledge of clinical practice and rationale for decision-making in PDAC.
* Reputation as a leader in their field across the organization and externally.
* A strategic leader and role model within the commercial team.
* Acutely aware of the impact of decisions across the business and acts with enterprise point of view.
* Collaborates with senior internal and external representatives to achieve objectives.
* Acts independently to determine methods and procedures on new assignments.
* Supports the US launch of RevMed molecules in the lung cancer marketplace and guides marketers supporting field team regarding customer needs.
* Acts as an ambassador of the company.
* Cultivates exceptional partnerships with external KOLs and partners, understands sentiments and influences commercial strategy with internal partners and stakeholders.
* Leads the development of Key Account engagement plans and congress plans for each assigned KOL for the commercial team.
* Plays a key role in enabling and influencing the understanding and opinion of diseases, mechanisms of diseases, and the potential role of products in the management of these diseases using on-label and approved marketing material.
* Executes integrated commercial and marketing strategic plans at national/regional scientific meetings with collaborative and aligned purpose.
* Partner with Sales, Medical Affairs, Market Access, and Commercial Operations & Business Analytics teams to ensure alignment of RevMed’s US commercialization strategy; Uncovers, prioritizes, and communicates market insights, challenges/barriers, and solutions to the organization.
* Develops promotional peer-to-peer content and programming including product theaters and other conference promotional education in alignment with annual congress plan.
* Develops and executes integrated commercial advisory boards to gain insights that will inform brand strategies.
* Contributes actively on all key marketing deliverables including QBR, brand/tactical planning, and Launch Readiness Reviews.
* Assists in the development of promotional speaker bureaus which may involve speaker identification and recruitment, attending and supporting speaker training meetings. Additional follow-on speaker training activities may be required to ensure accurate and effective presentations.
* Complies with all laws, regulations and policies that govern the conduct of RevMed activities.

**Required Skills, Experience and Education:**

* MA/MS degree in related discipline desired; or BA/BS degree in a related discipline with at least 10 years of related experience.
* Field-Based Regional Marketing/ TLL experience.
* Other related experience (e.g., market research, healthcare agency, consulting, etc.).
* Knowledge of KOLs and compliant KOL development practices.
* Ability to present ideas effectively to individuals or groups, targeting presentation to the needs of the audience.
* Oncology experience.
* Launch experience.
* Valid driver's license.
* Must reside within the geographic area of the assigned territory.
* Ability to travel to meetings/training/programs (~65% travel required).

**Preferred Skills:**

* Advanced degree preferred (MBA, PharmD, PhD).
* Equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Expert knowledge of relevant products, their associated therapeutic areas, competitors, and other related marketplace factors (lung cancer preferred).
* Strong organization, planning, project management, and analytical skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Ability to work independently to execute strategic and tactical plans under tight timelines.
* Ability to assemble and lead cross-functional teams toward a shared vision of success.
* Ability to lead, mentor and on-board newer members of the team.
* Highly proficient in Microsoft suite including PowerPoint, Excel, Word.

**About Davis Graham & Stubbs LLP**

For over a century, Davis Graham & Stubbs LLP (Davis Graham) has ranked among the region's most prominent law firms, consistently delivering high-quality legal services to emerging and established businesses across the Mountain West. We are the leading independent law firm in our region, offering AmLaw 50 quality at a distinct value - a true differentiator for sophisticated businesses facing major legal challenges within our recognized specialties.

  

Davis Graham is recognized as the leading firm for middle-market and lower-middle-market M&A, finance and corporate governance work, with particular depth in the energy, private equity, hospitality, and technology sectors. Our litigators hold a dominant position in high-stakes cases across the region, most notably in complex commercial disputes, environmental and energy litigation, and enforcement and investigations.

  

While our firm's Denver location and intermediate size allow strong, collaborative relationships with local and regional clients, our broad experience and innovative use of technology enable us to partner effectively with businesses and their investors throughout the country and internationally. We are committed to a culture of professional excellence—attracting top-tier talent, investing in our people, and delivering exceptional results for our clients. Davis Graham is a firm defined by a hardworking partnership, an ownership mentality, and a deep commitment to one another and our clients.

  

**Summary**

The Financial Systems Manager is responsible for managing the Financial Systems department, which involves technical research, evaluation, recommendation, development, testing, installation, configuration, documentation, support and solution best practices for designated financial-related processes and software/applications. Responsible for administration and maintenance of designated financial-related applications including development of financial reports, dashboards, workflows, and integrations with other software products. Works with others within the Finance department to plan, establish, and manage projects in collaboration with members of the Information Technology department.

  

**Essential Functions**
