eb7bc734db26da88c417.title: Director I, AP English Language and Composition, Curriculum and Assessment
eb7bc734db26da88c417.description:
**Director I, AP English Language and Composition**

**College Board – Advanced Placement & Instruction (AP&I)**

**Location:** This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

**Role Type**: This is a full-time position

**About the Team**

The AP Curriculum and Assessment Team at College Board (125+ staff) collaborates with colleagues across all aspects of the AP Program to develop, manage, and deliver AP’s 43 courses in a wide variety of subject areas. AP® is a rigorous academic program built on the commitment, passion, and hard work of students and educators from secondary schools and higher education. AP provides willing and academically prepared high school students with the opportunity to study and learn at the college level. AP’s course teams comprised of educators and disciplinary experts ensure that course curricula are aligned to higher education expectations and reflect the state of the art in the discipline, contribute to instructional resources and tools for teachers, and develop assessments that allow students in these courses to demonstrate their mastery of course content and skills. AP leads in strategic use of AI to expand student access, strengthen instructional design and professional support, and enhance assessment creation and exam analysis.

The English, World Languages, and Arts department, which includes English Literature, English Language, Spanish Language, Italian Language, French Language, German Language, Chinese Language, Japanese Language, Latin, Music Theory, Spanish Literature, and Art and Design is currently comprised of approximately 35 people supporting 14 courses in the AP portfolio. The Science department, which includes biology, chemistry, physics, psychology, environmental science, and Research, is currently comprised of approximately 25 people supporting 10 courses in the AP portfolio. The History and Social Science department, which includes history, art history, human geography, government and politics, economics, business, African American studies, and Seminar, is currently comprised of approximately 35 people supporting 12 courses in the AP portfolio. The Math, Computer Science, and Cybersecurity department, which includes precalculus, calculus, statistics, computer science, cybersecurity, and networking is currently comprised of approximately 22 people supporting 6 courses in the AP portfolio.

**About the Opportunity**

As the Director I, AP English Language and Composition, you will be responsible for preserving and improving the quality and validity of the AP Program’s core deliverables within the subject domain: the exam, the course curriculum, and the professional development content. You are also responsible for item development and management from authoring to administration; training and collaborating with subject-matter experts (SMEs), typically college professors and secondary school teachers. You will ethically and effectively integrate AI technologies in assessment creation and review. This includes judiciously using AI assisted tools to support fairness, validity, and innovation in AP assessments. You will train SMEs on assessment development protocols, translate between academics and technical experts (psychometricians), and collaborate to develop formative assessment materials and resources to support AP English Language and Composition teachers worldwide.

  

You will serve as a point of contact in AP for committees and communities of subject-matter experts and will be responsible for the curriculum and assessment for AP English Language and Composition, and, in partnership with other AP teams, further the strategic growth of AP English Language and Composition across the globe. Additionally, you may have the opportunity to present, speak, and moderate dialogue with academic and membership audiences to ensure that ongoing change and improvement within AP courses and exams is understood, accepted, and supported in secondary and post-secondary educational communities.

*In this role, you will:*

*Assessment Development and Scoring (45-75%)*

* Serve as an assessment leader for AP English Language and Composition, with primary responsibility for assessment development for AP English Language and Composition. Your work in developing and revising test content is of the quality that requires only minimal adjustments based on feedback from your manager and other program leaders.
* Independently lead processes for authoring and revising assessment content, including training educator constituents and leveraging generative AI to author and/or review assessment content, improving and/or making more efficient assessment processes and outputs.
* Independently lead the development and management of assessment content (formative and summative) and scoring materials for AP English Language and Composition through iterative review stages with multiple internal and external stakeholders, including the AP English Language and Composition Team, Assessment Production team, Test Development Committee, and the Chief Reader, as appropriate.
* Independently lead the development of assessment forms for AP English Language and Composition, ensuring the AP Exam development aligns with approved curricula and test specifications.
* Lead multiple face-to-face, weekend meetings, and virtual meetings (during work week, evenings, or weekends) annually with the AP English Language and Composition Test Development Committee. You strategize and develop an agenda and approach to ensure the committee’s meeting time is of the highest productivity; you successfully adapt and pivot during the meeting as needed; and you successfully resolve all post-meeting item content edits.
* Train and directly supervise Test Development Committee members in AP English Language and Composition as content development contributors and reviewers. Recruit educators for the AP English Language and Composition Development Committee and other opportunities to support AP Program.
Lead the successful scoring of student responses for AP English Language and Composition Exams at the annual scoring event in person and online—the “AP Reading”—and produce AP Reading publications materials for teacher and student use. You plan all year, with increasing intensity in the months leading up to the Reading, ensuring all workflow steps for this incredibly complex event, as well as all post-Reading activities, are accounted for and successfully executed.  

  

*Assessment Quality and Process (10-15%)*

* Contribute to current research and best practices in assessment, and engage regularly with AP Curriculum & Assessment colleagues to align on standards and shared principles guiding AP’s assessment directions
* Support assessment workstreams within the AP English, Language, and World Languages department.
* Contribute to processes for efficient, high-quality assessment development.
* Contribute to initiatives to refine and improve question task models as well as exam design in collaboration with AP Curriculum & Assessment leaders and aligned to other College Board initiatives to achieve psychometric and disciplinary best practices on AP English Language and Composition exams.
* Monitor exam validity, security, reliability, fairness, and quality, as well as reader reliability in accordance with established Program thresholds for AP English Language and Composition exam, identifying areas for improvement and executing on targeted improvement initiatives.
* Collaborate with psychometrics and AP Curriculum & Assessment staff to establish fair, reliable, and valid cut scores for AP English Language and Composition exam.

*Course Development, Program Support, and Stakeholder Engagement (5-25%)*

  

* Refine and improve AP English Language and Composition Course Framework to ensure clear and explicit learning outcomes that align with strategic priorities, including ensuring college/disciplinary standards as well as expanding the scope of reaching a broader audience of AP students.
* Collaborate with AP teams to support the development of new products for AP English Language and Composition designed to address unmet teacher instructional needs, potentially including developing prototypes, participating in small-scale market-testing, and creating models for subsequent development in conjunction with other AP workstreams.
* Recruit educators for the AP English Language and Composition Development Committee and other opportunities to support AP Program.
* Serve as a recognized and trusted resource within the educator community by collaboration and engagement with the community to drive teacher satisfaction with AP Course English Language and Composition Collaborate with the AP Professional learning team to support AP English Language and Composition consultants and teachers.
* Work with the AP Higher Education team to co-develop and implement plans to raise college and university awareness of AP English Language and Composition courses and exams, including recruiting college faculty to participate in the AP Reading, co-leading the planning and execution of discipline-specific AP Faculty Colloquia events, and supporting Visiting and Virtual Fellows Programs.

**About You**

*You (have):*

* A Master’s degree in English Language and Composition or a directly related discipline, and knowledge of current trends in the discipline (required), although a doctorate in the discipline is strongly preferred
* Expertise in English Language and Composition with at least 5 years of experience in standardized assessment development or related work; experience with digital assessment and teaching preferred
* Strong oral and written communication skills, with solid technical proficiency and a customer-focused mindset
* Excellent organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and maintain close attention to detail, including proofreading
* Demonstrated ability to implement processes and procedures, manage project plans and schedules, and maintain tracking documentation
* Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across all levels, and engage in giving and receiving constructive feedback
* Ability to travel 6-8 times per year, plus up to two additional weeks for the AP Reading; must be eligible to work in the United States

All roles at College Board require:

* A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
* Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
* Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
* A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
* A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
* A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success
* Authorization to work in the United States

**About Our Process**

* Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as item review and analysis, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.  

  

**What We Offer**

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck- we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  

* The hiring range for this role is $96,000–$135,000.
* Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
* We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
* We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

**Clyde S. Walton, Inc. | Lansdale, PA**

**Job Type:** Full-Time | In-Person

About Us

Clyde S. Walton, Inc. is a fourth-generation, family-owned heating, cooling, and energy company proudly serving Montgomery, Bucks, and Lehigh Counties. For generations, we have built our reputation on exceptional customer service, quality workmanship, and treating our customers and employees like family.

We are looking for a highly organized, motivated, and detail-oriented **Installation Coordinator** to join our growing team.

Position Overview

The Installation Coordinator plays a critical role in keeping our HVAC installation department running smoothly and efficiently. This individual is responsible for coordinating installation schedules, communicating with customers, supporting our sales and installation teams, and ensuring that every job is properly prepared, documented, and completed.

The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys working with people, and takes pride in staying organized and following through on commitments.

**If you enjoy coordinating multiple projects, solving problems, and being the person who keeps everything moving, this could be an excellent opportunity for you.**

* Coordinate daily and upcoming installation schedules with the Installation Supervisor.
* Communicate with homeowners to confirm installation dates, arrival expectations, and project details.
* Ensure installation crews have the information, documentation, and resources necessary to complete their assigned jobs.
* Coordinate equipment deliveries, rentals, subcontractors, and other project requirements.

* Assist with vehicle maintenance scheduling and other departmental administrative responsibilities.
* Support special projects and process improvements as assigned.

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.

* Familiarity with work orders, job scheduling, and field service management software.
* Experience coordinating field technicians or installation crews.

**HVAC experience is a plus, but not required. We are willing to train the right person who possesses strong organizational skills, a positive attitude, and a commitment to excellent customer service.**

What We're Looking For

We want someone who:

* Thinks ahead and anticipates problems before they occur.
* Understands the importance of keeping customers informed.
* Is comfortable juggling multiple responsibilities without losing track of the details.
* Takes initiative rather than waiting to be told what to do.
* Can communicate effectively with technicians, salespeople, management, and customers.
* Remains calm and professional when schedules change or unexpected challenges arise.
* Takes pride in being part of a team and helping others succeed.

Why Join Clyde S. Walton, Inc.?

You'll be joining an established, family-owned company where your contributions matter and where you'll play an important role in delivering an exceptional customer experience.

Apply Today

6b4814fb6e6da8962982.title: Inbound Sales Specialist
6b4814fb6e6da8962982.description:
**Inbound Sales Specialist**
============================

**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Location:** Remote  
**Apply here:** https://operationsarmy.com/application

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for a motivated, customer-focused Inbound Sales Specialist to join a growing healthcare technology company. This is an opportunity for a sales professional who knows how to turn inbound inquiries into qualified opportunities and wants to develop their skills in consultative selling and closing.

This is not a traditional cold-calling role. You will primarily engage with prospects who have already expressed interest, understand their needs, explain relevant solutions, and guide them through the early stages of the sales process.

You should be comfortable managing a high volume of leads, conducting sales conversations over the phone and video, and following up consistently to keep opportunities moving. The ideal candidate combines strong communication skills with a competitive mindset, disciplined organization, and a desire to achieve measurable results.

You will initially work alongside an existing sales team, qualifying prospects and advancing opportunities. As you gain experience and demonstrate strong performance, you will take on greater responsibility for managing your pipeline and closing customers.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Inbound Sales & Lead Qualification**

* Respond promptly to inbound inquiries and engage prospective customers through phone and video conversations.
* Understand prospects’ needs, challenges, and goals through thoughtful questions.
* Qualify leads based on their needs, level of interest, and suitability for the company’s services.
* Identify customer pain points and determine appropriate next steps.
* Explain the company’s offerings and communicate their value clearly.
* Prioritize incoming leads and manage a high volume of prospect interactions.
* Schedule sales conversations and ensure qualified opportunities are passed to the appropriate team members.
* Maintain a positive and professional experience throughout each interaction.

### **Prospect Engagement & Follow-Up**

* Follow up consistently with interested prospects to maintain engagement and move opportunities forward.
* Re-engage prospects who have not responded or need additional time to make a decision.
* Address initial questions, understand concerns, and identify potential objections.
* Keep track of conversations, commitments, and follow-up deadlines.
* Manage multiple prospects without losing track of important opportunities.
* Support the sales team during periods of high inbound lead volume.
* Ensure every qualified prospect has a clear next step.

### **CRM & Sales Pipeline Management**

* Maintain accurate CRM records, including contact details, call notes, activities, and opportunity status.
* Document prospect needs, qualification outcomes, and follow-up plans.
* Keep sales information organized and current.
* Track sales activities and progress against established performance targets.
* Identify opportunities to improve lead response times, follow-up consistency, and conversion rates.
* Collaborate with sales colleagues to maintain visibility across the pipeline.

### **Growth Into Sales Closing**

As you develop product knowledge and demonstrate strong performance, you will have the opportunity to:

* Take ownership of qualified sales opportunities.
* Conduct discovery calls and sales conversations independently.
* Present solutions that address specific customer needs.
* Handle objections and guide prospects through purchasing decisions.
* Manage your own pipeline and maintain momentum toward closing.
* Take increasing responsibility for closing customers against agreed sales targets.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

### **Must-Haves**

* At least 1–3+ years of experience in inside sales, sales development, business development, or a comparable customer-facing sales role.
* Experience handling a high volume of leads, prospect interactions, or sales conversations.
* Excellent spoken and written English.
* A confident, professional phone presence and strong interpersonal communication skills.
* Experience qualifying prospects and identifying customer needs or pain points.
* Strong follow-up habits and the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
* Experience working toward sales quotas, conversion targets, activity metrics, or similar KPIs.
* Experience using a CRM to track prospects, sales activities, and follow-ups.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to learn new products and explain their value to prospective customers.
* Self-motivated, coachable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
* Based in the United States and available during U.S. business hours.

### **Strong Plus**

* Previous experience in inbound sales or lead qualification.
* Experience conducting discovery calls or consultative sales conversations.
* Experience advancing opportunities or closing deals.
* SaaS or technology-enabled services sales experience.
* SMB sales experience.
* Healthcare technology sales experience.
* Experience managing short sales cycles and high lead volumes.
* A track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.

Previous experience in the specific industry is not required. We value strong sales fundamentals, consistent execution, and the ability to learn quickly.

**Working Style**
-----------------

You should enjoy engaging with prospects, asking questions, understanding customer needs, and helping people determine whether a solution is right for them.

This role requires someone who understands that speed and consistency matter in inbound sales. You should be comfortable balancing multiple conversations, prioritizing leads, and following through without constant reminders.

You should also be motivated by measurable performance and willing to use coaching and feedback to improve. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their work rather than simply completing assigned calls or tasks.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

Success means responding promptly to inbound inquiries, qualifying prospects accurately, maintaining consistent follow-up, and helping the sales team convert interest into opportunities.

As you grow in the role, success will also mean managing a pipeline independently, leading effective sales conversations, handling objections, and closing customers against agreed targets.

If you’re organized, persistent, customer-focused, and motivated to grow your sales career, we’d love to hear from you.

**Apply here:** https://operationsarmy.com/application

**Audit QA & Project Coordinator (1099 Contract, Part-Time)**

**Revu Healthcare | Remote | Up to 20 hours per week**

**About Revu Healthcare**

Revu Healthcare is a healthcare compliance advisory firm that performs retrospective documentation and coding reviews for hospitals, physician practices, and specialty providers. Our reviews span outpatient specialties, DRG validation, home health and hospice, ESRD dialysis, and remote patient monitoring. We deliver accurate, defensible findings in clear language our clients can act on.

**The Engagement**

We're seeking an experienced, certified coding professional to coordinate audit projects from handoff through final deliverables. This is an independent contractor (1099) engagement of up to 20 hours per week, with hours varying based on project volume. You'll serve as the day-to-day point of contact for clients on your assigned projects and work closely with the Director of Operations and our consulting team to keep reviews accurate, organized, and on schedule.

**Scope of Work**

*Project coordination*

* Take over assigned projects at handoff, confirm each account has the documentation needed for review, and request and track any missing documentation from the client
* Send consultants their project assignment details and Teams notification, and run the internal project kickoff
* Hold a weekly 15-minute project touchpoint with the consultants on each assigned project to review progress, QA feedback, questions, and upcoming deadlines
* Track account progress against project timelines and manage short timeline extensions according to Revu procedures
* Participate in regular Audit Operations check-ins with the Director of Operations (currently Monday, Wednesday, and Friday)

  

*Quality assurance*

* Perform quality assurance reviews of consultant findings for coding accuracy, guideline support, and consistent rationale
* Maintain audit worksheets and account status tracking so project information is current and accurate

  

*Client communication*

* Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for clients on assigned projects, beginning at the external kickoff call
* Send each client a weekly progress update every Friday
* Escalate missing documentation, access issues, timeline risks, and other concerns early, following Revu's escalation path

  

*Deliverables and rebuttals*

* Draft preliminary and final verbal readouts for Director of Operations approval, then send approved readouts to the client
* Initiate and track the 14-business-day client rebuttal period, escalating when a response is at risk
* Cross-check rebuttal outcomes against preliminary findings
* Support preparation of written reports

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Active Certified Professional Coder (CPC) credential through AAPC, held for 5 or more years and in good standing
* 5 or more years of professional coding experience
* Strong working knowledge of ICD-10-CM, CPT, and HCPCS Level II coding guidelines
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and comfort with Word, PowerPoint, and Microsoft Teams
* Strong attention to detail and clear, professional written communication
* Ability to protect PHI and follow HIPAA requirements
* Reliable, secure internet connection and own computer equipment

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in both coding audits and production coding
* Inpatient coding knowledge, including ICD-10-PCS and MS-DRG assignment
* Quality assurance experience reviewing other coders' or auditors' work
* Project management or project coordination experience
* Additional credentials such as CPMA, CIC, COC, CCS, or RHIT/RHIA

  

**Engagement Details**

* **Classification:** Independent contractor (1099); **no benefits are provided.**
* **Hours:** Up to 20 per week **based on workload**; no minimum is guaranteed
* **Time zone:** Revu Healthcare operates on Eastern Time (ET). All deadlines and meeting times follow Eastern Time unless otherwise identified.
* **Location:** Remote. Candidates must reside in and perform all work from within the United States; no exceptions.
  + Due to the nature of our client engagements and requirements for handling protected health information, we can only consider candidates who reside in and perform all work from within the United States.
* **Invoicing:** Biweekly

  

**Selection Process and Onboarding**

* **Written assessment:** 20 questions covering coding, quality assurance, project oversight, administrative tasks, and communication and feedback.

* **Hands-on QA exercise:**

* **Onboarding:** QA two-to-three sets of mock accounts in Revu's audit worksheet, using fictional medical records based on real review scenarios, then shadows a live project before coordinating projects independently.

  

As part of the selection process, candidates will be required to complete a candidate assessment covering coding, quality assurance, project oversight, and administrative tasks.

8fc6c28c4764b5dcba3d.description:
Overview:

Sprout is a global IT hardware retirement provider for hyperscaler and enterprise clients. We leverage a nationwide footprint (and international partner network) combined with proprietary software to enable efficient end-to-end IT asset disposition with a focus on data-bearing devices from the client to the cloud. The company is headquartered in Charlotte, NC with additional operations near Sacramento, Dallas, and Boston. Sprout provides software and services to clients in the form of our IT Asset Disposition, Certified Destruction, and Responsible Recycling solutions.

Since our founding as an electronic waste startup from a Duke University dorm room in 2014, we have been expanding at an average rate of >50% each year. By adhering to our 3 values (One Sprout, Deliver Excellence, and Integrity Matters), we are proud of our culture to move at #SproutSpeed seeking to become the emerging leader in our industry

The Technical Project Manager owns datacenter hardware projects across the full asset lifecycle — from initial buildout and infrastructure configuration, through steady-state operations handover, to end-of-life decommissioning and disposition. This role is the single point of accountability that keeps complex, multi-vendor hardware programs on schedule, on budget, and on spec while coordinating engineering, facilities, supply chain, and vendor teams. It is a delivery-focused role for someone equally comfortable in a project plan and on a datacenter floor, and who can translate technical detail into clear stakeholder communication.

Responsibilities:

* Plan and manage datacenter buildout projects end to end — site readiness, rack and power layout, cabling, and network fabric — against defined milestones
* Coordinate facilities, engineering, and vendor teams to deliver hardware installation on schedule and to spec
* Manage scope, dependencies, and site logistics across concurrent buildout efforts
* Drive the build and configuration of compute, storage, and network infrastructure to specification
* Manage burn-in, validation, and acceptance testing before production release
* Ensure configurations, firmware, and standards are consistent and documented across deployments
* Lead the transition of newly deployed infrastructure into steady-state operations
* Ensure runbooks, monitoring, documentation, and support ownership are in place before handover
* Confirm operations readiness and sign-off with receiving teams
* Manage decommissioning of end-of-life hardware — safe power-down, de-racking, and removal
* Oversee data sanitization, asset tracking, and compliant resale, recycling, or destruction
* Maintain regulatory and chain-of-custody compliance throughout the disposition process
* Build and maintain integrated project schedules, budgets, risk registers, and status reporting across all lifecycle phases
* Coordinate vendors, contractors, and internal stakeholders, holding each accountable to scope, timeline, and quality
* Track hardware assets and maintain accurate lifecycle records in the CMDB / asset management system
* Identify risks and dependencies early, drive resolution, and escalate clearly when decisions or trade-offs are needed

Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Business Management, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* Several years of technical project management experience delivering datacenter or IT infrastructure hardware projects
* Demonstrated experience across the hardware lifecycle: datacenter buildout, infrastructure build and configuration, operations handover, and decommissioning and disposition
* Certifications are a plus — e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, or CSM for project management, and datacenter / infrastructure credentials such as CDCP/CDCS, ITIL, or relevant vendor certifications (Cisco, Dell, HPE)
* Experience with ITAD, data sanitization standards (e.g., NIST 800-88), and environmental / chain-of-custody compliance is a plus

The Company is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, sex, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, gender, ethnicity, religion, national origin, ancestry, nationality, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, genetic information, or on any other basis prohibited by law (except where an attribute is a bona fide occupational qualification).

aef106b71be6cb2a21f8.title: Project Manager, Pre-Engineered Install
aef106b71be6cb2a21f8.description:
Who We Are:

At Encore Fire Protection, we are proud to be the East Coast's largest full-service fire protection company, serving over 90,000 customers from Maine to Louisiana. Our team of more than 2,800 dedicated employees provides customized fire protection solutions that protect lives and property every day.

Our goal is to deliver a unique experience to those who depend on us to make their lives safer and easier. We are passionate about growing with purpose, driving real innovation, and creating a winning culture built on teamwork, success, and an unwavering commitment to safety.

Our mission? ***To be the best fire protection company the industry has ever seen.***

The Opportunity:

Encore is hiring a Suppression Project Manager to run fast-moving projects for our pre-engineered fire suppression systems. These systems are built on factory-tested design parameters, and you will manage them across four types of work: commercial kitchens, vehicle suppression for bulldozers and other heavy operator equipment, paint booths, and other industrial manufacturing environments that require suppression systems.

Most of our projects are one to two days long, so this role moves quickly and rewards deep technical knowledge. You know your materials, you know what works and what doesn't, and you can adapt in the moment. When the schedule tightens or the materials on hand aren't what the plan called for, you find a smart, code-compliant way to get the job done with the team and resources you have.

Key Responsibilities:

**Project Management and Execution**

* Manage a high volume of short-duration suppression projects, typically one to two days, from scope review through completion and closeout.
* Plan each job, assign crews, and keep projects on schedule and on budget in a fast-paced environment.
* Adjust plans, sequencing, and crew assignments in real time to meet deadlines when conditions, materials, or staffing change.
* Resolve field problems quickly and within code, manufacturer requirements, and project scope, and escalate when a decision is beyond your authority.

**Technical Systems Expertise**

* Apply detailed knowledge of pre-engineered suppression systems, including restaurant kitchen systems, and their manufacturer design, installation, and testing requirements.
* Manage fire suppression systems built onto vehicles and heavy equipment, including bulldozers and other off-road machinery, working through mounting, routing, and detection challenges unique to each machine.
* Manage industrial suppression projects and paint booth suppression systems, including the related code and customer requirements.
* Review drawings, specifications, equipment details, and site conditions to confirm the right system, components, and approach for every job.
* Ensure all work complies with applicable NFPA standards, manufacturer listings, and the requirements of the authority having jurisdiction.

**Materials, Scheduling, and Resources**

* Plan material needs for each project, confirm availability, and find compliant alternatives or solutions when specified items are delayed or unavailable.
* Work with purchasing, warehouse, and branch teams to keep jobs supplied and moving.
* Get the most out of the team and resources available, balancing crew skills, schedules, and competing priorities.

**Customer and Trade Coordination**

* Serve as the main point of contact for customers, general contractors, and other trades on assigned projects.
* Set clear expectations on scope, schedule, system shutdowns, and access, and keep customers informed throughout the job.
* Coordinate with equipment owners, facility managers, and other trades to minimize downtime and disruption.

**Quality, Safety, and Documentation**

* Verify workmanship, system testing, and commissioning before project completion, and conduct customer walkthroughs and handoffs as needed.
* Maintain accurate project records, including scope changes, inspection and test documentation, and turnover paperwork.
* Track project costs, manage change orders, and support timely billing.
* Promote a safe work environment and follow all applicable OSHA and job-site safety procedures, including those for industrial sites and hot work.

What You Bring to the Table:

* 5-10 years of experience in fire suppression systems, including project management or technical field leadership.
* Strong technical knowledge of pre-engineered suppression systems, including commercial kitchen systems.
* Experience with vehicle and heavy equipment fire suppression systems.
* Experience with industrial suppression systems and paint booth systems.
* Working knowledge of NFPA 17, 17A, 33, and 96, manufacturer requirements, and applicable local codes.
* Ability to read and interpret drawings, specifications, and manufacturer design manuals.
* Proven ability to manage multiple fast-moving projects, prioritize under pressure, and solve problems on the fly.
* Strong communication skills with customers, contractors, and internal teams.
* Ability to lead and coordinate crews of varying experience levels.

**What Will Make You Stand Out?**

* NICET certification in Special Hazards Suppression Systems.
* Manufacturer certifications for pre-engineered suppression systems.
* Hands-on technician experience before moving into project management.
* Project management training or certification, such as PMP.
* OSHA 30 certification.
* Experience with job costing, scheduling, and project management software.

Beyond the Paycheck:

At Encore, we’re all about creating a culture where success is celebrated. We recognize that our work makes people’s lives safer, and we reward those who contribute to our growth. Here’s what you can expect:

* **Competitive Salary**: Compensation commensurate with your experience, with the opportunity to earn performance-based bonuses tied to your personal effectiveness and contributions to the team.
* **Purpose-Driven Work Environment**: We believe in working smarter, not harder. You’ll be part of a culture that values results, and we empower our team to focus on impactful work.
* **Flexible Dress Code**: Upon joining, you’ll receive branded Encore swag, and we believe in dressing for the objective, not the occasion. Most days, you can enjoy a casual work environment, but we’ll dress up when the situation calls for it.
* **People-Focused Culture**: We know our greatest strength is our people. That’s why we’ve built a culture that encourages experimentation, learning, and improving together. You’ll have the space to share your ideas and help shape a company that is constantly growing.
* **Tools for Success:** Access to leading-edge web-based productivity tools.
* **Health and Wellness**: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage to keep you and your family healthy.
* **Retirement Planning**: Participation in our Fidelity 401(k) plan with a company match, helping you save for your future.
* **Life Insurance**: Company-paid life insurance policy of $50,000 to give you peace of mind.

EEO Statement:

*At Encore Fire Protection, we protect people and property, and that starts with how we treat each other. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and welcome applicants of all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, status as a protected veteran, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. If you need a reasonable accommodation at any point during the application or interview process, please let us know at* *resumes@encorefireprotection.com**.*

41e98da2d1549ea8be3f.title: Program Manager - Second Shift
41e98da2d1549ea8be3f.description:
**SUMMARY:**

The Program Manager (PM) oversees and manages up to five (5) Community Living Arrangement (CLA) homes under Pennsylvania Office of Developmental Programs (ODP) 6400 regulations, supporting individuals who have intellectual and developmental disabilities (IDD), complex medical needs, physical disabilities, and mental illness. The PM manages all aspects of the home(s) during their assigned shift maintaining a clean, safe, and orderly environment for individuals with tasks including, but not limited to, supervising, training, and coaching staff, working alongside Direct Support Professionals (DSPs) to ensure implementation of Individualized Support Plans (ISPs), maintaining appropriate staffing levels, planning active programming, conducting medication observations, vehicle securement observations, and safety drills (CPR, seizure response, fire, etc.), and training assigned staff on individuals’ food and diet.

The PM provides feedback, coaches, and models professional behavior and correct methods of care to the DSPs, while also delegating tasks appropriately and ensuring accountability in close collaboration with the Treatment Manager and Overnight Supervisor so that the home functions smoothly 24/7 and meets 6400 regulations to provide a healthy, happy quality of life for the individuals served at CADES.

This role is regularly scheduled for the second shift Monday-Friday with periodic weekend on-call shifts. Regular, physical attendance at a CADES location Monday through Friday is required.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES****:**

* Provides supervision of assigned staff in the areas including, but not limited to, recruitment, selection, leadership, coaching, training, skill assessment, performance management, and corrective action.
* Collaborates with the Treatment Manager and Overnight Supervisor to complete performance evaluations for DSPs who may work multiple shifts.
* Works with, understands, and complies with terms and conditions of collective bargaining agreements (CBA) within a unionized environment with tasks including but not limited to adherence to scheduling procedures, processing transfers and promotions, administering disciplinary actions, adjudicating grievances, where appropriate, etc.
* Conducts regular house meetings (weekly, monthly, and as-needed) to ensure staff have a regular touchpoint with the team to review information and policies, receive regular updates, recognition, and feedback, and confirm that all staff in the respective homes know and are following policies, procedures, and individual support plans; keeps a written record/summary of all meetings (dates, attendance, and topics reviewed) and securely files those records.
* Monitors staff schedules for the group homes and ensures staff are following the schedule and that schedules align with needed staffing ratios; proactively communicates with the Treatment Manager, Overnight Supervisor, scheduling team and medical appointment team to ensure there are no gaps in support for the residents served; has knowledge of and implements backup plans in homes when dealing with emergencies that impact staffing ratios.
* Monitors the due dates and completion of Relias training and communicates to staff if assigned training is coming due or has lapsed to ensure completion and compliance with requirements.
* Completes orientation for any new direct support professionals and works alongside DSPs to coach and model all needed direct care skills utilized to work effectively in the home; confirms skill mastery and performs regular reviews, refreshers, and assessments to ensure staff have and demonstrate skills required to effectively support individuals.
* Utilizes a corporate credit card for supplies needed in the homes and reconciles the card as required per policy to ensure fiscal responsibility and adherence to budget.
* Models and coaches DSPs on the appropriate way to receive and greet visitors in the home to ensure a friendly, welcoming, and safe environment for all while protecting individual’s privacy and health.
* Provides coaching and training to Direct Support Professionals on essential job tasks including, but not limited to, completing effective documentation, accurately administering medication, changing, bathing, providing appropriate meals in the correct texture for the residents, cleaning and sanitizing the home, and engaging in proper infection control and use of PPE to ensure staff competency and the health and safety of the individuals supported.
* Coaches and directs assigned staff to accurately and effectively complete all required documentation including, but not limited to, daily t-logs, overnight checklists, food logs, sleep charts, and behavior data; regularly monitors data sources for completion and provides feedback and retraining as needed.
* Ensures that any training, coaching, or supervision provided is well-documented by sending staff a summary of what was discussed or reviewed and what is expected going forward/any follow up or action needed; enter and file documentation appropriately in the respective system (i.e. Therap, Paycom, Relias).
* Recognizes and builds on staff strengths, delegating household tasks to staff who are particularly good at/role models for certain elements of direct care, and praising staff accordingly for work well done.
* Completes medication observations and medication audits in line with ODP regulations; trains and holds staff accountable for administering medication and completing corresponding documentation thoroughly and accurately to ensure the health and safety of individuals supported.
* Provides training, coaching, and supervision to direct support professionals in the home, ensuring that all administrative tasks are completed including, but not limited to, electronic health record (EHR) documentation, visitor sign in sheets, Paycom, and Relias duties.
* Receives staff call outs and assists with locating qualified staff coverage to ensure adequate staffing in homes.
* Proactively contacts and updates direct support professionals who have been left on shift beyond their designated hours to ensure open communication and manage expectations that coverage will be available as soon as possible as well as demonstrate excellent customer service and expected communication standards for our staff.
* Returns calls, emails, and messages to all stakeholders to ensure respect and open and transparent communication.
* Protects and adheres to HIPPA compliance and confidentiality by ensuring that staff communications occur via HIPPA compliant systems (i.e. SCOM, utilizing CADES house cell phone).
* Demonstrates respectful, professional, engaging behavior with DSPs, the individuals served, CADES treatment team members, and any external stakeholders including, but not limited to, families, neighbors, physicians, supports coordinators, ODP representatives and external clinicians.
* Responds to emergencies following assigned training protocols (i.e. CPR, fire safety, utilization of rescue meds) and demonstrates/models skills and behaviors in responding to emergencies to ensure others know how to respond in emergencies; practices drills with staff to ensure they know how to respond appropriately in crisis situations.
* Supports the training of direct support professionals on specific clinical treatment plans such as proactive behavior strategies, transfer techniques, food texture modification training.
* Communicates regularly with families and other external stakeholders to coordinate leisure activities and visits for the individuals residing in the CLAs; considers the recreational needs for each individual and works with them to engage in a variety of leisure activities; arranges transportation and ensures funds are available to complete recreational activities; encourages direct support professionals to engage residents in building a portfolio of interests and activities, building skills, social capital, and enhancing the quality of life for the residents CADES supports.
* Reports and documents incidents concerning behaviors and other unusual incidents to program leadership to ensure appropriate follow up activities.
* Models and demonstrates how to engage in rapport building interactions with the individuals served at the CLA; demonstrates how respect, kindness, tone, as well as utilizing individuals preferred communication strategies and person-centered strategies are effective tools in engaging individuals and showing respect for the people CADES serves.
* Operates agency-provided vehicles and ensures the safe transportation of individuals served, including following required safety and wheelchair securement procedures for mobility devices.
* Participates in on-call responsibilities as assigned.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE/SKILLS REQUIREMENTS**

* High school diploma or graduate equivalency diploma; bachelor’s degree in human services, social work, or related field.
* Three (3) years’ experience working with individuals living with multiple disabilities, including a strong understanding of the safety and communication support required for individuals with physical disabilities.
* Two (2) years demonstrated experience in the supervision of staff in areas including, but not limited to, recruitment, selection, leadership, coaching, training, performance management, promotion, discipline, and termination.
* Previous experience working in and managing a unionized workforce.
* Knowledge of Pennsylvania Department of Public Welfare 6400 regulations.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced environment and effectively prioritize tasks.
* Demonstrated strong attention to detail.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively as part of a team.
* Demonstrated strong time management and organizational skills.
* Demonstrated excellent judgment with the ability to independently solve problems and make decisions with little or no need for direct supervision.
* Demonstrated ability to anticipate changes and/or identify issues and take appropriate and effective actions.
* Excellent customer interaction, collaboration, and written and verbal communication skills.
* Demonstrated intermediate experience with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, Outlook, SharePoint, and PowerPoint.
* Experience using electronic management/electronic records systems; Therap preferred.

* Must be able to perform CPR, First Aid, and crisis intervention using agency-trained protocols.
* Must pass and maintain CADES driving and securement observation certification.
* Must possess a current, valid driver's license in the state of residence, have a minimum of three (3) years of driving experience within the United States, and have an acceptable driving record, which will be assessed through a review of the Division of Motor Vehicles (DMV) record.
* Available for weekend work as needed and scheduled.
* Ability to attend meetings off site as necessary.

c0f3a1f5a699d3489972.title: Training and Workforce Development Coordinator
c0f3a1f5a699d3489972.description:
**Training & Workforce Development Coordinator**

**Company:** Eternal Workforce Group LLC (EWG)  
**Location:** Douglasville, GA | Metro Atlanta & Surrounding Areas  
**Job Type:** Full-Time / Part-Time (Based on Organizational Needs)  
**Compensation:** Competitive, based on qualifications and experience  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday (Remote)

**About Eternal Workforce Group LLC**

Eternal Workforce Group LLC (EWG) is a growing staffing, recruitment, workforce development, and business education company dedicated to connecting individuals with meaningful employment opportunities while helping businesses build stronger, more productive workforces.

Through our Workforce Development & Small Business Education division, we focus on career readiness, professional development, employer education, workforce training, and industry-specific skill development.

Our mission is to bridge the gap between employers seeking qualified talent and individuals seeking the skills, training, and opportunities necessary for long-term career success.

**Position Overview**

Eternal Workforce Group LLC is seeking a highly organized, motivated, and passionate **Training & Workforce Development Coordinator** to assist in developing, coordinating, and delivering workforce development programs, employment readiness initiatives, and professional training opportunities.

This position plays an essential role in supporting EWG's workforce development initiatives by organizing training programs, assisting participants with career preparation, coordinating employer partnerships, and ensuring the effective delivery of educational workshops.

The ideal candidate possesses strong communication skills, organizational abilities, a passion for helping individuals succeed, and experience in training, education, workforce development, human resources, or program coordination.

**Key ResponsibilitiesWorkforce Training & Program Coordination**

* Assist in designing, organizing, and implementing workforce development programs.
* Coordinate training schedules, workshops, orientations, and educational sessions.
* Facilitate job-readiness training, workplace professionalism, and career development workshops.
* Support the development of training materials, presentations, instructional guides, and assessments.
* Coordinate virtual and in-person training sessions.
* Track participant enrollment, attendance, completion rates, and training outcomes.
* Evaluate training effectiveness and recommend improvements.
* Ensure training initiatives align with employer expectations and workforce needs.

**Career Readiness & Employment Support**

* Assist job seekers with resume development, interview preparation, and employment readiness.
* Conduct employment orientations and career development workshops.
* Identify workforce skill gaps and recommend appropriate training resources.
* Support participants throughout their training and employment preparation process.
* Maintain participant records and monitor employment readiness milestones.
* Collaborate with EWG's recruitment team to connect trained candidates with potential employment opportunities.

**Employer & Community Partnerships**

* Assist with building relationships with local employers, educational institutions, workforce agencies, and community organizations.
* Coordinate employer-sponsored training and customized workforce development programs.
* Support outreach initiatives that promote workforce education and employment opportunities.
* Participate in employer meetings, community events, job fairs, and workforce development activities.
* Help identify employer training needs and recommend appropriate workforce solutions.

**Small Business & Employer Education**

* Assist in coordinating educational workshops for small business owners and employers.
* Support programs covering hiring practices, onboarding, employee retention, workplace communication, and workforce management.
* Coordinate guest speakers, industry professionals, and training facilitators.
* Assist in preparing educational resources and presentations.
* Support the development of business education programs designed to strengthen employer operations.

**Administrative & Program Reporting**

* Maintain accurate training schedules, participant records, and program documentation.
* Monitor training participation, completion, and performance metrics.
* Prepare program updates, progress reports, and training summaries.
* Assist with tracking program expenses and coordinating training resources.
* Maintain professional communication with participants, instructors, employers, and EWG leadership.
* Support documentation and reporting requirements for applicable workforce contracts, grants, and training agreements.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Associate degree in Education, Human Resources, Business Administration, Workforce Development, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience considered.
* At least 1 year of experience in training coordination, workforce development, education, human resources, recruitment, or program administration preferred.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Excellent organizational and time-management abilities.
* Ability to coordinate multiple projects, participants, and training schedules.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and virtual meeting platforms.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
* Comfortable facilitating group discussions, orientations, and training sessions.
* Ability to travel to local training locations, employer sites, and community events as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with workforce development programs, employment services, or adult education.
* Familiarity with career readiness training, job placement services, or vocational education.
* Experience developing training materials or instructional presentations.
* Knowledge of workforce development grants, government-funded programs, or workforce initiatives.
* Experience coordinating community partnerships or employer outreach.
* Familiarity with Learning Management Systems (LMS), training databases, or participant tracking systems.
* Experience in staffing, recruitment, or human resources.

**Ideal Candidate**

**We are looking for someone who is:**

* Passionate about education, employment opportunities, and community development.
* Organized, dependable, and detail-oriented.
* Comfortable communicating with diverse audiences.
* Creative in developing engaging educational activities.
* Proactive in identifying opportunities for program improvement.
* Able to build and maintain positive professional relationships.
* Motivated to contribute to the growth of a developing workforce education division.

**Career Growth Opportunities**

As Eternal Workforce Group LLC continues expanding its workforce development and education initiatives, this position may provide opportunities for advancement into roles such as:

* Workforce Development Program Manager
* Training & Education Manager
* Employer Partnership Coordinator
* Workforce Development Director

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates should submit an updated resume through Indeed.

Applicants are encouraged to highlight relevant experience in workforce training, program coordination, teaching, recruitment, community outreach, or career development.

Qualified applicants may be contacted for an initial interview.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Eternal Workforce Group LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to providing fair employment opportunities to qualified applicants.

*Position availability, scheduling, and responsibilities may vary based on organizational needs and program development.*

Pay: $26.00 - $34.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

### **General Information**

Position Title

ICT Analyst

### **Job Highlight**

DCO is strengthening its in-house capacity to maintain and improve practical digital tools used across the Resident Coordinator System. This role provides an opportunity to contribute to low-code and coded solution development, workflow automation, data analytics, UNINFO-related data integration, geospatial analysis, and testing of applied AI solutions, including retrieval-augmented generation, AI-enabled analytical tools, and user-centred digital solutions while working under the guidance of experienced developers and data specialists, under appropriate and responsible AI standards.

### **About the Region**

The UNOPS Global Portfolios Office (GPO) brings together diverse expertise to help partners deliver impact worldwide. With hubs in New York, Geneva, and Vienna, and expert teams operating globally, GPO leads multi-regional initiatives that advance sustainable development, climate action, and peacebuilding - including in some of the world’s most challenging environments. By leveraging our collective expertise and global networks, GPO supports UNOPS’ strategic priorities and the Sustainable Development Goals across more than 130 countries. We work closely with major global partners - including governments, international financial institutions, and UN agencies - to deliver a wide range of services, such as project management, fund management, hosting services, and HR support.

### **About the Country/Multi-Country Office**

Not Required - part of GPO/NYPO

### **Job Specific Context**

UNOPS has signed an agreement with the United Nations to implement defined activities in support of the Development Coordination Office (DCO).

  
  

The United Nations Development Coordination Office (DCO) supports the UN Resident Coordinator System globally, providing oversight, guidance and operational services to drive coordinated development results across 162 countries and territories.

In its Resolution A/RES/72/279, the United Nations General Assembly endorsed the transformation of the UN Development Coordination Office (UNDCO) as a stand-alone coordination office within the United Nations Secretariat. DCO assumed managerial and oversight functions of the resident coordinator system under the collective ownership of the members of the United Nations Sustainable Development Group (UNSDG). Under the UN development system reform, a reinvigorated RC system has been rolled out since 2019 and has created new frameworks, instruments, tools and platforms to support the RC system and enhance accountability and transparency.

To improve development coordination, facilitate data harmonization and demonstrate the UNSDG’s contribution to Agenda 2030, DCO established the online UN INFO system. UN INFO enables users to manage the data for a standard results framework based upon the UN Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework guidance. Accurate data management and analysis of information within UN INFO is critical for accountability and transparency on the work and results of the UN development system and of the RC system. UNINFO is also the main system for the UNCTs in their active engagement on the Efficiencies agenda, which enables cost effective sharing and use of resources within each country's context.

  

### **Role Purpose**

The ICT Analyst will support the Data, Digital and Innovation team in developing, maintaining and improving practical digital products, data services and analytical tools. The role will include low-code and coded solution development, workflow automation, data preparation and integration, reporting, visualization, geospatial analysis and applied AI prototypes that respond to agreed operational and analytical needs. This does not include complex software architecture or infrastructure ownership.

  
  

The incumbent will help translate business requirements into prototypes and working solutions; prepare, clean, validate, integrate and analyze data; develop dashboards, reports, and mapping products; test changes; maintain documentation; and support users and business focal points.

  
  

The incumbent may also contribute to AI-enabled analytical tools, retrieval-augmented generation solutions, intelligent assistants, reusable automation components, API-enabled integrations and information-analysis workflows. Complex architecture, security, production infrastructure, enterprise integration and DevOps decisions will be addressed in collaboration with senior team members and relevant technical owners.

  
  

The incumbent will work remotely with developers, data specialists and business focal points based in New York and across UN Resident Coordinator Offices, participating in regular team meetings, sprint activities and knowledge-sharing sessions.

  
  

The main technologies include Microsoft Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint or Dataverse, SQL, Python, Git, ArcGIS or QGIS, APIs, relational data platforms, and selected Azure or AI-enabled services.

  
  

Work may also involve retrieval-augmented generation, prompt engineering, automated testing, data pipelines, and responsible evaluation of AI-generated outputs.

  
  

Familiarity with every technology is not expected at entry; the incumbent should demonstrate sound analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail and the ability to learn and apply new tools.

  
  

The ICT Analyst will work under the supervision of the ICT Specialist - Reporting.

  
  

The incumbent of this position will be personnel of UNOPS under its full responsibility.

### **Functions / Key Results Expected**

The incumbent will support the delivery and maintenance of low-code digital solutions and data analytics products as part of the DCO development team. Work will be carried out under agreed standards and with guidance from senior technical colleagues. Key functions include:

  
  

* **Digital solution development and automation:** Configure, develop and enhance forms, applications, analytical tools and workflow automations using approved low-code platforms and, where appropriate, coded components. Apply reusable development patterns, version control and agreed technical standards.
* **Data preparation and management:** Collect, clean, transform, reconcile, validate and organize structured data for reporting, analysis and operational use. Support repeatable ETL processes, data pipelines, data models, taxonomies, metadata and data-quality controls.
* **Data analysis and visualization:** Produce clear analyses, dashboards, reports and interactive visualizations that respond to agreed business and decision-making needs, including rapid and ad hoc analytical requests.
* **UNINFO data and integration support:** Contribute to UNINFO data analysis, reporting, quality assurance and the development of AI-ready data structures. Support API-led data exchange and integration between UNINFO and other authorized enterprise data sources, under agreed security, governance and architectural standards.
* Requirements and process mapping: Support consultations with business focal points, document user needs and map existing processes to identify opportunities for simplification or automation.
* **Testing and quality assurance:** Define or support acceptance criteria; prepare and execute test cases; validate data, integrations and outputs; document defects; and contribute to automated testing, code or configuration review, and responsible-AI quality checks.
* **Technical maintenance and solution support:** Investigate application, automation and data-quality issues; resolve routine technical problems related to solutions maintained by the team; and escalate complex incidents or service-desk matters to senior team members.
* **Documentation and knowledge sharing:** Maintain user guides, data definitions, process notes and technical documentation, and support demonstrations or training sessions.
* **Team collaboration:** Participate in sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, code or configuration reviews and other agile team activities.
* **AI-enabled solution development:** Support the design, prototyping, testing and improvement of AI-enabled analytical tools, retrieval-augmented generation solutions, intelligent assistants and agentic or automated workflows. Contribute to prompt design or testing, source grounding, output evaluation, quality assurance and responsible-AI controls under the guidance of senior technical colleagues.
* **Information analysis and verification:** Support structured analysis of authorized open-source and organizational information, including source assessment, classification, pattern identification and verification, in accordance with applicable information-security, data-protection and ethical requirements. This in support of corporate reporting needs.
* **Continuous improvement:** Keep skills current in low-code development, data analytics, accessibility, data protection and responsible use of AI. Apply this learning progressively under appropriate technical guidance.

### **Skills**

Business Analysis, Data Analysis, Data Integration, Data Mining, Data Modeling, Data Visualization, Microsoft Power BI, MySQL, Python

### **Competencies**

Treats all individuals with respect; responds sensitively to differences and encourages others to do the same. Upholds organisational and ethical norms. Maintains high standards of trustworthiness. Role model for diversity and inclusion.

Acts as a positive role model contributing to the team spirit. Collaborates and supports the development of others. **For people managers only:** Acts as positive leadership role model, motivates, directs and inspires others to succeed, utilizing appropriate leadership styles.

Demonstrates understanding of the impact of own role on all partners and always puts the end beneficiary first. Builds and maintains strong external relationships and is a competent partner for others (if relevant to the role).

Efficiently establishes an appropriate course of action for self and/or others to accomplish a goal. Actions lead to total task accomplishment through concern for quality in all areas. Sees opportunities and takes the initiative to act on them. Understands that responsible use of resources maximizes our impact on our beneficiaries.

Open to change and flexible in a fast paced environment. Effectively adapts own approach to suit changing circumstances or requirements. Reflects on experiences and modifies own behavior. Performance is consistent, even under pressure. Always pursues continuous improvements.

Evaluates data and courses of action to reach logical, pragmatic decisions. Takes an unbiased, rational approach with calculated risks. Applies innovation and creativity to problem-solving.

Expresses ideas or facts in a clear, concise and open manner. Communication indicates a consideration for the feelings and needs of others. Actively listens and proactively shares knowledge. Handles conflict effectively, by overcoming differences of opinion and finding common ground.

### **Education Requirements**

* An advanced university degree (Master's degree or equivalent), preferably in information technology, information systems, information management, data science, business analytics or a related field is required; or
* A first-level university degree (Bachelor's degree or equivalent) , preferably in information technology, information systems, information management, data science, business analytics or a related field with two (2) years of relevant experience is required; or
* A high school diploma with six (6)years of relevant experience is required.

### **Experience Requirements**

**Required:**

Please make sure to explicitly highlight the number of years/experience relevant experience you have in your application:

* Relevant experience is defined as experience in data analysis, reporting, business process automation, or digital solutions development and maintenance.
* Experience using at least one low-code or data analytics platform, such as Microsoft Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, Tableau, Qlik, or a comparable tool, is required.
* Experience preparing, cleaning, validating, and analyzing structured data is required.
  

  

**Desired:**

* Experience creating dashboards and reports using Power BI, including Power Query and basic data modelling, is desirable.
* Experience developing forms, applications or workflow automations using Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint, Dataverse or comparable platforms is an asset.
* Working knowledge of SQL for querying and validating data is desirable.
* Basic experience with Python for data preparation, analysis or automation is desirable.
* Familiarity with version control, preferably Git, is an asset.
* Experience gathering user requirements, mapping business processes and documenting solutions is desirable
* Experience testing digital products, documenting defects and supporting users is an asset.
* Experience working in an agile team or using task and issue-tracking tools is desirable.
* Experience working independently and collaboratively with remote, geographically diverse teams is desirable.
* Familiarity with APIs, relational databases, cloud services or data integration concepts is an asset; advanced development or infrastructure administration is not required.
* Exposure to AI-assisted tools, simple AI-enabled applications or the evaluation of AI-generated outputs is an asset.
* Exposure to geospatial data, vector data or mapping tools is an asset.
